Find the state space equation and optimize it with the constraints of the target as the PMP suggests. Therefore, the multi-objective cost function is proposed. The primary objective function is to minimize the equivalent fuel consumption while coordinate engine and dual motors in real time. Reduce the battery SOC fluctuation and extend the battery life. This paper analyzes several typical control strategies of HEV, and evaluates the control effect as well as fuel saving effect of control strategy. The results show that PMP based HEV control strategy can effectively reduce fuel consumption.

articleTitle: Design of fractional-order iterative learning controller for cross-coupled contour motion systems
abstract: For the contouring errors produced by repetitive tracking motion of single-axis linear motor on XY platform, a combined method of fractional iterative learning and cross coupled is proposed. Firstly, a positional controller of the fractional PD-type iterative learning is designed, and the integer differential operator is replaced by the differential operator defined by Grünwald-Letnikov fractional calculus to improve the traditional integer order iterative learning law. The convergence condition of the fractional iterative learning controller is given. Then, the cross-coupled control is adopted between two axes, and the contour error is estimated by using the real-time contour error estimation model to reduce the contour error. The compensation amount of X and Y axis is assigned according to the relationship of cross-coupled gain, and the real-time compensation. The simulation shows that compared with integral iterative learning, fractional iterative learning has faster convergent speed and higher accuracy of contouring process. Fractional iterative learning is an effective way to improve the contour error.

articleTitle: An image haze removal algorithm based on blockwise processing using LAB color space and bilateral filtering
abstract: In order to solve the problem in image haze removal algorithms based on dark channel prior like color distortion and blurred image edge information, an improved image haze removal algorithm based on blockwise processing is proposed. Firstly, we choose LAB color space instead of RGB color space. Then, bilateral filtering is used to preserve edge smoothly and refine the transmission map. Finally, we set the tolerance for blockwise processing to remove color distortion problem. The results demonstrate that, the new algorithm we proposed can successfully solve the problems like color distortion and blurred image edge information in image removal based on dark channel prior, the algorithm's running time is greatly reduced simultaneously.

articleTitle: Research on information disclosure of corporate social responsibility based on environmental friendliness
abstract: Disclosure of social responsibility information is the basis for enterprises to fulfill their social responsibilities. The higher information level an enterprise discloses, the more effort it takes, which means the better social responsibility it fulfills. Environmental responsibility is not only reflected in how to reduce the damage to the environment and how to strengthen the governance of the damaged environment, but also in the actively it discloses the information about the environment. The combination of social responsibility information disclosure and environmental protection is significant in the development of Chinese enterprises. The purpose of this study is to answer the question of corporate social responsibility information disclosure, the importance of corporate environmental responsibility information disclosure, and the countermeasures and suggestions. to improve the corporate social responsibility information disclosure, especially the environmental information disclosure level.

articleTitle: Simulation of Buck-Boost torque ripple suppression technique for hoisting and conveying of motor
abstract: In order to improve the safety and reliability of mine hoisting and conveying system, the torque ripple suppression technique of brushless DC motor based on Buck-Boost is proposed. First, the development and current situation of the mine hoisting and conveying system are introduced. Then detailed analyzing the output characteristics of the working state of topology structure and inductance continuous mode for Buck-Boost DC converter. At last, based on the SIMULINK module of MATLAB software, modelling and simulating for Buck-Boost DC converter technique under the working frequency of 20 kHz. The simulation curve of switch tube gate trigger pulse, inductance voltage, inductance current, switch tube current and diode current can be obtained. The simulation results are basically consistent with the theoretical analysis, which shows the rationality of the designed Buck-Boost DC converter model.

articleTitle: Research on fault diagnosis method based on ITD & MED
abstract: In order to extract the fault characteristics of rolling bearing from complex operating conditions, a fault diagnosis method is proposed based on Intrinsic Time-scale Decomposition (ITD) and Minimum Entropy Deconvolution (MED). Firstly, by applying ITD to decompose vibration signals, a great deal of Proper Rotation (PR) shall be obtained. And those PR containing the most fault information shall be used for signal restructure based on the kurtosis criterion. Then with the use of MED, the restructured signals are able to be reduced and the impact features of those signals shall be enhanced. Finally, the Teager energy operator has been used to calculate the deduction of noise reduction signal and to draw the Teager energy spectrum which can identify the fault features of roll bearing. With the adaptation of this method for fault diagnosis of the rolling bearing, the experimental results have verified the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Smooth rapid three-axis reorientation of spacecraft
abstract: A practical chattering-free near-minimum-time control law is proposed to rotate a spacecraft around its eigenaxis. In the proposed control law, an analytic reference attitude generation method for smooth rapid three-axis reorientation along its eigenaxis is proposed first. Practical control constraints such as wheel torque and wheel speed are also taken into account in the reference attitude generation method. Attitude tracking feedback control is then used during the eigenaxis rotations to deal with inertia uncertainty and external disturbances. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Research on battery charging strategy based on multi-model adaptive
abstract: The charging method of battery is studied in this paper. This paper presents a multi-model adaptive charging method for the variation of the parameters in the battery charging process. And introduce the multi-model theory and method, determine the multi-model, controller and switching index of lithium battery. At last the feasibility and correctness of the charging method based on multi-model adaptive control are verified by MATLAB.

articleTitle: Chebyshev neural network observer based RBF neural network terminal sliding mode controller for a class of nonlinear system
abstract: This paper focuses on an observer-based controller for a class of nonlinear systems. In order to solve the problem of unknown dynamic in practical systems, two different Neural Networks (NNs) for observer and controller parts are adopted. In the observer part, a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) neural network based on error back propagation algorithm is applied to update the weights of neural network that will be used to estimate the system states. In the controller part, Radial Basis Function Neural Network (RBFNN) with terminal sliding mode controller, based on a new sliding surface, is combined to achieve a finite time stability and fast convergence speed. The update law in the controller part is related to the proposed sliding surface. The stability of the closed loop system is analyzed by Lyapunov stability theory. In simulation, the proposed technique is applied to a chaotic system to obtain the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Using adaptive multi-populations GA and GANN to select signal features and classify signals
abstract: In order to optimize signal features selection and signals classification, the paper uses the F-Ratio rule to calculate fitness function of GA(genetic algorithm), introduces the multi-populations parallel and competition strategy into GA, and uses adaptive genetic operator to improve the GA. In addition, the paper uses the improved GA to optimize the neural network (NN). The results of the experiments for three typical radio signals show that the proposed methods of this paper can more effectively select the signal features subsets, and have higher classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of fuzzy PI controller for asynchronous motor direct torque
abstract: The traditional direct torque control (DTC) of asynchronous motor has the disadvantages of the flux linkage, large torque ripple and instable switching frequency. To solve the above problems, a new scheme of modulating direct torque control system by adaptive fuzzy PI was put forward. According to the principle of fuzzy control, the regulator can perform the real-time optimization of PI parameters, realizing the good dynamic and static performance of system. In order to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of this scheme, this paper builds a simulation model of direct torque control system based on adaptive fuzzy PI control regulator by using MATLAB and Simulink. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional direct torque control system, the direct torque control system modulated by adaptive fuzzy PI has the merits of obvious reducing in flux and torque ripple, significant improvement on control performance.

articleTitle: Technician scheduling in IT service with the consideration of service level
abstract: This paper mainly studies human resource scheduling problem about the IT operation considering the service level under the condition of limited human resource. How to make full use of staff skills in operation and maintenance services and allocate limited human resources so as to effectively and promptly react to the failures and minimize the cost of the enterprises. A model of human resource scheduling problem about IT operation considering the service level is established and the goal is to make total cost of human resources minimum. Besides, it adopts a heuristic to resolve the problem of infeasibility created by crossover operations. The experimental results show that, in most cases, the genetic algorithm can obtain a better feasible solution compared with the greedy algorithm, but the program runs longer.

articleTitle: Improved optimization algorithm based on random mutation strategy
abstract: Harmony Search (HS) algorithm is a good meta-heuristic intelligent optimization method, which has been paid much attention recently by many researchers. However, there is a shortage of these intelligent optimization methods are easily trapped into local optima. HS is no exception. A new variant of harmony search algorithm with random mutation strategy (HSRM), which is used to improve the performance of HS is proposed in this paper. The HSRM uses a random mutation strategy to instead of the pitch adjusting operation, and dynamically adjust the key parameters pitch adjusting rate (PAR). Furthermore, experiment results demonstrated that the proposed method is superior to the HS and recently developed variants (IHS, and GHS) and other meta-heuristic algorithms.

articleTitle: Designing an automated tractor and semi-trailer exchange system for drop and pull transport
abstract: This paper aims at designing an automated exchange system for tractor and semi-trailer. The design is based on the analysis of the current exchange system and the autonomous truck system. The purpose of this design is to improve both the efficiency of exchanging and the development of drop and pull tractor. Based on the technology of sensors and information, the designed functions are realized based on two parameters reflecting errors: 1) the deviation angle between the center-line of a tractor and that of a semi-trailer; 2) the distance between the upper plane of fifth wheel and the lower plane of hauling pin. The two parameters are collected and fed into a master computer which analyzes the errors and asks automated control parts to make adjustments on the errors. The automated tractor and trailer exchange system can save the effort of manual operations, automate the complex processes, and reduce the failure rate in the exchanging process. This automated system has significant improvement on the perspectives of safety and practicality. The model simulation and analysis based on SOLIDWORKS show that the system designed in this paper is feasible and has strong practical significance in safety and practicability.

Author Keywords: Automated Tractor and Semi-trailer Exchange System

articleTitle: Research on guidance algorithm based on strap-down devices
abstract: This paper proposes a guidance algorithm based on strap-down devices to obtain more accurate guidance information for small missile system. This paper establishes a mathematic model of inertial devices to get the navigation information of the SINS. Then the calculation results of the navigation system are used to establish the mathematical model of the inertial line-of-sight angular velocity of the strap-down seeker. So, the extraction of guidance information can be realized. In order to reduce the influence of system noise, this paper designs extended Kalman filter and unscented Kalman filter to filter the guidance information separately and compares these two filter results with the data from the track generator. The simulation results show that the guidance algorithm is effective and can obtain the guidance information to meet the requirements.

articleTitle: Condition monitoring and fault diagnosis of ball mill gear
abstract: Ball mill is a typical representative of mineral processing equipment in mining machinery. This paper was concerned with the deterioration process of monitoring of gear, including the change of vibration and the spectrum characteristics. The common failure causes of gear and the methods of monitoring and diagnosis are given, which is of significance for reducing accidents, reducing maintenance costs and maximizing production efficiency. The application of this technology in a mine ball mill is illustrated in detail with an example, and its advantages are expounded.

articleTitle: Teaching-learning-based optimization algorithm for hybrid flow shop scheduling problem with assembly operations
abstract: This paper addresses assembly-type hybrid flow shop scheduling problem (AHFSP) with the minimization of total tardiness and makespan. The products have parts which are first processed in hybrid flow shop and then are assembled at the assembly stage. To solve this problem, a part-based solution representation is adopted and a teachers' teaching-learning-based optimization (TTLBO) is proposed. Teachers chosen from a non-dominated set undergo a self-learning phase and a teaching phase and these phases are implemented by multiple neighborhood search and global search, respectively. More- over, the learning phase of learners is removed and the learning of teachers is intensified to avoid the low-efficiency computation. Extensive experiments are conducted to test the performance of TTLBO. The computational results demonstrate that TTLBO is an effective and competitive method for multi- objective AHFSP.

articleTitle: Interconnection switch on-off state identification of distribution networks based on load measurement
abstract: In this paper, two approaches of interconnection switch on-off state identification of medium voltage distribution network are proposed; one is using weighted least squares (WLS) to estimate the voltage variables of all nodes by measured values of end nodes under given possible topology models, and then using recursive Bayesian approach (RBA) to justify which topology model is the correct one; the second approach is using back-forward sweep (BFS) power flow algorithm to obtain the voltage variables of all nodes, then using the same RBP to identify the topology. The case study of IEEE 33 nodes distribution networks shows that both approaches have a high accuracy, but the BFS has a faster justification, fewer iterations, less computing time and simpler codes.

articleTitle: Design of electric business hall monitoring system based on infrared imaging
abstract: In order to achieve high quality service, obtain customer trust and loyalty, establish and maintain a good relationship between enterprises and customers, power business hall imaging system using infrared detection technology, combined with efficient electricity business hall real-time status monitoring system to achieve accurate tracking of staff and supervision as well as real-time control of user-side conditions. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional video technology, the monitoring system of power business hall based on infrared imaging has good electromagnetic compatibility and electrical isolation performance, high reliability and no influence of light conditions in the practical application, and the accuracy exceeds 98%. Therefore, based on infrared imaging of electricity business hall monitoring system is suitable for business offices, stations and other crowded places to ensure that the monitoring within the highly efficient and accurate.

articleTitle: Large-scale nickel band width detection system based on machine vision
abstract: In order to achieve on-line high-precision detection of the total width of punching nickel-plated steel strip, a method based on computer vision and linear motor measurement has been proposed. High quality nickel tape images were collected by combining high-performance industrial cameras with telecentric lenses. And, the edge of the nickel belt was then obtained by using a sub-pixel algorithm. Meanwhile, by coordinating the linear motor trajectory and getting the partial images after two times, the total width can be get by combining the movement distances. An optimization compensation algorithm is proposed, which reduces the linear motor displacement error caused by the actual installation process and the temperature. The research showed that the system can detect the large width of the nickel tape with the total width effectively and stably. The accuracy was 0.035mm.

articleTitle: A clustering-plane based energy optimization method for image segmentation
abstract: A novel regional energy minimization model is proposed in this paper, which aims to find the optimal clustering planes for respective objects in the image domain. By using the distances from the pixels to the center planes and spatial location information, the model assigns the pixels to the appropriate categories. A soft membership function is introduced to estimate the score which describes the possibility that the pixel falls into the category. Further, the spatial information is employed to amend the membership function so as to enhance the noise robustness of the model. The parameters of the center planes are updated through the energy minimization, and constrained by the prior values as well. The proposed model has been conducted on the synthetic images and real images, quantitatively and qualitatively, to demonstrate its performance.

articleTitle: Finite frequency negative imaginary lemmas for descriptor systems
abstract: This paper studies the finite frequency negative imaginary properties of descriptor systems in terms of state-space realization. Necessary and sufficient conditions are provided for descriptor systems satisfying finite frequency negative imaginary properties based on linear matrix inequalities with equality constraints. Also, a time-domain interpretation of the finite frequency negative imaginary properties for descriptor systems is provided in term of the systems input, output, state. Finally, an example is used to illustrate the result.

articleTitle: Wirtinger's inequality is applied to event-driven output control of networked control systems with H∞ performance
abstract: This paper put forward Wirtinger's inequality method used to the analysis of Network control systems(NCSs) with the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance index level based on event-driven control. Firstly, the triggering mechanism of the event is represented by a delay model. Secondly, NCSs for the coupling between the controller ,input matrix and the output matrix is eliminated by a new method . The stable condition for the closed loop system with the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance index level can be obtained by Wirtinger's inequality and linear matrix inequalities(LMI). Finally, the validity of the filter design scheme is confirmed by a given numerical case.

articleTitle: Research on Safe Management Operation and Reliability of Relay Protection in Power Plant
abstract: Relay protection is a key part of the operation in the power plant, it can protect the safety of power plants. With the reform and development of power plants, the safe operation of relay protection is facing greater pressure, it needs to meet the needs of power plants to complete security protection, to avoid causing safety incidents. Power plant operation is very focused on the application of relay protection, through the protection of power plants to maintain the safety. However, the safety management of power plant relay protection involves a wide range, and requires a high degree of professionalism and technical, in the relay protection work has a greater difficulty. Therefore, this paper analyzes the role and significance of relay protection, combined with the application of power plant relay protection, put forward the precautions for safe operation of relay protection. The implementation of these theories can improve the accuracy of the relay protection in the power plant, ensure the normal work of the relay protection equipment in the event of failure, ensure the safe production of the power plant and improve the economic benefit of the power plant.

articleTitle: Stability for NCSs with T-S fuzzy systems and interval time-varying
abstract: This paper addresses a new stability problem of a NCSs fuzzy systems with time delays. We get a new stability conditions, which are less conservative than some results, derived from a new Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional and expressed base on some linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). A numerical example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the results.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of multi-functional digital servos control system
abstract: This paper designs a scheme of multi-functional digital servos control system based on STM32. The basic functions of each module are described; the hardware and software structure and working principle of the system are analyzed. In the system three working modes which are Motor mode, Servo mode and Wait mode are provided. There are wired and wireless communication modes between the master chip and PC. The master chip uses a typical PID algorithm to process the position information that is read by contactless magnetic rotary encoder and output the corresponding PWM to control the position and speed of the servos precisely.

articleTitle: A method of catamaran pitching stabilization based on predictive control
abstract: This paper mainly studies the control method of the catamaran with T-foil. Lineared the nonlinear mathematical model of a catamaran, establish the catamaran control model with T-foil, the seasickness rate function is used as the optimization index, and the controller is designed by the method of predictive control. Through the experimental data of a specific catamaran model to analysis. In case of naked ship and in case of installing T-foil with controller, compared the heave and pitch changes, the inhibition rate of seasickness. Verified the model predictive control is proposed for the catamaran longitudinal motion and the improvement of this algorithm is practical.

articleTitle: Robust steady-state Kalman filters with uncertain model parameters
abstract: For the linear-invariant systems with uncertain model parameters and known noise variances, the robust steady-state Kalman filters are presented by the new approach of compensating the parameter uncertainties by a fictitious noise. By the Lyapunov equation approach, we prove that when the conservative upper bound of the fictitious noise variances is given, there exists a sufficiently small region of uncertain parameter, such that its actual filtering error variances are guaranteed to have a less-conservative upper bound, and such region is called the robust region. For the prescribed fictitious noise upper bound variance, by the searching method, we can find the robust region. A simulation example shows how to find the robust region, and verifies the good performance of the proposed robust Kalman filters.

articleTitle: Research on the assignment of ground support tasks for civil aviation airport
abstract: In order to achieve scientific dispatching of airport ground support staff, increase airport capacity and improve airport operation efficiency, a task assignment model under constraints is put forward. In the model, components, relationships and algorithms are described by a formal method, using the descriptive set theory. It lays the foundation for the airport ground support task assignment system. Finally, an application case is given to prove the validity of the model we proposed.

articleTitle: An approximate solution for period-1 motions in a periodically forced oscillator with quadratic nonlinearity
abstract: In this paper, analytical solutions of periodic motions in a 1-D nonlinear dynamic system with two periodic excitation forces are obtained through the generalized harmonic balance method with prescribed-computational accuracy. From this method, the dynamic system is transformed to a nonlinear dynamic system of coefficients in the Fourier series. The analytical solutions of periodic motions are obtained by equilibriums of the coefficients dynamical system, and the corresponding stability analysis is carried out via eigenvalues analysis. With different excitation frequencies, the frequency-amplitude characteristics of periodic motions are analyzed.

articleTitle: Aircraft guidance law identification using interactive multiple model estimation
abstract: The avoidance of guided missiles is a very important factor for survivability in modern air combat. A guidance law identification filter, based on the interactive multiple model using extended kalman filter (IMM-EKF) has been proposed in this paper. In the guidance law identification filter, the filter bank was composed of relative motion models based on true proportional navigation and deviated pursuit navigation guidance law. The measurements including the relative distance, line-to-sight angle and acceleration of unknown aircraft were used for estimation. The proposed algorithm was able to identify the type of deployed guidance law by comparing model probabilities of each filter. The numerical simulation of various engagement scenarios demonstrated the satisfactory performance of IMM-EKF model for guidance law identification.

articleTitle: Robust H∞ tracking consensus for nonlinear multi-agent systems with time-varying delay
abstract: The distributed robust H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> consensus problem for second-order multi-agent systems with time-varying delay and nonlinear dynamics is considered in this paper. Considering the multi-agent systems with external disturbances and model uncertainty, the consensus control protocols are designed and analyzed. By Lyapunov functional theory and linear matrices inequality (LMI) method, some sufficient conditions are given to ensure the multi-agent systems can reach consensus with the given H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance.

articleTitle: Quantized H∞ state estimation for networked control systems: A hybrid-triggered method
abstract: This paper is concerned with the state estimation problem for hybrid-triggered networked control systems (NCSs) with stochastic nonlinearity and quantization. In order to establish a higher utilization of the network resources, a hybrid-triggered transmission scheme (HTTS) and measurement size reduction scheme are introduced. Firstly, the HTTS is presented such that the signal can be transmitted according to the law, and the measurement size reduction scheme, i.e., the quantization is applied. Then, considering the effect of HTTS and quantization, the original NCSs model is reformulated as a new hybrid-triggered state estimation systems with communication delay. By using Lyapunov functional method and linear matrix inequality technique, sufficient conditions for system stability with a prescribed H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance level are established, and the design of state estimator and hybrid trigger parameters can be obtained. Finally, a simulation example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Attitude Scheduling for Dynamic Imaging of Agile Earth Observation Satellite along a Curve Target
abstract: An attitude scheduling approach is presented for dynamic imaging of agile earth observation satellite (AEOS) along a curve target. First, build a six-order or seven-order polynomial model of target position in the earth-fixed frame and the image time through iterative fitting. Then, based on the obtained model calculate the roll angle and pitch angle for target tracking and the yaw angle for image motion compensation of TDI-CCD camera at each imaging time point. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed approach is capable of effectively addressing the problem of continuous dynamic imaging along curve targets, such as coastline, borderline, rivers, etc.

articleTitle: Frequency characteristic test of electric servo mechanism based on multitone signal
abstract: Aiming at the problem of long test time and low test efficiency in traditional frequency characteristic test, the method of frequency characteristic testing based on Multitone signal is proposed. The full text systematically introduces the basic principle and generating method of Multitone signal. Then, the algorithm of frequency characteristic based on least square fitting is adopted, and the amplitude and phase frequency characteristic curves of the system are obtained through simulation test. In order to solve the problem of simulation test under the condition of keeping the same sampling frequency in the entire sweep range, an improved scheme of piecewise test is designed and applied to the simulation of frequency characteristics of a certain type of electric servos. Finally, the expected effect is achieved. The test time is further shortened, and the efficiency and accuracy of the test are improved.

articleTitle: Specific index-related process monitoring using a two-step information extraction method
abstract: Specific index-related process monitoring covers a wide range of requirements from industrial production. At present, it is still a challenge to divide into the specific index-related information and the specific index-unrelated information more accurately. In this paper, a two-step information extraction method is presented to solve this problem. In the first step, the overall process variables are separated into a strongly related variable set and a weakly related variable set. In the second step, the two sets are further divided into a specific index-related subset and a specific index-unrelated subset, respectively. Two specific index-related subsets form a new subspace related to the specific index. Two specific index-unrelated subsets are combined into a specific index-unrelated subspace. Two T<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> statistics are built in the specific index-related subspace and the specific index-unrelated subspace, respectively. Finally, the proposed method is applied for Tennessee Eastman (TE). The results indicate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design and quantitative analysis of fluorescent immunoassay detection system
abstract: Quantitative detection of fluorescence immunoassay is widely used in clinical detection. For this reason, through a reasonable design of optoelectronic circuits real-time detection system, designing a set of fully functional fluorescence immunochromatographic quantitative detection system is necessary, which integrates a large number of peripheral modules, including fluorescence signal collecting, motion control, fluorescence signal processing data, quantitative curve fitting and testing results. After the improved threshold wavelet denoising through experiments, the system performance is very good, quantitative results are accurate. So, the system of fluorescence analysis has a vital significance.

articleTitle: Multiple disseminating dynamics of human behavior in social network
abstract: Human behavior is often influenced by several external factors and there are some similarities between the information spreading and the human behavior dissemination. In this paper, we propose a novel susceptible- negative/positive-recovered-susceptible (SN/PRS) model to depict human behavior disseminating in social networks from microscopical view. Different from previous literature, the discrete SN/PRS model considers the neutralization reaction of multiple behavior, and the marginal diminishing effect. Then the influences of topology structure, degree and ratio of initial fixed infected nodes on system stability are investigated. Results display that the density of two kinds of spreaders have similar periodic oscillations, but various phase diagrams during the behavior disseminating process in different networks. Finally, the countermeasures to prevent the outbreak of negative behavior are proposed respectively.

articleTitle: Input-to-state stabilization of networked switched nonlinear systems based on event-triggered scheme
abstract: This paper investigates the input-to-state stability (ISS) for a class of networked switched nonlinear systems. To make better use of network resources and reduce the computation cost of controllers, an event-triggered scheme is proposed. The original system is rewritten as a networked switched nonlinear system with time-varying delays. Meanwhile, the switching rule is designed based on the average dwell time (ADT) method. Sufficient conditions are established by employing multiple Lyapunov functions. Finally, a numerical example is presented to illustrate the effectiveness of our results.

articleTitle: Variance-constrained control for stochastic systems with multiplicative noises
abstract: In this paper, a problem of variance-constrained control is studied for a class of stochastic systems with multiplicative noises, which affect both the system state and control input. The purpose of this paper is to seek a state feedback controller such that the closed-loop system is mean square stable while satisfying the given variance constraints. A design method of variance-constrained state feedback control is proposed in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). Finally, a numerical example is provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An adaptive primal-dual image denoising algorithm
abstract: A primal-dual model for image denoising is proposed based on duality principle. We theoretically analyze its equivalency with the ROF variation model, and its structural similarity with the saddle-point optimization model. The primal-dual algorithm based on resolvent is used for solving the model. In terms of parameter selection, the regularization parameter is updated adaptively based on the discrepancy principle. The experiment results show that the proposed primal-dual denoising algorithm is effective in improving the visual effect.

articleTitle: Flow-shop deteriorating scheduling problem via a hybrid chemical reaction optimization algorithm
abstract: The chemical reaction optimization algorithm is one of the most popular meta-heuristic population based algorithms, which is applied into many combinational optimization problems. The deteriorating effect in flow shop scheduling have gained an increasing concern from the manufacturing system and combinational optimization areas. However, Most studies focus on the two and three machines. In this paper, we propose a general flow shop scheduling problem, and a hybrid chemical reaction optimization algorithm is proposed to solve this problem. In the proposed algorithm, the newly generated molecules are constructed based on the better solutions found and injected to the population adaptively, which can enhance and balance the exploration and exploitation ability. Simulation experiments are carried out on a set of stochastic test problems with the different size. Through the analysis of experimental results, the proposed algorithm performs better than the compared algorithms in solving the proposed problem.

articleTitle: On information disclosure of social responsibility of China's chemical enterprises—Taking 308 listed companies as an example
abstract: Listed companies are the main body of corporate social responsibility reports released by Chinese enterprises. However, less than 30% of listed companies have released CSR reports, and the information disclosure of CSR in China is not good. Different industries have different requirements for social responsibility, and it is necessary to explore the information disclosure of corporate social responsibility under the industry constraints. Through the study of social responsibility reports or corporate annual reports of China's 308 listed chemical companies, we can evaluate the current level of disclosure, establish the suitable evaluation standard, improve the disclosure content, and then optimize the quality of social responsibility information disclosure of China's chemical enterprises and promote the sustainable development of chemical enterprises.

articleTitle: PID- explicit predictive dual mode control for double-water tank
abstract: A PID-explicit model predictive control (EMPC) based on dual mode strategy is developed in this paper to deal with nonlinear processes. The basic algorithm of EMPC decomposes the controller optimization problem into two steps: offline calculate and online search, which can decrease the online calculation and obtain the explicit function of control law in every state. It is convenient for controller analyzing. The traditional linearization-based nonlinear system control depends on pre-established operating point. By the idea of dual mode control, this paper adopts PID controller for nonlinear area while combining explicit model predictive control for linear area. The proposed algorithm is simulated on a double-water tank, which can decrease calculation time and have a satisfying performance.

articleTitle: Nonlinear tracking control for quadrotor aircraft with disturbance observer
abstract: In order to solve the problem of trajectory tracking control of quad-rotor aircraft with uncertain disturbances, a tracking strategy using an extended state observer to estimate the disturbance in the system was proposed. The strategy is designed by the sliding mode controller considering the estimation to overcome the uncertainty of the model and the disturbance of external uncertainties, and he tracking error of the system are ultimately bounded under the control law. The stability of the controller system designed by the above method is verified by Lyapunov stability theory. Simulation results show that the controller can realize trajectory tracking control of aircraft.

articleTitle: Input and Output Strictly Passive H-infinity Control of Switched Linear Systems
abstract: This paper is concerned with input and output strictly passive H-infinity control of switched linear systems. Based on the definition of input and output strictly passive, a sufficient condition is first derived by using multiple Lyapunov functions method, which can ensure that the autonomous system is asymptotically stable and satisfies H-infinity performance index. Next, the above result is extended to the controlled plant, and the sub-controller with explicit expression of each subsystem is given. Finally, two numerical examples are given to show the validity of the proposed approaches.

articleTitle: Roller Parameters Prediction of Steel Tube Based on Principal Component Analysis and BP Neural Network
abstract: In the roll position adjustment of current steel tube production line, roller parameters decision for new tube is only based on the artificial experience and field measurement. Lack of effective prediction method leads to the low yield of production line and the waste of labor cost. This paper takes the F400 steel tube production line as the research object. Firstly, the stream of variation model for roll forming process is established and used to predicting the roller parameter. Then, according to historical roller parameters, the machine learning prediction model is built with principal component analysis and BP neural network. Finally, the predictive simulation and production test based on the PCA - BP model is performed. The simulation and experiment results show that PCA-BP intelligent prediction outperforms the stream of variation model and artificial roller adjustment, and the production error can be controlled within 2mm. PCA-BP prediction method shorten the changing time, improve the adjustment accuracy of new steel tube, solve the problems of production yield and labor cost, and is advantageous to the actual production application.

articleTitle: Prediction of concentrate grade and recovery rate of tailings in the process of production based on chaotic ant colony algorithm
abstract: In order to improve the prediction accuracy of the concentrate grade and recovery rate of tailings in beneficiation process, taking into account the neural network has strong nonlinear mapping function. At the same time, it is difficult to establish an accurate prediction model for the two important economic and technical indexes of flotation process, which are concentrate grade and flotation recovery rate, while the conventional control method to the problem of detecting instrument expensive, and a prediction model of the economic index of flotation is put forward by combining the chaotic ant colony algorithm with the BP neural network. In this model, the principal component analysis method is used to reduce the dimension of the modeling data, and the chaotic ant colony algorithm is used to train the BP neural network, which avoids the local optimum of the network and improves the quality of the network parameter identification. Finally, the prediction method is applied in flotation workshop of Anshan Iron and steel mine, simulation and experiment results show that the model is of good adaptability and strong robustness, can predict the flotation index of economy and technology well, and provide operational guidance for adding flotation agent, has a certain value of use, can also be applied to other industries.

Author Keywords: Economic and technical indicators of flotation

articleTitle: State estimation of autonomous rotorcraft MAVs under indoor environments
abstract: This paper realizes a state estimation system for an autonomous rotorcraft micro aerial vehicle (MAV) under an indoor environment. Our system only relies on one monocular camera as a visual sensor, in addition to two controller sensors, barometer and inertial measurement unit (IMU). The barometer and IMU data are fused with image data so as to address the scale problem in monocular odometry. We implement state estimation algorithms on a DJI Matrice 100 MAV platform which is equipped with an Intel NUC computer plus an i5-6260U processor. Experimental results under an indoor environment show that the state estimation system has maximally 0.05m position bias and 0.1m loop deviation, which is suitable for many indoor applications such as search-and-rescue and disaster management.

articleTitle: Global robustness of sliding mode control for servo systems
abstract: In order to ensure the position loop of servo system static precision and dynamic tracking performance, this paper proposes a robust sliding mode controller to control strategy, eliminate the influence of reaching phase of sliding mode control on system performance. The adaptive algorithm is used to estimate the gain of the sliding mode switching term, so that the controller design does not need to predict the uncertainties in the system and the upper and lower bounds of the external disturbances. The adaptive variable structure control of the uncertain servo system is realized.

articleTitle: Simulation Research of UWB location algorithm
abstract: Ultra Wideband solves the major problems of traditional wireless technology in communication. In this paper, a UWB positioning model based on the mixed algorithm of TOA(time of arrival), RSSI (Received Signal Strength Indication) and TDOA(Time Difference of Arrival ) is proposed, and the computer simulation is carried out. The initial value which is closer to the real value is obtained by the TOA mixed RSSI method. Then the initial value is brought into the Taylor algorithm of TDOA, which solves the problem that the Taylor algorithm is not convergent. And the simulation results show that the hybrid algorithm is more accurate when the SNR is high and the number of nodes is high.

articleTitle: The simulation study of optimization of pick-and-place route for delta robot based on lame curves
abstract: In order to achieve pickup and placement of high-speed light load in industrial production, three degree of freedom Delta robot is designed to meet this requirement. In this paper, we take Delta manipulator as the research object, analyze the mechanical structure and establish kinematics model of Delta manipulator. We establish the corresponding mathematical model on the basis of the simplified kinematic model, and then obtain the kinematics inverse algorithm. In order to improve the motion characteristics of Delta manipulator, lame curves is used to smooth the right angles of transitions, thus establishing the overall shape of the trajectory in Cartesian space. The position, velocity and acceleration of the one-dimensional curve are obtained through the high order polynomial motion characteristics. Through the simulation of virtual prototype ADAMS and MATLAB, the mechanical residual vibration parameters of the Delta robot are obtained, and the optimized trajectory has good performance by comparison.

articleTitle: Delay-dependent stability analysis for load frequency control systems with two delay components
abstract: This paper investigates the delay-dependent stability of the LFC scheme considering two time-varying delays, a new less conservative delay-dependent stability criterion is proposed to study the delay margin of LFC system with PI controller based on Lyapunov-Krasovskii (LK) functional method and linear matrix inequality (LMI) technique. In the presented stability analysis procedure, the time derivative of the LK functional is bounded tightly using the Jesen inequality and the extended reciprocally convex matrix inequality. The proposed stability criterion is tested on the one-area and multi-area LFC systems, and the delay margins with respect to different value of gains of PI controllers are computed to investigate the quantitative effect of the controller gains on the delay margin, and are obtained for different load disturbance to discuss the effect of the exogenous load disturbance.

articleTitle: Actuator fault diagnosis for flight control system based on sliding mode observer
abstract: In this paper, a sliding mode observer based fault diagnosis method was proposed for a class of linear systems with the disturbance and model uncertainty to detect the actuator faults. The difficulty on the sliding mode observer method can be directly solved by using linear matrix inequalities (LMIS). The stability of the designed sliding mode observer can be guaranteed by Lyapunov stability theory. The proposed actuator fault diagnosis method is tested in a 3-DOF aircraft simulation platform to illustrate the performance of the proposed observer and the effectiveness of the fault diagnosis algorithm.

articleTitle: Echo state network-based visibility graph method for nonlinear time series prediction
abstract: For an echo state network (ESN), the reservoir topology plays a very important role in network performance. However, the computing capability of classical random structure is limited, and it can not meet the prediction accuracy requirement of some highly complicated prediction tasks. Therefore, different algorithms to construct new reservoir topology based on complex network theory have been proposed, amongst of which, the visibility graph algorithm shows to be more effective and simple. In this paper, a new ESN based on the visibility graph (VGESN) is proposed to perform the prediction of Mackey-Glass chaotic system (MGS) and nonlinear autoregressive moving average (NARMA) time series. Furthermore, the network features of associated graphs are analysed, including the small-world feature and scale- free property. The simulation results indicate that the proposed VGESN has better prediction performance compared with traditional ESN. The analytical results of network characteristics also reveal that the MGS associated graph has small-world feature, while the NARMA associated graph has both small-world and scale-free property.

articleTitle: UCAVs online collaborative path planning method based on dynamic task allocation
abstract: In order to minimize the UCAVs loss cost and maximize targets damage value, with the combination of task allocation and collaborative path planning, the online collaborative path planning method based on dynamic task allocation is presented. At first, collaborative path planning method based on task allocation is regarded as two synchronous relevant optimization problems by using layered strategy. Then Chaotic Local Search Grey Wolf Optimization algorithm is proposed to optimize online collaborative path planning method based on dynamic task allocation. In order to improve the planning efficiency, the initializing strategy based on solution space is proposed. The simulation results for four time slices show that the proposed method is feasible.

Author Keywords: chaotic local search grey wolf optimization

articleTitle: Distributed Variance-Constrained Filtering for Time-Varying Systems with Multiplicative Noises and Randomly Occurring Nonlinearities over Sensor Networks
abstract: This paper is concerned with distributed variance-constrained filtering problem for a class of time-varying systems and multiplicative noises and randomly occurring nonlinearities. The target plant is disturbed by the multiplicative noises as well as additive noises. By fully taking the network topology structure into account, the available measurements collected by each sensor node and its adjacent sensor node are used when designing the recursive filter. Attention is focused on the design of a distributed variance-constrained filtering algorithm such that, in the simultaneous presence of multiplicative noises and randomly occurring nonlinearities, an upper bound of the filtering error covariance is obtained in terms of the solutions to two Riccati-like difference equations. Furthermore, the filter parameters are designed to minimize the obtained upper bound by utilizing a novel matrix simplification technique. Finally, a numerical simulation is utilized to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed distributed filtering scheme.

articleTitle: A robust method of fusing ultra-wideband range measurements with odometry for wheeled robot state estimation in indoor environment
abstract: The Global Positioning System (GPS) is a popular satellite-based positioning system which provides world-wide coverage to allow us obtain precise position information in outdoor environment. Today, the number of applications which relay on indoor state estimation is rapidly increasing. Ultra-Wideband (UWB) technology provides a substitution in indoor environment due to its several advantages such as low-cost, high-precision, easy-deployment. However, it can't provides information of orientation. Wheel encoder is a common device that converts wheel's angular motion to a digital signal. With this signal, robot's posture can be easily calculated by odometry in it. This paper describes a method using Particle Filter for fusing UWB range measurements with odometry to acquire a real-time posture estimation of a wheeled robot in indoor environment. We improved the firmware of UWB devices and trilateration algorithm for higher measuring stability when in the presence of obstacles. Performance is experimentally investigated in several scenarios and static positioning accuracy is ±5 cm, dynamic positioning accuracy is ±10 cm.

articleTitle: Robust attitude control for quadrotor UAV system with two kinds of disturbances
abstract: This paper develops a robust attitude control method for a quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), which considers two kinds of disturbances. Firstly, a nonsingular terminal sliding mode observer is presented, which is aimed to observe the derivative of three attitude angles of the UAV system. At the same time, the compensation and suppression of the matched disturbance are included in this observer. Secondly, a sliding mode controller based on the observer results is designed as the control strategy. Thirdly, considering the influence of mismatched disturbance, a disturbance observer based on sliding mode control method is given to deal with the problem of the mismatched disturbance. Finally, the feasibility and stability of the proposed method are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Consensus of first-order multi-agent systems based on cooperation and competition
abstract: This paper studies the consensus of multiple single integrators with a leader, where the interaction graph is not necessarily nonnegative and is not necessarily structurally balanced. By matrix analysis, some sufficient conditions for consensus are established. It is shown that consensus can be reached if the interaction graph among followers and the weights for the edges connecting the leader and followers satisfy some inequalities. Some other results are also revealed. For example, if the interaction graph has some negative weights, then having a spanning tree is just a necessary condition but not a sufficient condition for consensus. Simulation examples are further provided to explain the effectiveness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Virtual implementation of radar full pulse description word for battlefield electromagnetic environment
abstract: In view of the problem that the current electromagnetic environment platform is not able to provide the real signal source for electronic reconnaissance, in this paper the complex electromagnetic environment faced by modern warfare is analyzed, and design the electromagnetic environment platform which can provide an approximate real environment for cognitive reconnaissance. Based on the signal feature modeling and the calculation of the feature parameters, the platform can obtain the approximate radar pulse data, and through the data fusion and coding, can get the approximate battlefield electromagnetic environment data, and show the data through the chart. The data can be more effectively applied to the process of modern radar reconnaissance signal processing, and provide a more realistic platform for the modern war in the cognitive reconnaissance. Experiments show that the generated data has the better similarity as the real battlefield data, and can provide the data source for the signal processing.

articleTitle: Simulation study on leakage current of metal zinc oxide arrester
abstract: The core element of Metal zinc oxide arrester is a zinc oxide resistance. By establishing equivalent circuit of zinc oxide resistance and using simulation software of EMTP, this paper simulated leakage current of Metal zinc oxide arrester. And we analyze the impact of arrester ageing on leakage current measurement under the steady state. The simulation results show the measurement should first estimate equivalent impedance value of the arrester, and then select the appropriate resistance to match in order to avoid measurement errors.

articleTitle: Optimal control of aircraft landing gear state feedback based on magneto rheological damper
abstract: The landing gear cushion Controller is one of the important parts of the aircraft undercarriage, and its performance directly affects the safety of aircraft landing. the dynamics model of landing gear cushion system based on magneto rheological fluid is established. The optimal control algorithm based on state feedback is introduced and the optimal control algorithm based on state feedback is used to simulate the landing gear cushioning system in this work. The simulation results show that the optimal control based on state feedback can effectively absorb the impact load energy.

articleTitle: The shared steering controller inspired by the neuromuscular system of drivers
abstract: The steering model of driver is very important for study man-machine shared driving and that neuromuscular system is an important part of driver's steering model. This paper proposed a steering controller for imitating driver's neuromuscular system, which describes characteristics of neuromuscular system. For example, we describing steering force of driver as a result of combination of actuation regulator and impedance regulator. Actuation regulator describes exerting forces on steering wheel, impedance regulator imitates the muscle contraction to against external force disturbances. Afterwards, based on anthropomorphic steering controller model, we further explain its promising application in man-machine shared driving because of improving the safety of shared driving and reducing the risk of lane departure caused by driver. At last, we simulated double lane change test to validate the performance of ADRC controller through set up corresponding models of controller and neuromuscular system in MATLAB and built vehicle model in CarSim. The next work we will do some experiments on driving simulator to evaluate the real-time performance of the controller.

articleTitle: Consensus-Based control for unmanned aerial vehicle formation with speed adaptability
abstract: This paper presents a distributed control method based on consistency control for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) formation flight in three-dimensional space. Aiming at leader-follower model, an elastic distance vector is designed based on the positional relation between the leader and followers and the instantaneous velocity of UAV, which gives the formation speed adaptability. What's more, a consensus control protocol including communication gain and feedback gain is proposed for the formation. Simulation results verify the correctness and validity of the given controller and show the feasibility and operability of the elastic formation method.

articleTitle: A Method of TOA Positioning for Mine to Effectively Reduce the Impact of Non - Line of Sight Error propagation
abstract: In order to improve the positioning accuracy of time of arrival (TOA) in mine and analyse the main factors of positioning error of TOA, a method of TOA positioning for mine to effectively reduce the impact of non - line of sight (NLOS) error propagation is proposed based on the effective suppression of synchronization delay and timing error by symmetrical double-sided two way ranging (SDS-TWR). Firstly, the Kalman filter is used to eliminate the random NLOS delay caused by locomotives and other irregular devices. Then the parameter fitting method and geometric method are used to restrain the errors caused by the fixed NLOS delay in the locating area. The MATLAB simulation results show that the proposed method has a significant inhibitory effect on TOA positioning error and improves the accuracy of TOA positioning in the mine.

articleTitle: Quantitatively computational controllability of complex networks
abstract: At present, people are paying more attention to exploring the ultimate goal of complex networks, that is, how to control complex networks, while the existing research on complex networks is qualitative. In this paper, a new problem of quantification controllability for complex networks is discussed. We obtain a controllability quantitative index by using the condition number of controllability matrix and control centrality of complex networks. The effect of this index is observed and discussed by a series of simulations on various types of complex networks, namely ER networks, WS small-world networks, and BA scale-free networks. The results show that the performance index can truly reflect the controllability of the complex networks.

articleTitle: Containment control for multiple underactuated surface vessels systems
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the formation control problems and the containment control problems for the multiple underactuated surface vessels. To deal with the coupling of unactuated and actuated states, we adopt a state transformation method to convert the nonlinear system into a linear one. We propose the expression of the leader vessels' formation controller and the followers' containment controller. Besides, two theorems are given to prove the stability of the closed loop system. Then, input transformation is used to get the actual controller for the system. Finally, we give a simulation example, and the results show the effectiveness of our theories.

articleTitle: A novel data fusion algorithm for multivariate time series
abstract: In this paper, a novel fusion data algorithm is proposed. In the method, multi-lead ECG signals are appropriately converted to a single-lead physiological signal via the idea of the local weighted linear prediction algorithm. Experimental results indicate that the algorithm can obtain desirable results on synthetic ECG signals.

articleTitle: Improvements and comments on "New admissibility conditions for singular linear continuous-time fractional-order systems"
abstract: In the above paper, it is claimed that the necessary and sufficient conditions for the static output feedback controller of fractional order singular systems are given in terms of linear matrix inequalities(LMIs). In this note, numerical examples are presented to show that both the necessary and the sufficient conditions of Theorem 3 given in [1] are incorrect. Besides, the the example in Section 4.2 of [1] constructed to support Theorem 3 is also wrong since it does not satisfy the assumption condition KC = sin(θ)/γ G asserted and misused by the authors of [1]. A novel and solid improvement of static output feedback controller design is presented for the closed-loop fractional order singular systems to be admissible. Numerical examples are given to illustrate the proposed approaches.

articleTitle: Distributed fusion incremental Kalman filter
abstract: In the actual application process, the impact of the surrounding environment, the error of the observation device, and the improper parameter selection usually yield the system error. The incremental Kalman filter can effectively solve the state estimation problem for the systems under poor observation condition. In this paper, a distributed fusion incremental Kalman filtering algorithm is presented, which can eliminate the unknown system errors and improve the accuracy of state estimators for the multi-sensor systems under poor observation condition. It is simple in form and easy to be applied in engineering practice. The simulation results show its effectiveness and feasibility.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of multi-stage gate operation in container terminals
abstract: With the rapid increase of container terminal throughput and the number of vehicles entering and leaving the port, the traditional gate with manual operation mode has become the bottleneck restricting the development of container terminal throughput. The operating characteristics of traditional single-stage gate have been analyzed in this paper, the front gate with channel distribution rules has been set to shunt the container truck, then the multi-stage gate has been established. In addition, the simulation models of single-stage gate and multi-stage gate are established respectively by Plant Simulation. At last, through the statistical analysis of the number of vehicles passing through the gate and waiting time of vehicles queuing at the gate, it is concluded that the configuration of the multi-stage gate can reduce waiting time of vehicles lining at the gate and improve the efficiency of the gate.

articleTitle: Some relations between unscented and cubature kalman filters
abstract: The unscented Kalman filter (UKF) and the cubature Kalman filter (CKF) are the popular nonlinear Gaussian sigma point filters. UKF propagates the sigma points by function evaluations using the unscented transformation (UT) and it is at first glance very different from CKF which is based on the spherical-radial cubature rule. In this paper, some relations between UKF and CKF are analyzed from the perspective of Mahalanobis distance ellipsoid. Two examples are given to demonstrate why UKF and CKF can achieve nearly the same accuracy.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Event-Triggered Consensus Based on Distributed State Observer
abstract: In this paper, an event-triggered mechanism based on distributed state observer is proposed for multi-agent systems. For the first-order integrated multi-agent systems, the state observer dynamic model of the system state is given. The system controller and event-triggered condition are designed respectively by using the observed states. By constructing a suitable Lyapunov function, the convergence and stability of the system are proved. Simulation examples are used to verify the feasibility of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: The determination of fixed controllable subspace in complex networks
abstract: In general, a controllable subspace of complex networks consists of the non-fixed part and the fixed part. The non-fixed part changes with non-zero elements in the system matrices. The fixed part consists of all state vertices that can be controlled by any parameter in the controllable subspace, and is called a fixed controllable subspace. The fixed controllable subspace is considered as a stable and controllable part of the system. Actually, the fixed controllable subspace is a subspace of a state space with general properties, which can be controlled and is not affected by the change of parameters. In this paper, we show that the subspace of complex network is controllable when almost all of the parameters are free. This paper introduces the notion of fixed controllable subspace and applies it to the study of structural controllability. A few characteristics of the fixed controllable subspace are also derived by using the graph theory. In addition, we explore how the fixed part can be determined by using the well-known result of Hosoe's controllable subspace theory.

articleTitle: The modified RRT-based cooperative searching for human and UAV
abstract: In the disaster rescue scene, due to the limited capabilities of UAVs, many relief operations that mere UAVs are not enough to deal with. This paper presents a human and UAV cooperative area search planning framework to help people and UAV share information during disaster search process and collaboratively plan the path of UAV. In order to minimize the uncertain environment in the search area, an improved algorithm based on Rapidly-exploring Random Tree (RRT) is proposed for UAV area search through the introduction of environmental uncertainty information. The Bayesian estimation is introduced into the UAV module for inferring the goal area that human plans to search. By combining the inferred human goal with a modified RRT-based algorithm, the UAV is able to intelligently design search path to assistant human in seeking the goal area while observing the district that human cannot reach. Simulation results demonstrate that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Research on evacuation control of panic crowds
abstract: Considering the behavioral characteristics of panic crowds, the macro mathematical model of the crowds in the corridor has been constructed based on LWR and Pipes-Munjal models. Obtained model in macro scale that is described using partial differential equations is discretized into finite ordinary differential equations through dividing the corridors into finite sections. Feedback controllers based on feedback linearization have been used in control of panic crowds and stability of the system has been guaranteed no matter the bounded speed of crowds is large or not. Simulation experiments based on Matlab have been conducted to show change of density or speed respect to time, which verifies the rationality and validity of the control.

articleTitle: A method to extend TOPSIS for decision-making problems with interval weight
abstract: In some cases, determining precisely the exact value of the weight is difficult and their values are considered as interval numbers. Therefore, in this paper, we extend the TOPSIS method for solving multiple attribute decision- making problems with interval weight. Firstly, the evaluation on each alternative and the weight of attribute are given as interval numbers. Then, based on the proposed interval t-norm, the original interval decision matrix and interval weight are merged into interval weighted decision matrix. Next, the ranking result of the alternatives is obtained by TOPSIS method. Finally, an example is given to highlight the procedure of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Adaptive output feedback control for nonlinear systems with input delay and disturbances
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the adaptive output feedback control for a class of nonlinear systems with input delay and disturbances. A neural network (NN) observer is designed to estimate the unmeasurable states. Besides, we also develop an auxiliary system to compensate for the effect of the input delay. By the aid of adaptive backstepping technique, an adaptive controller is designed which can guarantee the boundedness of all the signals in the closed-loop systems. Finally, a numerical example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Consensus of fractional-order multi-agent systems via LMI approach
abstract: This paper investigates the consensus control problem of linear and nonlinear multi-agent systems, where the dynamics of each agent is represented by a fractional-order differential equation, respectively. By using the fractional Lyapunov direct method and matrix theory, some sufficient conditions are presented to ensure that the states of the followers can asymptotically converge to the leader, and the feedback matrix of the proposed protocol is also determined according to linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) formulation. A simulation example is provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the obtained theoretical results.

articleTitle: Adaptive Sliding Mode Control for Distributed Control Systems with Mismatched Uncertainty
abstract: Adaptive-based sliding mode control scheme is developed to solve the problem of mismatched uncertainty that exists in communication channels and external disturbance for a class of distributed large-scale systems. A linear sliding manifold is adopted to guarantee asymptotic stability of each subsystems and achieve the global robustness. Meanwhile, by adjusting the parameters estimation of adjustable gains via proposed adaptive scheme, the upper bound of the unknown uncertainty can be obtained. Then an distributed adaptive sliding mode controller is designed combining with the relative information of neighboring subsystems. It is shown that the presented controller has the capability to achieve the asymptotic stability of each closed-loop subsystems via Lyapunov theory. Finally, a simulation example applied to a network of two quad-rotor dynamical systems is given to exhibit the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Distributed finite-time tracking algorithm for multiple uncertain Euler-Lagrange systems based on backstepping technique
abstract: Based on the backstepping method, this paper investigates the distributed finite-time tracking control problem for Euler-Lagrange systems under directed graph. We consider that only some of the followers can receive information of the dynamic leader. There exist system parametric uncertainties which can be linearized while parameter-linearity property is used to approximate the uncertainties. Backstepping method and Lyapunov stability theory are utilized to prove that the tracking errors and adaptive estimation errors are bounded. Further, the finite-time convergence property of the tracking errors is proved by increasing control gains. Numerical simulations are provided to show the effectiveness of the proposed control algorithm.

articleTitle: Exact order reduction for fornasini-marchesini state-space models based on real eigenvalues
abstract: In this paper, an exact order reduction approach based on real eigenvalues will be proposed for the Fornasini- Marchesini state-space model of multidimensional (ra-D) systems. Specifically, earlier results on the connection between eigenvalues and reducibility are generalized and applied to the exact order reduction for Fornasini-Marchesini state-space models. Moreover, corresponding examples are given to illustrate the details as well as the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Improved adaptive backstepping sliding mode control for multi-machine system with TCSC
abstract: For the multi-machine power system with TCSC, the TCSC controller is designed by using the improved backstepping method, adaptive control and sliding mode control under the condition of the uncertainty of damping coefficient and external interference. In the design process, the k-class function is introduced to improve the backstepping method. For the external interference, we use the adaptive control to design the adaptive estimation law for the upper bound of the interference, and add to the sliding mode term to suppress the interference. Finally, the simulation results show that the TCSC controller can quickly suppress the oscillation and ensure the transient stability of the multi-machine power system.

articleTitle: Self-tuning reduced-order Kalman smoother for the descriptor system
abstract: For the linear stochastic descriptor system with uncorrelated noises, the self-tuning reduced-order smoothing problem is solved, when the noise variances of the process noise and measurement noise are unknown. The consistent estimates of these unknown noise variances are obtained by applying the correlation method, and the optimal Kalman reduced-order smoother is obtained based on the singular value decomposition method and the classical Kalman filtering theory. Then substituting these consistent estimates of unknown noise variances into the optimal reduced-order Kalman smoother yields the self-tuning reduced-order smoother and the smoothing error variance. A example of singular system verifies the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Pedestrian detection algorithm based on integral channel features
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy, real-time and robustness of pedestrian video detection, this paper presents an improved fast multiscale pedestrian detection algorithm based on integral channel features. The captured video is pretreated which is transformed RGB image into LUV image, and then the image pyramid is calculated to obtain the channel features at different scales. The improved fast image pyramid algorithm is used to estimate the other layer features of the pyramid. Traversing all the pyramid image by the sliding window to extract features. Finally, the features are input into the trained cascade AdaBoost classifier to find the most representative pedestrian characteristics. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm in this paper can detect pedestrians accurately and meet the requirements of good accuracy, real-time and robustness with different posture and the variety of complex backgrounds.

articleTitle: Finite time control for generic hypersonic vehicle
abstract: A nonlinear finite time sliding mode control (FTSMC) for generic hypersonic vehicle (GHV) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a control-oriented model of GHV is introduced for sake of simplicity. Secondly, Finite time controllers for velocity and altitude subsystems are designed independently by sliding mode theory to achieve tracking of velocity and altitude trajectories. Total disturbances including parametric perturbations, nonlinear dynamics and external disturbances in GHV model are estimated by utilizing finite time disturbance observer (FTDO) method. Chattering problem in sliding mode is settled by using a smooth approximate function. Finally, numerical simulations are provided to show that the proposed composite control scheme allows an excellent tracking performance.

articleTitle: The study on optimization model of emergency resource migration cost in multi-cycle
abstract: The study builds an optimization model to analyze the emergency resource migration cost constraint problem in multi-cycle. The environment periodic variation is common phenomenon in the actual supply network. However, the traditional model set the supply network as constant. And the facility setup and migration cost constraints have not been considered in model. It is required to add the migration cost constraint into the model with the time variation. This paper improves the traditional RANPCP (r-all-neighbor p-center problem) model by taking the dynamic supply environment change into account. The proposed model defines the new objective function and constraint condition of key facility migration cost. The study uses the Simulated Annealing algorithm to solve the improved model. The numerical example is given to verify the feasibility of the proposed method. The result suggests that has more realistic significance and the research value.

articleTitle: Non-fragile H∞ filtering for Markov jump systems with incomplete transition probabilities and intermittent measurements
