In this study, the complex Morlet wavelet (CMW) is adopted to extract possible harmonic waves existing in the power signal to a concerned alternative current motor, based on which an instantaneous amplitude identification approach is carried out to estimate the amplitudes of harmonic components. Numerical simulations are included to demonstrate the advantages of the suggested approach, and comparisons are also done with respect to those under the Fourier transform and other conventional algorithms.

articleTitle: Self-tuning Full-order Kalman Smoothers for Singular System
abstract: For the singular system with unknown correlated noise variances, the self-tuning full-order Kalman smoother and the smoothing error variance matrix are presented, based on the maxinum likelihood (ML) linear estimation criterion. Applying augmented state method, the optimal full-order Kalman smoother is obtained, according to smoother's relationship with the filter. The fused estimates of these unknown correlated noise variances and cross-variances can be obtained by the correlation function method. Substituting these estimates into the full-order smoother yields the self-tuning full-order smoother. The convergence of the self-tuning full-order is proved by the dynamic error variance analysis (DEVA) method. A simulation example of a singular system verifies its effectiveness of the self-tuning Kalman smoother.

articleTitle: Damage identification method of carbon fiber reinforced polymer structure based on ReliefF and LSSVM
abstract: The damage identification method of carbon fiber reinforced polymer structure is of great significance for the timely detection of structural invisible damage and the avoidance of catastrophic consequences. The damage identification method of composite materials based on ReliefF and LSSVM was researched in this paper. Firstly, the damage signals of composite structure were obtained by using non damage active excitation method. Then, Fourier transform is used to extract the damage feature and reduce the feature dimension by ReliefF. On the basis of this, the damage identification model based on LSSVM was established by taking the damage feature as input and the damage mode as output. The experimental results showed that for the 20 test, the correct recognition time was 19 times, which showed higher damage identification accuracy. This paper provides a feasible method for damage identification of composite structures.

articleTitle: Research on fast recognizing ball method based on multisensor data fusion in robotic game
abstract: In order to solve the puzzle of fast recognizing target ball in the environment of autonomous basketball robot game, the paper proposed a new method of fast recognizing target ball based on multi-sensor data fusion. In the paper, it researched on the criterion of correctly recognizing target ball, on the one hand, it obtained the approximate direction angle α of a single ball by using the visual camera, and on the other hand, it acquired the direction angle β and distance d of some balls by using a 2-D scanning laser range finder in its measured range, if the absolute value of the difference between α and β is within the setting range, the ball is the target ball collectively identified by both the visual camera and 2-D scanning laser range finder. Under the condition of laboratory, the basketball robot game environment has been built, the actual experiment results testified the feasibility and validity of the method. The experimental results show that the proposed method can obtain better effect of correct recognizing ball.

articleTitle: Observer-based additive H∞ control for a class of uncertain time-delay sampled-data system
abstract: The problem of additive H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> control for a class of uncertain sampled-data systems with time-delay is considered via observer-based state feedback control. According to the case that there exist uncertainties not only in the plant, but also in controller gains and observer gains, and in terms of the Lyapunov function theory and linear matrix inequality (LMI) approach, a sufficient condition on the existence and designing method of non-fragile observer and additive H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> controller are derived. Finally, a numerical example is illustrated to show the effectiveness of the proposed results.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis and isolation in complex dynamical networks with uncertainties
abstract: Fault diagnosis and isolation is necessary in obtaining reliable and stable operations of complex dynamical networks. This paper presents a novel fault detection and isolation (FDI) method for complex dynamic networks with uncertainties. In the proposed FDI architecture, a fault detection estimator (FDE) and a bank of fault isolation estimators (FIEs) are designed for fault diagnosis and isolation in each local subsystem. When a fault is detected by the FDE in one subsystem, the corresponding FIEs are activated to figure out which type of fault is taking place in the subsystem. It is effective to monitor changes in complex dynamical networks with uncertainties for fault diagnosis and isolation. In addition, some numerical simulations are done to illustrate the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Analysis of the influence of tourism on ancient buildings—Taking Ningxia tourism as an example
abstract: As a solidified art, architecture is carrying a lot of rich historical information. The protection of ancient buildings has always been an important work in the protection of cultural relics. In recent years, with the rapid development of tourism, the impact on ancient buildings is more serious. The ancient buildings were damaged and damaged. This is the same as the ancient buildings in Ningxia, and more and more ancient buildings are destroyed. Through the actual investigation, the impact of tourism on ancient buildings is analyzed, and effective measures for protecting ancient buildings are put forward.

articleTitle: Research on application of valuation method for electric power engineering list
abstract: The project budget quota valuation model is adopted in the construction project of our country, before the list valuation mode is not popularized. In 2003, "the unity of quantity and price" in the past turns into "the separation of quantity price "after the mode is used in the field of construction, providing the mode of just, fair competition and becoming popular in the majority of the construction field. The quantities bill valuation of electric power construction engineering is the inevitable result of mercerization of electric power construction, and is also the important measure which deepens the reform of electric power project pricing mode. Therefore, how to push the model by bill in electric power construction engineering has become one of the important subjects about the reform of pricing mode of the electric power industry now.

articleTitle: Two indirect adaptive fuzzy sliding mode control of three-phase active power filter under different conditions
abstract: In this paper, two indirect adaptive fuzzy sliding mode control methods are proposed for the current tracking control of active power filter in view of the influence of the parameter perturbation and the unknown disturbance. In the first scheme, a fuzzy system is used to approximate the unknown dynamics in order to eliminate the dependence on the prior knowledge, and another fuzzy system is used to replace the switching control term to reduce the chattering phenomenon. In the second scheme, based on feedback linearization idea, sliding mode controller for active power filter is designed first. Then the fuzzy systems are used to approximate unknown nonlinear functions and the lumped uncertainty which weaken the dependence on mathematical model of the system, effectively improving the system robustness. In the two schemes, the compensation control term is designed based on the fuzzy approximation error estimation, which ensures the tracking performance of the closed loop system. Simulation studies in the MATLAB/SimPower Systems Toolbox demonstrate that the proposed control methods offer a good behavior in both steady state and transient operation during balanced and unbalanced load.

articleTitle: H∞ consensus for multi-agent systems with restricted frequency-domain specifications
abstract: This paper considers the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> consensus problem with restricted frequency-domain specifications (RFDs) of multi-agent systems. Using a linear transformation, the consensus problem is first transformed into a partial stability problem of a reduced dimensional system. Then the sufficient and necessary conditions are given for H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> consensus with RFDs in directed networks, subject to parameter uncertainties and external disturbances. Moreover, the state feedback controller gain is achieved by a alternating iteration algorithm. A numerical example is presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Compressed identification by sparse sampled frequency data
abstract: This paper considers the identification of a rational transfer function with sparse representation in pairs of FIR and Takenaka-Malmquist (TM) bases and from random sampled linear frequency-domain measurements. We firstly prove the uniqueness of the sparse representation of the transfer function represented in concatenated FIR and TM basis functions. Then we propose to reconstruct the unique representation coefficient vector by ℓ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> minimization with sparse sampled frequency data on the upper unit circle. The simulations verify that the concatenated FIR and TM bases in the proposed identification framework can obtain a much sparser reconstruction with lower reconstruction order even with incomplete information of the system poles.

articleTitle: On the crowdsourcing-based radio map construction with noisy location labels
abstract: In order to reduce the overheads of constructing a dense radio map as well as to prevent the accuracy degradation, various crowdsourcing-based methods have been developed to automatically collect WiFi RSS measurements to build the radio map. Unlike existing studies focusing on crowdsourcing techniques, this paper deals with how to efficiently and accurately produce the radio map based on crowdsourcing RSS measurements which suffer from noisy location labels. In the literature, gaussian process regression (GPR) is commonly adopted to construct radio maps by sufficiently making use of the spatial correlation among received signal strength (RSS) measurements at nearby locations. However, the standard GPR does not take into account the uncertainties in the location labels attached to the crowdsourcing RSS measurements, which consequently deteriorates the performance of localization systems relying on the corresponding radio maps. Hence, the standard GPR is extended to mitigate the influences of noisy location labels. Experiments are carried out based on practical RSS measurements, and confirm the feasibility and superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The vectorization research of military map base on micro variation chaos genetic algorithm
abstract: Aiming at the research of military map vectorization, the vectorization method of military map based on micro variation chaos genetic algorithm is designed. The modificatory operations of new individuals are added after new individuals were produced, and the fitness can be improved by the operations. The adaptive crossover probability and adaptive mutation probability are proposed, which consider the influence of every generation to algorithm and the effect of different individual fitness in every generation. The results of experiment research show the effectiveness of the proposed method through that traditional algorithm compares with adaptive genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: New exact solutions for the generalized Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation
abstract: In this paper, with symbolic computation, the generalized Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation which describes the fluctuations of the position of a flame front, the motion of a fluid going down a vertical wall, or a spatially uniform oscillating chemical reaction in a homogeneous medium, is studied via the extended tanh-function method. By virtue of the extended tanh-function method, new exact solutions of this equation are presented. The restrictions on the parameters are also identified. It is shown that the extended tanh-function method is a competent and influential tool in solving nonlinear partial differential equations in mathematical physics.

articleTitle: Study of Direct Air-Cooled Condenser for Variable Working Characteristics Based on the Simulation Model
abstract: Based on the condensation heat transfer mechanism of the direct air-cooled condenser, the dynamic simulation model is established through reasonable system decomposition and simplification. Taking one 200MW unit as an example, the unit's cold end system characteristic curves were drawn, by considering various conditions, including the forced velocity of air, the air temperature, scale thermoresistance in pipe and condenser heat load. The result indicates that the analysis based on the simulation model has enough precision and practicability. It has great value in guiding operation of direct air-cooled units.

Author Keywords: Simulation Model and Variable Working Characteristic

articleTitle: Research Progress and Strategy on Stand-alone DC Micro-grid with Multi-sources and Multi-loads
abstract: Compared to AC micro-grid, DC micro-grid has some advantages in improving power quality, decreasing energy consumption and other cost. Firstly, DC micro-grid with multi-sources and multi-loads are put forward. Secondly, its energy management and coordinated control structure are studied. Lastly, we focus on hybrid energy storage system (HESS), especially the HESS topology.

articleTitle: Decision making approaches for online auction with a permanent buyout option
abstract: In this paper we consider a two-bidder English internet auction with permanent buyout option. We propose a new model based on focus points to illustrate the decision making procedure of the seller and bidders. Different people are described by different types of focus points. Under each type of focus points, we obtain the optimal strategy of the bidders during an online auction with buyout price, we state the necessity of providing buyout option and suggest the buyout price for the seller to increase revenues. It is a new method for solving online auctions problem which fits the real decision procedure of human being intuitively.

articleTitle: Bilateral contour descriptor and manifold learning based fault diagnosis for non-periodic vibrating equipments on ships
abstract: In this paper, the bilateral contour descriptor and the nonlinear manifold learning were presented for fault diagnosis of non-periodic vibrating equipments on ships. The fault diagnosis for periodic or rotating equipments was researched widely. There were also many non-periodic and non-rotating equipments on ships. Due to the unreasonable description and the redundant signal, it was difficult to diagnose fault of non-periodic and non-rotating equipments. The bilateral contour descriptor was presented to describe the reasonable feature of the non-periodic and non-rotating equipments. The bilateral contour descriptor fused the spatial position information, the feature weight and the difference resulted by the sensor distribution. Then the original high-dimensional feature data was handled by the nonlinear manifold learning. The lower-dimensional description of the original vibration feature showed the intrinsic characteristic of the non-periodic and non-rotating equipments. In the end, the accurate results of fault diagnosis was obtained for the non-periodic and non-rotating equipments.

articleTitle: Study on plant-wide optimization based on interval number for gold hydrometallurgical process
abstract: Considering the difficulty of accurate online-measurement of some key variables in hydrometallurgy plant-wide production process, which leads to process modeling difficult and optimization control based on conventional plant-wide optimization methods is difficult to realize, it is very necessary to establish an accurate plant-wide optimization model of the gold hydrometallurgical process. A plant-wide optimization method based on interval number is proposed for realizing the gold hydrometallurgy plant-wide process modelling and optimization in this paper. By using interval numbers to replace the key variables that cannot be measured, the established plant-wide optimization model can further satisfy with practical productive process. Furthermore, considering the optimization solution based on non-linear mechanism model is very time-consuming, a back propagation neural network is constructed and used to represent the local procedures models in this paper. Finally, a second-order oscillation partical swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm with high gloval convergence is used to solve the optimization problems. Simulation results indicate that the proposed model has a better optimization performance in gold hydrometallurgical process.

articleTitle: Research on wavelet neural network decoupling control of variable-air-volume air-conditioning system
abstract: Variable-Air-Volume Air-Conditioning System (VAV system) is a multi-input and multi-output system. It has multi-variable and nonlinear characteristics, and is coupling between each loop. The coupling exists in each loop so that the control is interfered each other and system stability is affected. Decoupling control technology based on the WNN (wavelet neural network) was used to eliminate the coupling between the temperature control loop and humidity control loop in a VAV system. Its operation condition shows that the decoupling control based on the WNN is feasible to the decoupling control of the two loops in a VAV air-conditioning system.

articleTitle: Fault reconstruction for stochastic distribution system with time-delay
abstract: A new robust fault reconstruction is proposed for stochastic distribution system with additive fault and time-delay, which can effectively achieve the estimation of states and disturbance simultaneously, as well as fault reconstruction. In this framework, an augmented system is firstly constructed by using coordinate transformation and forming an augmented state with system states and disturbance. Next, a robust descriptor observer is designed to simultaneously estimate the states and the disturbance. And then, a sliding mode scheme is used for the designed observer so that the additive fault can be reconstructed. Finally, a numerical simulation showed the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: On minimum time equilibrium targeting in epidemic diseases
abstract: This paper presents a time-optimal vaccination control strategy for epidemic models. A minimum time vaccination control is generated from an "a priori" constant value plus an incremental value obtained from the minimization of the Hamiltonian associated with a minimum time loss function. The targeted state final value is defined as a certain accuracy closed ball around some point being a reasonable approximate measure of both disease-free equilibrium points associated with the two vaccination levels used for the optimal- time control.

articleTitle: Prescribed performance control of the fractional-order chaotic economical system with external disturbances
abstract: This paper presents a control method which is capable of guaranteeing prescribed performance bounds for a class of fractional-order chaotic economical system with external disturbances by means of the fractional-order control method. By prescribed performance bounds, we mean that tracking error should converge to a predefined arbitrarily small set, with convergence rate no more than a prescribed value. The main idea is to transform the original constrained system into an equivalent one via an appropriately defined output error transformation. A fractional-order controller which can guarantee the prescribed performance of the tracking error is proposed for fractional-order chaotic economical systems. Finally, an illustrative simulation result is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: A new sliding mode tracking guidance based on three-dimensional trajectory
abstract: With multiple path constraints taken into consideration during hypersonic glide phase, a new sliding mode tracking guidance based on three-dimensional trajectory is proposed. Firstly, on the basis of entry vehicle dynamics and geometrical transformation, the dynamics formulation of crossrange parameter is derived. Therefore, a nonlinear guidance model composed of crossrange parameter and flight path angle is formed. Secondly, with the aid of feedback linearization technology, the nonlinear dynamics equations are converted into linear ones. Later, in order to track the reference states well, two sliding mode controllers are introduced based on the linear model and the stability of guidance system is proofed. At last, CAV-H model is utilized to validate the robustness of proposed guidance.

articleTitle: Design of water level control system high pressure heater in power plant based on Honeywell TPS
abstract: The high pressure (HP) heater system is an important part of the circulating water treatment system in the power generating units, whose role is to extract the steam with high temperature and high pressure exhausted from the turbine to heat the water supply of desecrator. The running state of HP heater system has a direct impact on the power generation unit. Based on the industrial automation control features of distributed control system (DCS), the water level control system of HP heater in the power plant by using an integrated and rapid safety industrial controllable network (Honeywell TPS) is designed, where the fieldbus, human machine interface and industrial control system are integrated together. Then the actual operation experiments on HP heater system with the proposed water level control scheme are carried out. Through the observation of water level curves, the design scheme makes the stability of the high water level improved greatly.

articleTitle: Based on bridge detection UAV's path planning and analysis of wind field under bridge based on bridge detection
abstract: In this paper, a full-coverage path planning method is designed for bridge detection based on element decomposition in view of the high cost and long cycle of traditional bridge detection methods and the high safety risk of operators. We firstly analyze the wind field under the bridge and obtain the maximum wind speed that makes the UAV fly safely under the bridge. Secondly, the environment model of the bridge bottom is built using the grid method and the corresponding attributes for grids is given. Then the search space is decomposed into multiple sub-regions by the unit decomposition method, and the sub-regions are covered and traversed by the two-point method and the binary tree search strategy. Finally, simulated experiment is implemented. The results show that the bridge detection UAV can realize the full coverage traversal of the bridge bottom.

articleTitle: Evaluation of rail transit route selection scheme based on fuzzy soft set theory
abstract: Many factors in the evaluation of rail transit route selection scheme are often not able to be quantitatively analyzed due to the large number of factors involved in route selection. A number of factors involve imprecise data and their solution involves the use of mathematical principles based on uncertainty and imprecision. The fuzzy soft set theory is an effective tool to solve uncertain problems. In this paper, we use the fuzzy soft set theory to evaluate the three schemes of partial construction of a city subway route and the evaluation result is consistent with the result of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation.

articleTitle: Emergency response gas emergency intelligent auxiliary information terminal software development based on the android operating system
abstract: At present, the common use of gas provides convenience for people's production and life, but the gas is flammable, explosive, easy to leak, poisoning and other characteristics, making people in the course of the use of certain dangers. From the case of gas accident, we can find many problems exist in China's gas industry, especially in emergency rescue. Although for different levels of accidents, the corresponding emergency plan has been formulated, but there are problems such as poor practical operability, inadequate equipment for repair, unreasonable staff distribution, non-standard and unscientific emergency handling procedures on site. If you can have a smart query manual, according to the accident scene, quickly determine the disposal process, so more efficient and more scientific. This article chooses the representative outdoor steel pipe as an example to illustrate the emergency disposal process and software development process.

articleTitle: Soft sensor of wet ball mill load based on DAMKELM model
abstract: In this paper, a domain adaption multi-kernel extreme learning machine (DAMKELM) is proposed as a novel algorithm, to solve the problem of misalignment of the original measurement model of a wet ball mill in multiple operating conditions. By introducing domain adaption extreme learning machine (DAELM), a small number of labeled samples in the working condition under test are transferred with the original working samples. The kernel method was introduced to construct DAMKELM to solve the problem of insufficient stability caused by the randomness and uncertainty of the extreme learning machine (ELM), which effectively improves the stability and accuracy of the model. The experimental results show that the DAMKELM can effectively solve the problem of misalignment of the original measurement model due to the change of the working condition.

articleTitle: Robust control for super-maneuver flight based on adaptive observer
abstract: A robust control method for super-maneuver flight based on the adaptive observer has been designed in this paper to solve the uncertainty of aerodynamic parameter, external disturbance and model error. The discontinuous projection adaptive law is adopted in the fast and slow loops to online estimate the uncertainty of aerodynamic parameter. The external disturbance and model error are observed and compensated by the adaptive observer which designed by applying the adaptive law in the general observer, and then Lyapunov function is selected to analyze the stability of whole system to obtain final control signal. The digital simulation of super-maneuver flight proves that the controller can effectively resist interference caused by the uncertainty of aerodynamic parameter, external disturbance and model error, and enhance the robustness of the system.

articleTitle: A NSP-based dictionary learning for image fusion
abstract: For the multimodal image fusion, this paper proposes a method of NSP-based and dictionary learning on image fusion. Through Non-subsampled Pyramid(NSP) filter of the image of high and low frequency decomposition, then the high frequency region of sparse representation. Clustering of parts in different images by structural similarity, which mainly composed of over-complete dictionary. Finally, Sparse coefficients are estimated by using simultaneous orthogonal matching tracking algorithm. This method is used on common dictionary learned to represent multimodal images. The experimental results show that the algorithm in the subjective and objective evaluation are raised to some extent.

articleTitle: Robust H∞ controller based on variable gain linear parameter varying and pole assignment of nonholonomic mobile robot trajectory tracking
abstract: A trajectory tracking controller is presented with pole assignment based on robust H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> linear parameter-varying for nonholonomic mobile robot because of it's dynamic uncertainty. This dynamic equation of robot trajectory tracking is obtained by Euler- Lagrange method, which is transformed into linear parameter-varying plant with convex polyhedron structure by the variable gain linear parameter varying and convex decomposition technique. Based on robust control theory and linear matrix inequality theory, the state feedback controller at each vertex of the convex polyhedron is designed. Then, linear parameter varying controller is obtained by using each vertex controller. Simulation results show that robot manipulators have good tracking performance for the joint position change.

articleTitle: Controllability of multi-agent networks based on almost equitable partitions
abstract: Controllability is a fundamental problem in the study of multi-agent systems. In this paper, we consider the controllability of multi-agent networks, where a collection of agents obey the role of leaders, while the rest of the agents enforce local, consistent protocols. Our goal is to determine the concept of graph theory as a reflection of the theoretical properties of such systems. In particular, we expand the controllability graphical to a multi-leader setting by taking advantage of network almost equitable partitions. We do some analysis and discussions about the existing conclusions and point out the limitation of equitable partitioning method in the study of multi-agent controllability. Besides, we found a class of controllable topology structures and presented a concise proof.

articleTitle: Adaptive control algorithm of permanent magnet spherical motor based on neural network
abstract: In order to solve the friction and external interference on the spherical motor performance, reduce the dynamics model modeling error. Based on the structural characteristics of the spherical motor, the dynamic model of spherical motor is established by using <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">xyz</sup> the Euler angle and the Lagrange equation, on this basis, the neural network approximation model is designed to achieve precise control of the spherical motor. The simulation results show that the adaptive control algorithm based on neural network can effectively improve the anti-interference ability of spherical motor, and in the case of large modeling error, it can still guarantee the motion accuracy of the spherical motor.

articleTitle: Design and realization of two-degree-of-freedom light intensity detection and tracking PTZ
abstract: A two-degree-of-freedom light intensity detection and tracking PTZ is designed for light source utilization and light source location tracking. The system uses STC90C52 microcontroller as the control core and it uses BH1750FVI sensor to collect light intensity. It analyzes light intensity data and controls the steering gear Action to locate and track the light source intelligently.

articleTitle: Bus penetration rate estimation of road segment using bus GPS data
abstract: To realize the estimation of bus penetration rate in road segment using bus GPS data, a method is proposed in this paper to estimate bus penetration rate in single signal cycle, according to the bus position at the end of red phase at a signalized intersection. Sum of squares for factor A (SSA) of bus penetration rate and time function in different signal cycle length are selected to characterize the accuracy and real-time quality of the estimation, on the basis, objective function is constructed to find appropriate signal cycle length as the time window. Aiming at the possible abnormal points in single cycle bus penetration rate, quartile method was used to eliminate them. In the end, simulation tests were carried out under different traffic flow and bus penetration rates, the results show that the proposed method in this paper has better performance when traffic flow is higher than 600veh/h, and the bus penetration rate is higher than 5%. On the same time, a field test was conducted in an arterial road of Chongqing, the results show that the estimation method proposed in this paper can estimate the bus penetration rate of road segment effectively.

articleTitle: Search engine advertising optimization strategy based on Ontology and multi-attribute entropy weight fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
abstract: In the web advertising domain, faced with massive advertising data, making advertising optimization strategy has become a huge challenge. Therefore, we propose an ontology-based search engine advertising semantic model, which aims at semantic description of search engine advertising domain knowledge and reuse integration of existing product ontology model. On this basis, put forward Search Engine Optimization Strategy based on multi-attribute entropy weight fuzzy comprehensive evaluation which purpose is refuse the current artificial decision problems. In order to effectively solve the problems faced in the artificial optimization of Internet advertising.

articleTitle: Simulation and experiments of fire for transport aircraft cabin environment control system
abstract: As one of main reason that caused the accident of aircraft, the fire on the plane will be extremely serious, which has been attracted more attention. More and more scholars have carried out deep research on cabin fire. In this paper, the Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) fire-field model based FDS (Fire Dynamics Simulator) was used to simulate changes of the cabin environment control system, and the results were compared with the observation temperature data. The results showed that the experimental temperature transformation was in accordance with the FDS simulation results. And for cabin fire risk assessment had a certain practical reference value. FDS simulation could be implemented when experiment was restricted, and this provided real and effective data for the development of fire in the cargo cabin for aircraft. According to the research in this article, we could get a better understanding of the aircraft cabin fire situation. This would make it better to deal with fire and manage energy better.

articleTitle: Reentry tracking control of hypersonic glider based on Legendre pseudospectral method
abstract: Based on Legendre pseudospectral method for solving the optimal control problem, the tracking control of hypersonic glider is studied. In this paper, the differential form of Legendre pseudo spectral method is used to convert the optimal control problem into a nonlinear programming problem for reentry vehicle tracking. The state quantity and control amount on the LGL node are selected as the parameters to be optimized, and the optimal performance index is selected as to maximize the cross-range. Then the angle of attack in the reentry section is solved. The control rate of a universal hypersonic gliding vehicle (CAV) is calculated. The simulation results show that the proposed method has a certain precision and efficiency. In addition, the simulation process also shows that the Legendre pseudospectral method is not sensitive to the state guessing value, and the algorithm is easy to converge, which is suitable for the solution of the reentry control problem of the aircraft.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of winning decision algorithm in Hex game system
abstract: Hex game is a kind of board game with two players which has the rules that to seek the winner who firstly connect the two boundaries of the board with his own pieces. The decision of winning is the necessary factor of board game, and the effective decision algorithm is the premise to support the whole intelligence level of the game system. Based on the above inference, this article focuses on winning decision process in Hex, and especially for different winning situations to make different strategies. In order to meet the different winning situations, Union-Find Set and Deep-First-Search strategy will be used and hence get a valid algorithm, then, the complexity of algorithm will also be analyzed in the end.

articleTitle: A PM2.5 monitoring system for buildings based on Zigbee and Qt technology
abstract: To realize the real-time monitoring of PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</sub> in building and solve relevant problems such as lack of cognition and poor monitoring, a new type of PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</sub> monitoring system is designed with Zigbee wireless network, embedded technology and Qt technology. This system adopts the Zigbee wireless network module as the core of communication, Arduino UNO embedded development board as a sensor acquisition port and a Modbus slave, using a PC application designed by Qt to receive and process signals. It fully realizes the real-time visualized monitoring of PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</sub> and intelligent actuator control. With the good scalability of the system, users can flexibly monitor other parameters in the air such as formaldehyde concentration, temperature and humidity.

articleTitle: Research on the impact of retailers' online channel on supply chain
abstract: For a Manufacturer who has online direct sales channel, considering the free-riding behavior of consumers, the question of retailers opening the online sales channel was studied in centralized decision making and manufacturers dominated Stackelberg decentralized decision making. Through the theoretical and numerical analysis, following conclusions were obtained. If retailers open online sales channel, the total profit will decrease in centralized decision making. However, in the condition of decentralized decision making, it is favorable for retailers when offline channel has a small basic market share, but it is also favorable for manufacturers when offline channel has a big basic market share. In summary, retailers should better make the decision of opening the online sales channel or not according to the basic market share of the offline channel.

articleTitle: Motion target correlation method based on structural similarity in camera array
abstract: Aiming to solve the problem that there is limited scope of the motion target correlation method based on geometric constraint in camera array, a novel motion target correlation method based on structural similarity is proposed. Firstly, the target segmentation is addressed on low resolution clear target image in subarray by exploiting the Gaussian mixture model (GMM), then pre-correlation is carried out by utilizing the template matching, finally utilizing the target images' brightness, contrast and structure contrast, the correlation of the same target in different camera images is completed based on structural similarity in order to estimate the continuous motion information of the target. Experiments show that our algorithm can effectively accomplish the correlation of the same moving target between single-target and multi-target scene with high robustness.

articleTitle: Approach of linguistic group decision making based on combination weighting 2-tuple linguistic VIKOR
abstract: This paper presented an approach of linguistic group decision-making based on combination weighting 2-tuple linguistic VIKOR. Firstly, the 2-tuple linguistic is used to cope with assessment information of attribute values and weights that represented with linguistic variable. Subjective weights of attribute are calculated by using the weighted averaging operator for 2-tuple linguistic and the objective weights of attribute are determined based on the statistical variance. And subjective weight and objective weight are integrated into combination weight. Then, through the 2-tuple linguistic VIKOR method, the compromise ranking result of alternatives can be determined. Finally, an example analysis is given to illustrate the validity and applicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An improved hybrid algorithm for minimizing energy consumption and cycle time in flexible process planning
abstract: Nowadays, sustainable manufacturing has been recognized as a key technology for advanced manufacturing, and improving energy efficiency of manufacturing system is an important aspect. However, little attention has been paid to the development of flexible process planning (FPP) problem that takes into account the energy consumption. In this paper, an energy-efficient flexible process planning model that incorporates energy consumption and cycle time is proposed. For solving the problem, an improved hybrid algorithm (IHA) based on hormone modulation mechanism is devised to explore the optimal solution. The IHA incorporates a new crossover operation based on the precedence constrain module and a new annealing rate function inspired by hormone modulation mechanism. The IHA tries to overcome the local optimum and further to explore the solution space. Finally, computational experiments were conducted, and the comparison was made for the approach and other algorithms like GA and SA. The experimental results show that the approach is feasible and effective in the optimization research of flexible process planning.

articleTitle: Robust H∞ dynamic output feedback control of linear time-varying periodic fractional order singular systems
abstract: Many issues such as controllability, observability and stability of linear time-varying periodic fractional order singular fractional order systems (LTVPFOS) depend on its state transition matrix which is still an open problem for LTVPFOS. The paper deals with the robust H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> dynamic output feedback control of an ordinary LTVPFOS. The periodic problem is converted into a kind of norm bounded issues with robust control thought. Two theorems in terms of LMIs on the admissibility and dynamic output feedback controllers of robust stabilization and H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> control of LTVPFOS are proposed and designed. A numerical example is provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

Author Keywords: Linear time varying periodic singular systems

articleTitle: On the robustness of a data-driven optimal ILC method with data loss
abstract: In this work, the robustness of iterative learning control with random data loss is discussed for a class of general nonlinear systems. The loss of output data from the system sensor to the controller side is considered, and the data loss is described by Bernoulli random variables. The design of the system controller is based on the optimal principle. The strict convergence analysis process is developed with the condition of optimal iterative learning control design. Finally, the validity of the proposed algorithm is verified by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Clustering and discrimination analysis of telemetrie pulse numbers of inertial navigation system
abstract: In order to automate the process of tackling the telemetric pulse numbers generated from an inertial navigation system, the classification issue of telemetric pulse numbers is studied. Firstly, examples for classification are extracted from the telemetric pulse number file, according to its inherent characteristics. Secondly, the clustering analysis is applied to verify that the outlier examples can be separated from the overflow examples. Finally, the discrimination analysis is conducted by the linear discrimination function and Bayesian approach respectively. Based on the data of a flight test, the analysis results indicates that better clustering results can be obtained when the cosine distance approach is adopted to measure the examples distance, and with the same training set and test set, better discrimination results are obtained by the Bayesian approach than by the linear discrimination function.

articleTitle: Research on the DEA model with dynamic virtual decision making unit
abstract: When using the traditional DEA methods to evaluate the decision making units, the important indices are difficult to reflect. To solve this problem, we establish BC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> model with dynamic virtual decision making unit-DVBC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> model and establish heuristic algorithm to solve DVBC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> model - progressive search algorithm based on virtual unit dynamic changes. The rationality and practicability of the DVBC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> model are proved by examples.

articleTitle: Fault detection for continuous-time semi-Markovian jump systems
abstract: This paper investigates the fault detection problem of continuous-time semi-Markovian jump systems (S-MJSs). The fault detection problem is studied for S-MJSs by using a conventional filter. The decoupling method is used to handle the fault detection system. According to Lyapunov functional stability, the filter is designed such that the fault detection system is stochastically stable with an H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance, and its parameters can be solved by convex optimization method. Simulation results are given to illustrate the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Study on trip distribution of Beijing residents based on information entropy model
abstract: The forecast models of the trip distribution are focused on in this paper. The probability that different trip modes are adopted at different trip distances is considered. For the residents in Beijing, we get the actual distribution according to practical data, and use the method of maximum information entropy to find out the theoretical distribution. For a certain trip mode, we establish and evaluate different models with order m from 1 to 5, and explore the differences between theoretical distribution and actual distribution. Furthermore, the most suitable order of model is selected and the model is tested by chi-square. Finally, the forecast precision of the model is calculated.

articleTitle: Controllability of edge dynamics on directed multi-agent systems
abstract: In this paper, the controllability problem is investigated for the directed multi-agent system with both edge dynamics and node dynamics. The system with edge dynamics is addressed by associating each edge of the network with a state variable. Firstly, we propose a new class of dynamic-edge multi-agent system based on the first-order integrator model and the rationality of this system is illustrated by the example of a power network system. Then, by discussing the relationship between λ and 0 and the relationship between λ and decay rate respectively, the controllability problem is investigated for the directed multi-agent system with both node dynamics and edge dynamics. With PBH criterion, necessary and sufficient conditions are finally derived for the controllability of the system.

articleTitle: Simulation of electromagnetic field based on Simplorer and Maxwell software
abstract: This paper presents a method of studying electromagnetic field using Simplorer and Maxwell software. The basic principles of electromagnetic field control are discussed, including excitation power supply, magnetic field, and the relationship of between electric field and magnetic field. The ideas and steps of establishing the electromagnetic field research model using Simplorer and Maxwell software are introduced. The method of building up the model of electromagnetic coil using Maxwell software and the model of circuit of excitation power supply using Simplorer software are introduced. This paper has positive guidance and help for the research and application of electromagnetic field.

articleTitle: Target tracking based on the feature fusion
abstract: In order to improve the tracking performance and strengthen the recognition role of the saliency feature, a novel multi-feature fusion method is proposed. The histogram models of the hue feature and the texture feature are separately. The probability value of the pixel in the probability distribution image is chosen as the larger value between the two probability values obtained by the back projections based on the hue histogram and the texture histogram separately. Camshift method based on the feature fusion is used to track the face target. Simulation results show that the method can recognize the target from the complex scene, the interference can be restrained by the method, and the tracking performance can be improved.

articleTitle: Algorithm design and simulation for one double loop UPQC system
abstract: Power quality has become the most important issue for specific industry and sensitive customers because of the extensive use of nonlinear loads and the rise of energy internet nowadays. Control algorithm and topology design of one unified power quality conditioner which includes active power filter (APF) and dynamic voltage restorer (DVR) is proposed in this paper. Method of voltage detection and current detection is given by way of theoretical method, compensation algorithm of both transient voltage sag and harmonic current are provided based on the provided topology provided. The effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is demonstrated. The proposed system is validated by performing tests using PSCAD. It is proved that the proposed UPQC can recompense the reactive power, fault current, and deviated voltage profile under faulted condition by simulation and experiments.

articleTitle: Fractional-order memcapacitor-based Chua's circuit and its chaotic behaviour analysis
abstract: In this paper, a simulation model of the charge-controlled memcapacitor is realized, and fractional calculus is used to analyze it. An interesting phenomena found out is that the curve is bent downward as the parameter order-α decreases. And then, the fractional-order memcapacitor Chua's differential equations are presented. Theory analysis and simulation results show the influence of the fractional-order to the system dynamics. The nonlinear dynamics of the above fractional-order nonlinear system including phase graphs, time domain waveforms and bifurcation diagrams are studied in detail, during which many interesting phenomena are discovered. We observe that chaos seems to disappear as the order q decreases. Meanwhile, when q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> =3D q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> =3D q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> =3D 0.90, the chaos disappeared completely. Finally, corresponding bifurcation diagram of variable Y versus parameter q, q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> are presented respectively, and get a conclusion that the order q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> has the greatest influence on Chaos than q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> and q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>.

articleTitle: Reducing variance in MCTS using bootstrap method
abstract: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is a heuristic search algorithm for some kinds of decision processes, it has many important applications to computer game domain. The most important thing in theory for MCTS is to reduce variance of the estimate values of the tree nodes under the limited search scope due to the constraints of computing resource and time consumption. The original MCTS algorithm uses a random policy which usually does not converge. Some optimizations, like the UCT and the RAVE, can reduce variances partly through the use of episode information. In this paper, we introduce a new algorithm, which could produce low-variance estimate of node values via a statistical method called bootstrap. Experimental results show that the new algorithm significantly improves the theoretical performance of MCTS.

articleTitle: Design of robust adaptive neural course controller for unmanned surface vehicle based on trajectory linearization control
abstract: This paper proposes a novel course controller on unmanned surface vehicle (USV) by using the methods of robust adaptive neural network trajectory linearization control (TLC). TLC is an effective control method for solving nonlinear tracking and system decoupling. However, the performance of the current TLC control strategy will be significantly decreased when there is a large the uncertainty of model. To enhance performance of the systems, Radial Basis Function Neural Network (RBFNN) is introduced to approximate the uncertainty of model to achieve real-time online compensation. It is proven that all error signals in the system are uniformly ultimately bounded by Lyapunov function. Finally, simulation results are presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Study on electromagnetic ultrasonic testing method for determining solidified shell thickness during continuous casting
abstract: One of the areas in the high-temperature continuous casting process that has not been definitively addressed is a method for accurately determining of solidified shell thickness. Therefore, this paper investigates a novel method for non-destructive detection of the solidified shell thickness based on the electromagnetic ultrasonic (EMA) technology. In this method, an electromagnetic ultrasonic transducer (EMAT) was utilized for exciting ultrasonic waves in the continuous casting slab. According to the fact that the propagation velocity of ultrasonic waves is a considerable difference in the solid and liquid metal, the TOF delay caused by the reflection and refraction at a solid-liquid interface of ultrasonic waves has been analyzed. Furthermore, studies on the effect of solidification shell thickness on ultrasonic echoes have been carried out by finite element simulation. Through the construction of the experimental platform, the measured data show close agreement with the simulation results and thus verify the reasonable and feasible of the proposed method which can provide reference for on-line detection of solidified shell thickness during continuous casting.

articleTitle: Design of DSP-based monitoring system for control transformer operating parameters
abstract: The fault of control transformer will directly lead to the damage of power supply in the control system of electromagnetic starter, inverter, soft starter and other equipment, and seriously affect the normal operation of such equipment. Herein, based on the analysis of structure and basic working principle of control transformer, the monitoring system for operating parameters of control transformer is designed by using a digital signal processor (DSP). And the voltage monitoring circuit, current monitoring circuit, 3.3 V and 5 V power supply circuit were detailed designed.

articleTitle: Sequential introduction of quality-differentiated add-ons in advance bundling
abstract: Advance bundling is a hybrid strategy of advance selling and bundling strategy. The firm bundles the base product with one add-on in advance period and then sells another quality-differentiated add-on individually in spot period. This paper establishes an analytical model to solve the optimal advance price and the optimal spot price over two periods when consumers are heterogeneous. The experimental results show that when the number of high-value segment is large, the high advance price and spot price is optimal, while the low advance price and spot price is optimal when the number of low-value segment is large.

articleTitle: Event-triggered Resilient Filtering for Time-varying Systems with Randomly Occurring Nonlinearity and Missing Measurements
abstract: This paper studies the event-triggered resilient filtering problem for a class of nonlinear systems with randomly occurring nonlinearity and missing measurements. Both the phenomena of the randomly occurring nonlinearity and the missing measurements are described by Bernoulli distributed random variables, where the occurrence probabilities could be uncertain. The event-triggered communication mechanism is introduced to save the network bandwidth during the data transmissions through the network. Additionally, the filter gain perturbations are characterized by employing the norm bounded uncertainties. The aim of the paper is to develop a robust event-triggered resilient filtering algorithm against the randomly occurring nonlinearity and missing measurements. Note that the analytical expressions of the filtering error covariance cannot be computed directly. Consequently, we derive its upper bound as an alternative way and subsequently minimize such an upper bound by properly designing the filter gain at each time step. Finally, an illustrative example is presented to show the effectiveness of the provided filtering algorithm.

articleTitle: A practical grasping system using HSV modelled Kinect2 vision and YouBot
abstract: In order to reduce the instability of the robot experiment results based on monocular vision, this paper proposes a method of robot grasping using Kinect2 in vision part. In this method, Kinect2 is fixed on the robot. The robot and Kinect2 are connected to the same terminal to form the control system. In the coordinate transformation between Kinect2 coordinates and robots, we use checkerboard calibration method to determine the Kinect2's internal and external parameters. We provide Kinect2 with the RGB image and the depth data, and uses the Point Cloud Library to match them, thus the grasping system is formed. The RGB image is converted to HSV image, and the target object is identified through color recognition. The coordinates of the target in the robot coordinate system are calculated through the internal and external parameters calculated before. After getting the coordinates of the object, the optimal way of grasping is determined through the solution set of the motion angle of the manipulator and path planning.

articleTitle: Face recognition algorithm based on cascading BGP feature fusion
abstract: BGP feature is a simple and efficient face recognition descriptor which is robust to light, expression and occlusion. Normally, the feature extraction of BGP is performed once on the face, and the texture information obtained is not rich enough. In this paper, a multi-level cascaded BGP extraction method is applied to obtain richer facial texture information. Firstly, feature extraction is performed on the original face using BGP. Then, feature extraction is performed on the obtained face feature images in the same way to obtain multi-level concatenated features. Finally, the histograms of the feature images are spliced and combined on the face features. The algorithm is fully validated in Yale and extended YaleB, and the recognition accuracy is significantly improved compared with the original BGP algorithm.

articleTitle: Robust active queue management for internet with multiple time delays
abstract: This paper focuses on modeling and compensation of multiple time delays in Internet congestion control, which has not been addressed in the literatures. A new mathematical model of the congestion control system for Internet with multiple state and input time delays is established, and a robust predictive congestion controller is presented. The controller is designed based on active queue management (AQM) and linear matrix inequality (LMI). The performance of the closed-loop system is analyzed via Lyapunov-Krasovskii approach and the effectiveness of the proposed controller is verified through simulation.

articleTitle: Time-delay dependent H-infinity control for networked control systems with singular system and Markovian jumping parameters
abstract: In this paper, the control of a class of networked control systems with singular systems and Markovian jumping parameters is discussed. The network control system of Markovian jumping singular system is considered, including constant delay and normal boundary uncertainty. Based on the linear matrix inequality (LMI) method, a time-delay dependent condition is proposed, which ensures that the networked control system with Markovian jumping singular system is random. On this basis, a sufficient condition for the existence of a state feedback controller is given, which guarantees the robustness and performance of the controller. The applicability of this method is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Research on simulation data exchange model in joint simulation of weapons and equipment systems
abstract: In joint simulation which combined by multi-architecture weapons and equipment systems , the data exchange model has the basic effect of data exchange between heterogeneous constituent systems. In order to solve the problem of data exchange between heterogeneous constituent systems, a simulation data exchange model based on XML is designed. According to the conception of System Entity Structure (SES), the content of data exchange model is determined, and the expression of SES in the ontology layer is established by using the XML Schema of implementation layer. The XML instance is used as the specific description of Pruned System Entity Structure(PES). The simulation data exchange model designed in this paper provides a unified specification and design for the data exchange of the joint simulation of weapons and equipment systems. It can be used as the specification of information sharing between heterogeneous constituent systems in simulation of System of Systems(SoS).

articleTitle: Sampled-data leader-following consensus of second-order nonlinear multi-agent systems with disturbance and missing data
abstract: In this paper, the leader-following consensus problem of second-order nonlinear multi-agent systems with disturbances and random missing input data is investigated. The stochastic variables with a Bernoulli distributed sequence are used to model missing input data. A novel protocol with missing data is proposed. Further more, the sufficient condition is obtained to ensure the leader-following consensus. Finally, a numerical example is provided to verify the effectiveness of the proposed protocol.

articleTitle: A novel method of beidou satellite signal acquisition using signal square stripping NH scrambling
abstract: The BeiDou Navigation Satellite system is original designed to perform navigation and control tasks as an compatible, independent, open, and global navigation system. The success operating of this system in real-world environments have to overcome numerous challenges, chief among which are the BDS signal's success capture ratio, and the time resources consumed to accomplish standard positioning task. These issues are still deemed as key open challenges currently. Aimed at mitigating the aliasing artifacts brought by the way the modulation codes are tackled, and improving the BDS system performance in terms of reducing the usage of logical resources and shorten the capture time, we proposed in the current paper an acquisition method of using signal square to capture satellite signals and remove the NH implementation code interference signal. We designed a hardware system based on Xilinx XC7Z045 platform to realize the main principle and idea of the proposed method. The simulation tests are carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. Also, we compared resources cost of the proposed methods against the traditional one, it seems that the hardware circuit resources of the current method are reduced significantly. In addition to providing a novel perspective of the navigation problem, the proposed signal square stripping approach adopted in this paper paves the way to several extensions in relation to position, navigation and control of BeiDou systems, such as the transportation, mobile network synchronization and guidance & control of varied kinds of platforms and multi-agent networking systems.

articleTitle: Analysis on the adaptability of bus rapid transit system in Zibo
abstract: How to improve urban traffic and achieve the sustainable development of the city, is a very challenging task in front of the traffic workers. The core idea of urban transportation infrastructure construction is to improve the quality of resident life and protect the environment. Development and construction of a high -volume, low-cost, high-quality form of public transport, which can meet the above requirements of the construction. A large number of practice has proved that the rapid transit system has better combine the strengths of rail transit and bus. Its relatively low cost and high efficiency is indeed a very good mode of public transport. In this paper, the applicability of BRT system in Zibo is studied based on Zibo traffic and environment status.

articleTitle: Boundary feedback stabilization for a time fractional-order wave equation
abstract: In this paper, the boundary feedback stabilization of an unstable time fractional-order wave equation is discussed by the backstepping method. We firstly solve the kernel function in the forward and inverse transformation; then, we obtain the polynomial stability of the closed-loop system.

articleTitle: Optimization of Ideology and Politics education process based on evolutionary game theory
abstract: In order to explore the optimization of education in Ideology and Politics, the author constructs a strategy evolutionary game model between educators and educates, which is based on the analysis of participants organizational units and costs and benefits of different strategies in the process of ideological education. By the analysis of the evolutionary game model, it is drawn that educators can improve the ideological level of educatees by adopting positive educational methods and educatees' adopting active acceptance mode. And then not only the cohesion of the unit can be improved but also a win-win result will be reached.

articleTitle: Delay - dependent robust stability of neural networks with time-varying delays
abstract: This study is concerned with the problem of delay - dependent robust stability for neural networks with time- varying delays. Through constructing appropriate Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional, combined with reciprocally convex combination technique and Wirtingers inequality approach, the delay-dependent robust stability criteria are derived. Finally, an example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness and correctness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Scatter Search Algorithm for QoS Multicast Routing Problem
abstract: Quality of service (QoS) multicast routing is non-linear combinatorial optimization problem. It tries to search a multicast routing tree with minimal cost that can meet constraints such as bandwidth, delay, and delay jitter. This paper presents a hybrid scatter search algorithm (ACO&SS) to solve QoS multicast routing problem. The main feature of the hybrid algorithm is to hybridize the solution construction mechanism of the ACO with scatter search (SS). Moreover, the hybrid algorithm considers both solution diversification and solution quality. The method has both the advantages of ant colony optimization, the ability to find the higher performance solutions, and that of scatter search, the ability to explore different parts of the solution space and to find better solutions. Finally, the simulation results show that the ACO&SS algorithm performs well in terms of solution quality.

articleTitle: LPV model reference control method for hypersonic vehicle control system
abstract: The traditional state feedback control method needs longer adjustment time and needs longer time to stably track the changes of the flight state commands. Aiming at the above situation, a LPV model reference control method is developed in this paper. Firstly, considering the changes of the flight states of the hypersonic vehicle, the control law of the hypersonic vehicle based on LPV model reference control method is designed according to the characteristics of the longitudinal model of the aircraft. Then, the singular value decomposition is used to solve the controller's coefficient matrix and the controller's state feedback gain is solved by the linear matrix inequality. Under the action of the controller, the actual output of the model converges to the output of the reference model. Finally, effectiveness of the controller is verified by the simulation results. The comparison between the designed controller and the traditional state feedback controller shows that the designed controller has shorter adjustment time and smaller overshoot.

articleTitle: Fractional dynamics analysis of human behavior disseminating
abstract: A fractional dynamics model is introduced to investigate the human behavior disseminating among enterprise or industry based on traditional literature. In this paper, individuals are divided into pure, experienced and recovered considering their explicit behavior and the fractional model is solved by the Admas-Bashforth-Moulton (ABM) predictor-corrector numerical approach. It is found that the fractional model has better memorability and could describe the dynamics processes of the system accurately by the numerical simulations than traditional integer model. Furthermore, reducing the mobility of employees is provided for enterprises or industry to avoid the potential risk in future.

articleTitle: Stabilization for three classes of simple 3D chaotic systems with no constant term via nonlinear and linear control approaches
abstract: Three classes of simple three-dimensional (3D) quadratic smooth chaotic systems with no constant term are constructed in this paper. The origin is a common equilibrium point of all chaotic systems. Nine quadratic nonlinearities in each class of chaotic systems are relative to a certain state variable simultaneously. Three classes of chaotic systems can be stabilized via two different control approaches including a nonlinear state feedback approach and a linear state feedback approach. A numerical example on a new chaotic system shows the effectiveness of two control approaches.

articleTitle: Event-triggered Based Rolling Optimization in a Microgrid under Uncertainties
abstract: This paper introduces a scheduling method based on event-triggered rolling optimization to realize operation optimization of a microgrid. An event occurs when deviation of real-time values and predictive values exceed a predetermined range. Under this approach, an aperiodic rolling window is utilized to deal with immense volatility of a microgrid caused by weather condition, demand profile and time-of-use power price. Besides, in pursuit of accuracy of solutions, short time interval also increases computational burden. Continuous scheduling periods are incorporated into a rolling window to improve computational efficiency if there are no events. Simulation results show that the event- triggered rolling optimization method reduces the total operation cost and the number of iterations of operation under uncertainties. Moreover, the proposed method makes a trade-off between effectiveness of the algorithm and optimality of the scheduling.

articleTitle: Robust face recognition based on non-negative sparse discriminative low-rank representation
abstract: Due to occlusion or camouflage existing in the current face images, previous face recognition algorithms such as sparse representation classification algorithm do not take face damage into consideration during the training period, and therefore their testing performance will be degraded. In this paper, we propose a novel non-negative sparse discriminative low-rank representation algorithm (NSDLRR). First, we seek a sparse, low-rank and non-negative matrix in training samples. Then, we add a structural inconsistency constraint on this basis, make different kinds of samples as independent as possible, thereby increasing the extra recognition ability. Finally, the test samples are classified by sparse linear representation. Experimental results on different face database show that the algorithm has better performance.

articleTitle: A transportation network stability analysis method based on betweenness centrality entropy maximization
abstract: In order to analyze the structural stability of transportation networks, a dynamic structure optimization method combining with betweenness and network entropy, named Fast Betweenness Entropy Maximization (Fast BEM), is proposed in this paper, which uses iterative calculation process to enhance stability of network structure, and finally reaches a stable structure of transportation networks. The Fast BEM improves the speed of convergence on the basis of the existing open shortest path first algorithm, despite an increase in the work done in each optimization iteration. But the number of optimized iterations and the running time are reduced in general. Consequently, the stable structure can be found more quickly. The experiments show that by using the Fast BEM, the convergence speed tends to be stable to reduce volatility, and the effectiveness of this algorithm is verified.

articleTitle: The comparison of canny and structured forests edge detection application in precision identification of pointer instrument
abstract: As an indispensable measuring instrument, the pointer instrument has been widely used in the fields of industrial production. While the manual instrument identification has problems of higher labor intensity, higher rate of misjudgment and lower production, we take advantage of computer vision to deal with the images of pointer instrument dials. Two algorithms are proposed for image edge detection: structured random forests edge detection and canny edge detection, Hough transform is used to recognize the straight lines of the pointer, then the automation of instrument identification can be realized. Our results show that the accuracy of the dials printed by the two methods can meet the production requirements.

articleTitle: Attitude control for a quadrotor base on ADRC with GSO parameter optimization
abstract: A kind of attitude control strategy for the quadrotor based on active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the dynamic model using Newton-Euler formula of the quadrotor helicopter is developed. Then according to the order of dynamics equations design corresponding ADRC. Subsequently, in consideration of the characteristics of uncertain parameter of ADRC, the Glowworm Swarm Optimization(GSO) is designed to optimize the controller parameters so as to enhance the system performance. Finally, the comparative simulation for attitude of quadrotor is developed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy. The results of simulations show that the proposed controller possesses strong robustness and high performances.

articleTitle: Control and simulation of fractional order inverted pendulum systems
abstract: In this paper, a model of fractional inverted pendulum is constructed. Different controllers are designed to guaranteed closed-loop system stability. In the process of control, the integer order controller and the fractional order controller are used to control the system, respectively. Furthermore, we compare the integer order controller with the fractional order controller. In the process of analysis, the stability of the systems is analyzed in time domain and frequency domain, respectively. Besides it, the simulation results shows that the fractional order control systems have better stability if the proper fractional order is adopted.

articleTitle: Trajectory linearization method based on sliding mode observer for unmanned helicopter trajectory tracking control
abstract: Aiming at disturbance forces and torques in the system, the trajectory linearization method combined with sliding mode disturbance observer is applied to design a trajectory tracking controller for an unmanned helicopter. The design of controller is based on the six degree of freedom rigid body nonlinear helicopter model, and by model simplification, the nonlinear helicopter model is equivalently transformed into four subsystems including position kinematics, position dynamics, attitude kinematics and attitude dynamics. The controller of position dynamics and attitude dynamics consist of pseudo inversion, closed loop feedback error regulation and compensation control generated by sliding mode disturbance observer. Finally, under disturbance of forces and torques, the trajectory linearization method and trajectory linearization method combined with sliding mode disturbance observer are separately applied to track the desired trajectory, and simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Stabilization for impulsive switched positive systems under asynchronous switching
abstract: In this paper, the stabilization problem for a family of impulsive switched positive systems under asynchronous switching is addressed. By using multiple linear copositive Lyapunov functions approach and dual system theory, the state feedback controller is designed to guarantee the positivity and exponential stability for the closed-loop system. The total running interval ratio between matched period and mismatched period is restricted to be more than a known constant and the switching frequency satisfies an average dwell time. In addition, the impulse-free case is also discussed. Our obtained results are all formulated in terms of linear programming problem, which is numerical feasible. Finally, a numerical example is presented to demonstrate the validity of our results.

articleTitle: Underwater vehicle trajectory planning in dynamic environments based on Radau Pseudospectral method
abstract: In this paper, the problem of trajectory planning for underwater vehicle in dynamic environments is discussed. Considering the kinematics model of underwater vehicle, the optimal trajectory planning model is set up with the goal of minimum time consumption and collision avoidance.
