abstract: Pose estimation of moving body, such as mobile robots and UAVs(Unmanned Aerial Vehicles), is critical for visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping(vSLAM). For the moving body carried with an RGB-D camera, their pose can be assessed through estimating the camera pose in RGB-D SLAM. Most RGB-D SLAM algorithms employ a framework with RANSAC and ICP(Iterative Closest Point) to refine feature correspondences and calculate camera pose simultaneously. However, due to its random sampling, standard RANSAC can not always find the optimal feature correspondences and performs not very well with lower accuracy and speed when false matches account for higher proportion. In this paper, we propose a new pose estimation algorithm based on RGB-D SLAM presented by Endres et al. [16] with ICP and improved RANSAC. Compared with the work of Endres et al., the improved RANSAC can be much more effectively to reject false feature matches, leading to more accurate pose estimation with faster speed. Several experiments are performed to prove the effectiveness of our algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of the behaviors about scientific research innovation and management in university based on evolutionary game
abstract: Scientific research, the representative of a university's comprehensive strengths, is one part of the four significant functions in colleges. Management and incentives to scientific research innovation is a key point to build a positive research atmosphere. This paper, on the premise of bounded rationality, initially analyze the factors that have influence on researchers and management administrations decision-making. we construct a game pay-off matrix about the behaviors of researchers and management administrations based on Evolutionary Game Theory (EGT) and build a replicated dynamic equation. Then, we analyze the evolutionary paths of both sides and factors by using EGT, which reveal the impact of individual selection on group behaviors. In order to study innovative behavior of scientific research systematically and quantitatively, the next step is to develop a simulation system related to scientific research innovation and management on Matlab GUI platform. The analytic procedure of this paper can provide decision support for universities and scientific research management departments. Those bodies are able to choose the best incentive strategy and improve the level of scientific research innovation in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Research on Micro-Grid Inverter and its Operation Control
abstract: The grid-connected inverter is the key component of the micro-grid system. In this paper, the voltage and current double closed-loop control method was adopted in the inverter, which improved the stability of the inverter output. The droop characteristic control methods of active-frequency and reactive-voltage were used to implement parallel operation and island operation respectively in micro-grid effectively, which can realize finding a stable working point quickly and automatically in the micro-grid system. At the same time, the related parameters are derived in the paper. Finally, the simulation results show the validity and correctness of the designed control system.

articleTitle: Research on the inspection and monitoring system of power equipment based on cloud storage platform
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the data quantity of the electric power inspection system in smart city is increasing rapidly without the capacity to be collected, stored and analyzed safely and efficiently, A cloud storage system for inspection and monitoring data of power equipment in the smart grid was designed. The system is based on the inspection and monitoring procedures of the electric power system and the construction of cloud computing technology and cloud storage platform, through the establishment of cloud storage model with cloud storage platform Hadoop and HDFS system structure, and the application of Java language, Struts2 and Spring framework, using jQuery, EasyUI as interface development tools, with MySQL database and the methods of Maven unit testing tools, Log4J logging tools and other tools for system implementation. The test shows that the designed system can realize the collection, transmission, storage and archiving of power equipment inspection and monitoring data and other functions in order to provide power guarantee for the development of intelligent city and better meet the use demand of power operation environment.

articleTitle: Bridge crack image segmentation based on improved watershed algorithm
abstract: In order to solve the problem of over - segmentation of bridge fractures by the watershed algorithm, an improved watershed segmentation algorithm based on threshold marker is proposed. Firstly, the original gradient image is obtained from the gray image by using morphological operation, and the second - order Butterworth low - pass filtering is performed on the original gradient image to obtain the low - frequency component of the gradient image. And then apply the best threshold for the use of Otsu method to be applied to the morphological extended minimum transform technique, and the technique is used to extract the local minimum value which is highly correlated with the bridge crack feature information from the low frequency components of the gradient image; Finally, the original gradient image is used to compose the minimum gradient of the original gradient image to obtain the modified gradient image, and watershed segmentation is performed on these gradient images. The experimental results show that the crack image of the bridge is accurate and clear, and the over - segmentation phenomenon is effectively reduced.

articleTitle: Research of MIMU/GPS integrated navigation based on improved Kalman filter
abstract: Kalman filter algorithm is basically applied to the MIMU/GPS integrated navigation, but there are always accidents such as abnormal observation noise or noise mutation in reality, where may make the state covariance matrix lose symmetric even the emergence of the divergence of the filter with the consequences of leading to lower the accuracy of integrated navigation system. This paper aims to solve this problem using the principle of singular value decomposition. The main concept behind the algorithm is to achieve updating process via singular value decomposition factors of all the matrices consisting of error covariance, process noise covariance and measurement covariance, instead of Cholesky decomposition on the basis of the conventional Kalman filtering algorithm. The simulation experiments show that the robustness of the proposed algorithm based on singular value decomposition is superior to the Kalman filtering and the square-root filtering algorithm, and improves the navigation accuracy effectively.

articleTitle: Design of bidirectional DC-DC converter based on single chip microcomputer
abstract: A bidirectional DC-DC converter based on single chip microcomputer (SCM) is designed by adopting bidirectional buck-boost topology instead of the traditional method of separately designing boost circuit and buck circuit. The converter is designed to achieve charging and discharging functions of five 18650 lithium-ion batteries. The main control chip of the converter is SCM STC12C5A60S2. The IR2104 half-bridge driver with bootstrap function is selected to drive MOSFET for stable turn-on and turn-off. The converter includes sampling circuit formed by the sampling resistor and the op amp op07 and display circuit formed by LCD1602, which can sample and display current and voltage in real time in both charging mode and discharging mode of the converter. In addition, the converter can control the current through keys. The overall system structure is simple, easy to control and low cost. The conversion efficiency is greatly improved using synchronous rectification. In the prototype test, the current fluctuation is small and the voltage stability is high. The designed converter is applied to a small DC motor drive circuit in a laboratory, the motor works well.

articleTitle: Pseudo-color processing of forward looking sonar image: An adaptive hot metal coding algorithm
abstract: According to the features of forward looking sonar image, an adaptive hot metal coding algorithm with maximum entropy threshold (AH-M) is proposed to complete pseudo-color processing in forward looking sonar image. Specifically, the parabolic eight-point interpolation is used to interpolate the beams and the sampling points. Meanwhile, the backward mapping coordinate transformation is adopted to generate forward looking sonar image. On this basis, a new hot metal coding algorithm is proposed to complete pseudo-color processing. In order to perform pseudo-color processing according to the features of forward looking sonar image, the node values of the hot metal coding are selected adaptively by the maximum entropy threshold method. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed AH-M can eliminate mosaic phenomenon and get detail-prominent sonar images. And it can get rich and distinct colors in generated sonar images with relatively fast speed.

articleTitle: Flexibility suppression for aeroelastic hypersonic vehicle
abstract: A novel control scheme is proposed to address the control problem for the hypersonic vehicles with flexible dynamics based on predictive sliding mode control (PSMC). First, the model of flexible hypersonic vehicle is presented and simplified to facilitate control system design. Then, PSMC is utilized to attenuate flexible dynamics and model uncertainties based on feedback linearization control, with stability demonstrated via Lyapunov stability theorem. Finally, simulation results are given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Hopf bifurcation in fractional red blood cells model via time-delayed feedback control
abstract: In this paper, we propose a time-delayed feedback controller in a fractional-order red blood cells model. Based on this model, we study the stability and Hopf bifurcation. The time delay of the model can change the stability and cause the generation of bifurcating periodic solutions in the controlled fractional-order red blood cells model. We choose the time delay as the bifurcation parameter. Through the stability analysis, we can see that the controller parameters can affect the stability of the controlled model and change the bifurcation point. Then, we can adjust the proper control parameters to achieve desirable model indicators. Finally, numerical simulations are given to prove the correct of theoretical results.

articleTitle: Bibliometric analysis and visualization on international mobile library research output, 2007–2016
abstract: Bibliometrics analysis of published research output is performed on the mobile library field for the period of 2007-2016, based on research data retrieved from the Science Citation index and Social Sciences Citation Index databases. A number of 772 mobile library related articles in the period are identified in this research. On the basis of the above data source, combined with the softwares of GEPHI and VOSviewer, co-word analysis and visualization are employed from the viewpoint of the bibliometrics analysis method, in order that the number evolution pattern of research outputs, prominent authors and their research paradigms, institutions contributing to the field, and content analysis based on co-word method are conducted in the paper, to reveal the research status and future trend in mobile library field.

articleTitle: Crowd counting oriented to indoor scenes based on FCN with inception modules and residual networks
abstract: In public places, the number of people is an important indicator of population safety, especially for indoor closed places. In this paper, we propose a new fully convolutional neural network (FCN) to calculate the indoor population and draw a density map which can reflect crowd distribution. We add inception modules and residual network structures to our network, which greatly enhances the accuracy rate about the prediction of the population and solves the problem of overfitting. Compared with the prior art methods, our proposed scheme achieves a faster, less space- consuming and more accurate prediction of the population density.

articleTitle: Non-uniform sampling scheme based on low rank matrix approximate for sparse photoacoustic microscope system
abstract: Optical-Resolution Photoacoustic Microscopy (OR-PAM) has rapidly emerging as tool for label-free imaging of the morphology and functions of the microvasculature in vivo with a high resolution. However, the data acquisition time is so long that it is a great challenge for real time imaging. Therefore, a Sparse PAM (SPAM) has been proposed to obtain a high-resolution PAM image with relatively low sampling density. In order to successfully set up a SPAM system, the two key problems that we need to keep focus on are designation of the compressive sampling scheme and the corresponding image recovery algorithm. Typically, a random uniform sampling scheme is adopted. In this paper, a non-uniform sampling scheme based on low rank matrix approximate are proposed to replace the conventional point-by-point scanning scheme to implement fast data acquisition. The effectiveness of the proposed non-uniform scanning scheme is validated using both numerical analysis and PAM experiments. As compliments for SPAM system, the total sampling points are dramatically decreased for a relatively high-resolution PAM vascular image and to implement accelerated data acquisition. Thus, OR-PAM is of great potential to find board biomedical applications in the pathophysiology studies of tumor and treatments for anti-angiogenesis.

articleTitle: The K-Nearest neighbor slope one algorithm based on weighted user similarity and user tag
abstract: Slope One algorithm has been widely used in collaborative filtering algorithm. However this algorithm does not consider about the similar relationship among users, and the accuracy of the algorithm is affected. Combining with the idea of the K-Nearest Neighbor, this article weights fusion Improved Jaccard and Pearson ways to bring in the user neighbors to calculate the deviation terms in Slope One algorithm, and the prediction accuracy is improved. And then the prediction accuracy is further increased by bringing the user tag information. In the end, applying the algorithm to the MovieLens Data Sets, the simulation results show that the prediction accuracy of the algorithm in this paper is better than the traditional Slope One algorithm and some other algorithms.

articleTitle: Consensus Control of A Class of Second-order Nonlinear Multi-agent Systems Based on Distributed Adaptive Protocol
abstract: In this paper, we focus on the consensus control problem for a class of second-order nonlinear multi-agent system with bounded external disturbances. And a distributed adaptive control law is proposed to solve the problem. By using Lyapunov function theory, we prove the stability of the proposed control protocols, and derive a sufficient condition for consensus convergence of the system. Unlike the results that given in many literature, the nonlinear functions of system dynamics here are not necessary to satisfy any limitations of the global Lipschitz or Lipschitz-like conditions. Therefore, the method proposed in this paper has more applicability and usability in practical engineering applications. Finally, simulation examples are provided to illustrate the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: A consensus algorithm-based power dispatch method with the consideration of power outage in smart home
abstract: This paper investigates a consensus algorithm-based power dispatch problem when the power outage happens in the intelligent household. Energy storage devices are added in power grids to support the electricity supply while taking power outages into consideration. According to the need of using electrical appliances caused by the different power outage periods lengths, the establishment of smart home load model and the load shedding judgment are proposed. When the different energy storage devices are used to provide electricity, a consensus algorithm is proposed for the power dispatch. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A recursive algorithm for generating four-block cutting pattern of circular blanks
abstract: Focusing on the unconstrained circle cutting problem, a recursive algorithm which can generate four-block cutting pattern was presented. With the four-block cutting pattern, a sheet can be cut into four blocks. Each block contains strips of the same direction and length. In each strip more than one row of identical blanks can appear. The optimal arrangement of strips on each block was determined by the recursive algorithm. An implicit enumeration method was used to determine the combination of blocks in sheet to make the material usage reach its maximum. The experimental results show that, the algorithm is efficient in both the computation time and the material usage.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis method for stochastic systems with unknown parameters
abstract: The problem of fault diagnosis in stochastic systems with unknown parameters is studied within dual control concept. This paper puts forward a conception of logic parameter decay rate based on the threshold, and has designed a rolling control algorithm learning control law based on Kalman filtering theory and Lqg control law, while this algorithm can estimate the parameters, on the side of the parameter learning, the system has good fault tolerance ability, thus more accurate fault detection and isolation, the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis on the impact of innovation and entrepreneurship on economic development in heilongjiang province, P.R.China
abstract: Innovation and entrepreneurship are an important engine of economic development. Based on the state space model, the paper explored the impact of innovation and entrepreneurship on economic development in Heilongjiang Province from three aspects, such as employment vitality, market vitality and scientific and technological innovation vitality. The paper drew a conclusion that the changing trends of elasticity of employment, vitality of market and innovation of science and technology to economic development were the same. These elastic coefficients all increased from 2001 to 2013, but decreased from 2014 to 2016. Meanwhile, the average values were 3.1509, 1.7927 and 0.5240 respectively. Based on the empirical analysis, aiming at the impact of innovation and entrepreneurship on economic development, reasonable consideration and suggestions were given.

articleTitle: A new elementary operation approach for the realization of 2-D singular systems
abstract: This paper proposes the singular general model (SGM) realization approach for two-dimensional (2-D) singular systems by using elementary operations. The new elementary operation approach proposed recently by the co-authors for the Roesser model realization of regular systems case will be generalized to the singular system case. Specifically, the realization problem of singular systems is first formulated as an elementary operation problem of a well-defined polynomial matrix associated with the given transfer function. Then, a general constructive realization procedure is established based on elementary operations, which guarantees an SGM realization of an arbitrarily given transfer function of 2-D singular systems. Two examples are given to illustrate the details and effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Finite time integral sliding mode fault-tolerant control for airbreathing hypersonic vehicle with external disturbances
abstract: This paper concerns the finite time tracking control problem for the longitudinal model of an airbreathing hypersonic vehicle (AHV) with actuator faults and external disturbances. First, the dynamics of system outputs V and h are given by calculating the differentials. Next, combining external disturbances and actuator additive faults as lumped disturbances, a nonlinear disturbance observer (NDOB) is designed to estimate them. Then, two integral sliding mode manifolds are designed based on tracking errors. Finally, combining NDOB and integral sliding mode control (SMC) techniques, a composite fault tolerant controller is constructed for the longitudinal model of an AHV. This control approach can make the velocity and altitude track the reference signals in finite time and reduce chattering phenomenon caused by SMC. Simulation results are given to show the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: A fast image enhancement algorithm for highway tunnel pedestrian detection
abstract: Pedestrian detection is a necessary means of support in modern traffic management. The error and miss detection rate of traditional pedestrian detection are high due to uneven illumination, dim environment in the tunnel, and the blurred monitored image, which makes it difficult for the subsequent identification. Therefore, in this paper, a fast image enhancement algorithm based on imaging model constraint is proposed and narrowed to the pedestrian ROI in the pavement near the street under the scene of highway tunnel. First, the method uses the combination of global atmospheric light and partitioned atmospheric light to estimate the local atmospheric light. Second, transmission is estimated based on the formula derived from the imaging model constraints. Third, the method uses constant instead of illumination to balance tunnel image illumination. Last, the tunnel image is enhanced according to the imaging model. Furthermore, because of the algorithm's real-time requirement, we propose a narrowing region method to thoroughly improve the overall computing efficiency. Considering about the characteristics of high way tunnel, which is a blurred scene and has difficulty recognizing the foreground from the background, we adopt a method of multi-feature integration to detect the enhanced image. Experimental and comparative analysis results show that the proposed method can rapidly and effectively enhance the tunnel image, and improve the effect of pedestrian detection in high way.

articleTitle: Finite-time consensus for heterogeneous dynamic agents networks with unavailable velocity information
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to solve the finite-time consensus problem for heterogeneous dynamic agents networks with unavailable velocity information. The considered system is composed of first-order agents and second- order integrator agents in which the velocity information is unavailable over fixed topologies. Two classes of new consensus protocols are presented by feat of auxiliary systems. By constructing new Lyapunov functionals and applying homogeneity theory and Lasalle's invariance principle, the proposed protocols are proved to make all states of the systems tend to be consistent. Some simulation examples are given to verify the efficiency of the obtained results.

articleTitle: Motion-planning-based formation-containment control for multi-agent systems
abstract: This paper studies the formation-containment problem for multi-agent systems. By using motion-planning approaches, a new class of distributed formation-containment protocols are designed for multi-agent systems such that the states of followers asymptotically converge to the convex hull formed by the states of leaders. Then, by selecting a special sampling time sequence, the finite-time formation-containment problem are solved for multi-agent systems. Finally, a numerical simulation is shown to verify the theory results in this paper.

articleTitle: Levitation control of PEMS high speed maglev train considering the coupling effects within a joint structure
abstract: High speed maglev train is designed for long distance intercity transportation with a maximum speed of 600 km/h. The fundamental levitation component in a high speed maglev train is a joint structure which consist of two single-point levitation subsystems connected by a rigid levitation frame. Usually for ease of computation and analysis, researches are constrained on the the single-point levitation subsystem which neglect the mutual coupling of the two adjacent single-points in a joint structure. To improve the riding performance of high speed maglev train, first a model of the entire joint structure levitation system is obtained. Then a controller is designed based on classic LQR method. In the end the performance of the decoupling controller is compared with the traditional controller via simulation.

articleTitle: Guaranteed cost control of uncertain continuous-time singular semi-markov jump systems with indefinite quadratic cost
abstract: This paper investigates the guaranteed cost control problem of continuous-time singular semi-Markov jump systems, in which the weighting matrix is indefinite in quadratic cost function. Firstly, a sufficient condition is given which guarantees the closed-loop systems to be regular, impulse-free, and robust stochastically stable, and the cost value is restricted between the lower and upper bounds. Then, based on singular value decomposition and linear matrix inequalities method, the state feedback guaranteed cost controllers are designed. Lastly, a numerical example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A High-dimensional data analysis method based on PCA and density clustering in clinical diagnosis
abstract: With the development of medical science and technology, a large number of high-dimensional data have appeared in medical fields. There is a large amount of irrelevant data and data redundancy information, which leads to the learning model tends to transition, fitting or characterization ability weakened. It is unable to express effectively the medical data characteristics. By principal component analysis and principal component analysis based on mutual information, we select features and reduce dimensionality of high dimensional data. Furthermore, combine with effective density clustering with excellent performance to reduce ultimately the size of data and improve the quality of data analysis to help doctors making diagnosis. Experimental results show that this method can effectively deal with high-dimensional medical data analysis and achieve better results.

articleTitle: MPC-based fault tolerant robust control of surface vessel eqquiped with T-foil
abstract: Incident waves are the primary cause of strong heave and pitch motion during navigation. The longitudinal stability of surface vessels can be improved by the installation of active T-foil. The MPC-based fault tolerant robust control algorithm is proposed in the context of disturbances of incident waves, according to the surface vessel fault model with input constraints and parameter perturbations. Mathematical models of surface vessel longitudinal motion and incident waves are presented. Considering the robustness of model, all probabilities of sensor failures and the input constraints of T-foil attack angle, the control of attack angle is realized by designing the MPC-based controller for the failure model. Simulation results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Multi-part pedestrian tracking algorithm with fuzzy decision for partial occlusion
abstract: For the obstacle of the traffic sign and facilities causing different degrees of occlusion to up-right person tracking system on-board visual equipment, a multi-part pedestrian tracking algorithm taking advantage of multi particle filters is proposed for solving the partial occlusion tracking failure problems that resulting in a wrong bounding box of the whole body. A novel spring elastic-load decision was introduced to coordinate and calibrate the actual position of each person's part, in order to decrease the error risk only using a single particle tracker and increase the visual object tracking robust under the partial occluded conditions. With the simulation results, the algorithm achieves better performance compared to only single tracking filter in partial occlusion of pedestrian, and weakens the wrong tracking effect in complex street background, so that it can provide a support for driving assistance visual object obstacle avoidance applications.

articleTitle: Single degree of freedom suspension control for permanent magnet disk with the thickness optimization
abstract: This paper proposed the single degree of freedom (D.O.F) suspension control with the thickness optimization for permanent magnet disk (P.M.D), which reduces active suspension D.O.F and power consumption. Considering the winding edge effect and the gravity central deviation, two-degree-of-freedom dynamic model is constructed including axial suspension and pitching motion, with which structural constraints are deduced from the improvement of the pitching stiffness. Considering controllability, disturbance rejection, and structure constraints, Lagrange function method is applied to optimize the P.M.D thickness. State feedback axial active controller is applied to suspend the P.M.D, and then suspension performance is theoretically analyzed from the aspect of the controller stability margin, closed-loop stiffness and damping. Simulation results verify that the optimized thickness has the best air gap tracking and disturbance rejection through the comparison of three thickness P.M.D. Experimental results further validate that the thickness optimization can reduce active suspension D.O.F and improve asymptotic tracing ability with wider air gap operation range.

articleTitle: A new method for obtaining the heart sound signals source components
abstract: This paper introduces a new method which using synchronized acquisition of four-channel heart sounds to acquire a heart sound signal source. First of all, we introduces the generation mechanism of heart sounds in detail, and puts forward that the heart sound signals have the characteristics of "time-sharing". Then, according to the basic characteristics of heart sound transmission in the thoracic cavity, we model the mathematical process of heart sound transmission in the thoracic, and propose a mathematical model about heart sound transmission. Finally, according to the mathematical characteristics of the model and the main feature of time-sharing in the heart sound signal, we propose a source separation method for the four-channel heart sound signal in order to obtain the source of heart sounds. The purpose of this algorithm is to eliminate the interaction between simultaneous acquisition of four-channel heart sound signal, which makes the acquired heart sound signal show the characteristics of time difference, energy concentration and low frequency of the spectrum so that we can obtain the source composition of heart sound signal. The experimental results show that the algorithm used in this paper can better obtain single heart sound source components, and single heart sound source components include four major components of the first heart sound (S1), the A and P components of the second heart sound (S2), which have a positive meaning in analyzing the original composition and production mechanism of the heart sound.

articleTitle: Robust H∞ filtering for nonlinear uncertain stochastic time-varying delayed systems
abstract: This paper mainly discusses the robust filtering problem for a class of nonlinear uncertain stochastic time- varying delayed systems. The system involves parameter uncertainties, Ito-type stochastic disturbances, time-varying delays and nonlinearities. The aim of this paper is to design a robust H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> filter such that the filtering error system is exponentially mean square stable with all admissible uncertainties, nonlinearities, time-varying delays and a prescribed H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> disturbance attenuation level is guaranteed. Sufficient conditions are obtained for the existence of desired H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> filters, which are given in terms of the solutions to linear matrix inequalities(LMIs).

articleTitle: Active disturbance rejection control with input prediction for systems with time-delay
abstract: This paper presents an input prediction based active disturbance rejection control scheme for systems with time-delay. The new scheme is motivated by the principle of Smith-predictor and traditional active disturbance rejection control. In order to make the transitive relation between the virtual control input and actual output approach a pure inertial element, an input predictor is adopted. The approximate error forms part of total error as well as the internal uncertainties and external disturbances, which can be easily dealt by traditional active disturbance rejection controller. Numerical examples and simulations based on the fuel dynamics of a boiler turbine unit show the improvement of the new method.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of blind sidewalk recognition system based on FPGA
abstract: With the popularity of blind sidewalk construction in the city, the blind sidewalk can greatly facilitate the daily travel of blind man. However, in reality, some blind sidewalks often become disrepair, which is not convenient for the blind man to recognize. Some blind sidewalks are also occupied, which brings certain danger to the daily travel of the blind man. To solve this problem, this paper presents a video image blind identification system based on FPGA. The system uses Altera's DE2 development board as a hardware platform, and collects images through the CMOS image sensor, and realizes the real-time monitoring and recognition of the blind road environment, and provides voice prompts for the dangerous sidewalk sections.

articleTitle: The optimal descaling frequency searching method for electromagnetic anti-scaling descaling device
abstract: At present, there is a lack of optimal searching method in the field of electromagnetic anti-scaling descaling; therefore the electromagnetic anti-scaling descaling device can not adjust its descaling frequency adaptively. Based on the analysis of working principle of the electromagnetic anti-scaling descaling device, we propose an optimal frequency searching method in this paper based on hysteresis comparison method. Due to the changes in conductivity value do reflect the effect of descaling, we use it as the main indicator of anti-scaling descaling performance. Considering the nonlinear relationship of conductivity and the alternating magnetic field in actual measurement, we give the anti-scaling descaling device a positive disturbance frequency and reverse the disturbance successively to form a hysteresis loop and record the changes of electrical conductivity around two disturbances. We use the rule of hysteresis frequency to determine the optimal frequency, until the frequency is fixed near the optimization frequency. After experimental validation, we find that not only the operation is simple, but also the evaluation time is short, the proposed method can search and track the optimal frequency to ensure maximum effect of electromagnetic anti-scaling descaling.

articleTitle: A semi-active fuzzy vibration control strategy on narrowband random excitation
abstract: Among the main high-tech facilities systems, precision-fabrication suffer from micro- strain vibration. Most of all, realistic vibration sources are variable in time and abundant in narrowband at random. This paper presents the design of a fuzzy controller for narrowband random vibration isolation system with semi-active isolator (magnetorheological elastomer). The performance of semi-active isolato r - s evaluated by sweep frequency test at zero field . A fuzzy controller is designed i n view of narro wbend random whibh is unpredicted. Then the experten is set up and the roo- mean square of response acceleration time doman and Power spectral density of that in frequency domain are analyzed in comparison with passive controller to verify the effectiveness of the designed controller. The experimental results demonstrate the designed fuzzy controller is superior and reliable for narrowband random vibration in application.

articleTitle: A sliding mode approach for uncertain markovian neutral-type singular systems
abstract: This paper investigates the sliding mode approach for a class of uncertain Markovian neutral-type singular systems. Sliding mode control synthesis is analysed via establishing a new integral sliding function. The control input is constructed such that the system states can reach the sliding mode surface in finite time, and then under the control input, a sufficient condition can be obtained by matrix inequality method that can guarantee the sliding mode dynamics to be asymptotically stochastic stable.

articleTitle: Pulse Doppler radar based on micro variation chaos genetic algorithm
abstract: The micro variation chaos genetic algorithm designed as a general optimization method was applied to the ambiguity resolution of pulse Doppler (PD) radar. The fitness, based on squared error for multi-PRF (pulse repeat frequency) consecutive ordered ranges, was designed. The crossover operator and the conditions of ending in GA were discussed. The relations among the probability of ambiguity resolution of this algorithm, the measurement error and the computational efficiency were analyzed. Simulation results show the ambiguity resolution algorithm does better than the sliding window algorithm on the probability of ambiguity resolution.

articleTitle: Pruning channels and fully convolutional deep learning based target detection
abstract: In this paper, a target detection method based on the Faster Regions-Convolutional Neural Network (Faster R-CNN) with pruning channels and fully convolutional network is proposed. Firstly, we use the Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO) regression to prune the redundant channels. Secondly, the linear least square method is used to minimize reconstruction error. Finally, fully convoluted VGG-16 network to share Region of Interest (ROI) calculations. Experimental results show that the proposed method has higher efficiency in target detection than other state-of-the-art method.

articleTitle: A multi-objective invasive weed optimization for task assignment in prefabricated systems
abstract: A novel discrete invasive weed optimization (DIWO) algorithms is proposed to solve the task assignment problems in the prefabricated systems. Three objectives are considered simultaneously, i.e., minimization of the total execution time, the total transportation cost and the total balance of execution time. In the proposed algorithm, a novel reproduction heuristic based on the p-optimality criteria is embedded to decide the number of offspring for each weed during the generation, which can obviously increase the searching quality and diversity of the algorithm. Moreover, five types of neighborhood structures are proposed to realize the dispatching mechanism in the canonical IWO algorithm, which can only applicable for the continuous optimization problems. Furthermore, to decrease the computational complexity, during each generation, the newly-generated weeds are stored and applied the non-dominated sorting algorithm to update the Pareto archive set. Detailed comparisons on the randomly-generated instances show the efficiency and diversity of the proposed DIWO algorithm.

articleTitle: Equivalences between quadratic admissibility and generalized quadratic stability for uncertain singular systems
abstract: The robust stability and robust stabilization of uncertain singular systems are more complicated than those for normal state-space systems. For norm bounded uncertain singular systems, there exist two different quadratic admissibility definitions. This paper considers the relationship of quadratic admissibility and so called generalized quadratic stability of uncertain continuous singular systems. The equivalence between the above definitions is proven. Furthermore, the new criteria of quadratic admissibility of closed loop system through feedback and quadratic stabilizability of uncertain continuous singular systems are obtained by the equivalence relationship. The criteria are directly solved the feasible solutions with LMI toolbox and are much more tractable and reliable in numerical computation than existing results which involve semi positive definite LMIs with equality constraints. Numerical example is given to show the effectiveness of the proposed approaches.

articleTitle: Process monitoring method based on improved dynamic multi-scale principal component analysis
abstract: A process monitoring approach based on improved multi-scale dynamic principal component analysis (IMSDPCA) is proposed to handle the multi-scale and dynamic characteristics of industrial process data. Augmented data matrix is structured by using the "time lag shift" method, and then multi-scale measurement characteristics of the wavelet is used to analyze the augmented matrix of the measuring variable in multiplicity scale. So the problem that the measuring variables have the dynamic and the multi-scale characteristics of industrial process data is not only resolved, but the shortcomings that the number of principal components is too much is overcome, on the basis of this, the monitoring index based on T<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and SPE is improved using. The simulation results of the Tennessee Eastman chemical process faults based on MSDPCA monitoring method shows that the IMSDPCA algorithm is feasible and effective, the process monitoring performance is improved compare with PCA and DPCA approach.

articleTitle: An improved implicit equal-weights particle filter
abstract: The implicit equal-weights particle filter (IEWPF) algorithm is developed to solve the problem of curse of dimensionality. Based on the implicit particle filter, the algorithm could estimate the high-dimensional state with the disturbance of the Gaussian white noise. In this paper, a new algorithm is proposed for extending the application of the IEWPF algorithm. New algorithm could switch the IEWPF algorithm and implicit particle filter depending on the ensemble size and dimension. Besides, the colored noise problem is converted into a Gaussian white noise problem in the new method. The improved algorithm is tested in the linear model, the Lorenz96 model and the target movement model based on the MSC coordinate system, compared with the primary IEWPF algorithm. The results is presented that the improved algorithm has better performance than the original IEWPF algorithm.

articleTitle: Improvement of industrial system identification by outlier detection
abstract: This paper focuses on improving data environment in the context of industrial process control. Considering the negative influence of outliers in target set, this paper proposes a novel outlier detection method named triSVDD, where three varying SVDD models are built successively. With data processed by triSVDD, performance of data-based techniques dedicating to system identification can be improved significantly. A realistic application, i.e. Transonic Wind Tunnel system is used to verify the significance of triSVDD in terms of system identification. Finally, performance with respect to only outlier detection is also investigated and compared with two well-known competitors.

articleTitle: Output-feedback stabilization of stochastic upper-triangular time-delay systems
abstract: This paper investigates the output-feedback stabilization problem for a class of stochastic upper-triangular time-delay systems. On the basis of stochastic time-delay system stability theory and homogeneous domination idea, by selecting a suitable Lyapunov-Krasoviskii functional and a low gain scale, an output-feedback controller is designed such that the closed-loop system is globally asymptotically stable in probability. The proposed design scheme is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Disparity map optimization based on edge detection
abstract: In stereo vision, disparity map after stereo matching using projection model can get the depth information and 3D information of the original image. In order to improve the accuracy and speed of stereo matching, improving the quality of disparity map becomes the core problem of stereo matching. Firstly, the paper extracted edge information of binocular images using Canny, Scharr and Sobel edge detection algorithm. On this basis, the paper use SGBM algorithm(Semi-global block Matching) and DP algorithm(Dynamic Programming)and CSCA algorithm(Cross-scale Cost Aggregation) respectively calculated the disparity map and its error rate. After analysis, the combination of Canny detection algorithm and CSCA algorithm can eliminate a large number of number of irrelevant information and reduce the amount of data processing. The real scene image is selected to validate the method .Based on the above research results, the method improved the quality of disparity map.

articleTitle: ADS adaptive sliding mode course controller with slow time-varying disturbance observer
abstract: During ADS underwater directional operation, the ADS system often encounters problems of external disturbances, parameter uncertainties and time-varying terms. An ADS adaptive sliding mode course controller based on disturbance observer is presented to solve these problems. The disturbance observer can eliminate slow time-varying system disturbance, and the adaptive sliding mode course controller can further compensate errors in order to meet the requirement for system course tracking performance. The dynamic model of ADS motion is introduced, then the design method for the adaptive sliding mode course controller based on disturbance observer is described in detail, and Lyapunov stability criterion is used to prove the system stability and convergence which is further testified by numerical simulation experiment. The simulation results show that the designed course controller has good robustness and achieves good controlling performance.

articleTitle: A car-following model considering two different time delays and stability analysis
abstract: Based on the different sensitivities as drivers to response for the space headway or the velocity difference between the following vehicle and the leading vehicle, this study proposes a new car-following (CF) model that considers two different time delays in sensing space headway and velocity. The stability analysis of the proposed CF model is performed using the perturbation method and the root locus method to obtain the stability condition. Simulation-based numerical experiments are conducted. Results show that the stable region of the proposed model varies with the difference between two different time delays.

articleTitle: Dynamic Output Feedback Control for Neutral Stochastic Delay Systems with Markovian Switching Parameters
abstract: This paper is concerned with the problem of exponential stabilization for neutral stochastic delay systems with Markovian switching parameters. Dynamic output feedback controllers with Markovian switching parameters are designed to ensure that the resulting closed-loop system is exponentially stable in mean square. Sufficient conditions for exponential stability of the closed-loop system are obtained in term of linear matrix inequalities(LMIs). A numerical example is provided to show the effectiveness of the proposed design methods.

articleTitle: The multi-innovation stochastic gradient method for double-frequency signals through dynamical sampled data
abstract: The study of this paper is to derive a parameter estimation method for double-frequency sine signals with the initial phase. In order to trace the time-varying of parameters, a sampling scheme of dynamical data is designed to collect the measured data. Moreover, a strategy of dynamical window data is devised for the purpose that more sampled data can be utilized at each recursion. Based on the negative gradient search, a gradient algorithm and a stochastic gradient algorithm are presented to estimate the signal parameters. For the purpose of improving the accuracy, a multi-innovation stochastic gradient algorithm is derived and applied to model the double-frequency sine signal with the initial phase. Finally, the numerical example is provided to confirm the performance of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Optimal low-thrust control for GEO satellite reorbiting based on gauss pseudo-spectral method
abstract: For the low-thrust problem of the GEO satellites reorbiting during the end of orbiting life, a planning method for optimizing propellant based on pseudo-spectral method is studied. First, the modified orbital elements are chosen as state variables, and the reorbiting problem of the GEO satellites is modeled as the optimal control problem. Furthermore, the optimal control problem is transformed into a non-linear parameter optimization problem based on the pseudo-spectral method. Finally, simulation results demonstrate the validity and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on trajectory planning and simulation of vehicle exterior wall grinding robot
abstract: At present, the domestic locomotive exterior wall putty layer grinding is still using manual mode of operation, this article locomotive vehicle putty layer automation dust-free grinding system based on grinding robot actual work space size, and the working space of the selected robotic arm of ABB-IRB-6660-205/1.9 is calculated by statistical simulation method. The kinematics equation of the grinding robot is established by D-H coordinate transformation method, and the positive and negative solutions of the robot are obtained. On the basis of kinematics, the 5-Lagrangian interpolation polynomial method is used to simulate the motion path of the grinding robot. Using the Robot Tool toolbox in Matlab, the displacement, velocity and acceleration of each joint of the robot are simulated and simulated. It provides the theoretical basis and reference for the research on the dynamics of the motorcycle body grinding robot, the complex space trajectory, the motion control algorithm and the obstacle avoidance of the robot.

articleTitle: Efficiency analysis of public cultural services organizations in poverty areas
abstract: In the construction of modern public cultural service system with Chinese characteristics, the most arduous and heaviest task is in poverty areas. In this paper, 21 provinces with key counties for poverty alleviation and development are selected as decision reference sets. DEA is used to calculate the comprehensive efficiency, pure technical efficiency and scale efficiency of public cultural services of in above provinces. Insufficient output and input redundancy adjustment also analyzed. The results show that the comprehensive efficiency value of public cultural services is low; the output of public cultural services is insufficient and the input redundancy coexist; but the efficiency of providing public cultural services in the less poor counties is lower. It is concluded that promoting poverty alleviation by culture in the densely populated areas will provide more help for precision poverty alleviation.

articleTitle: Research on rapid modeling method and simulation platform of the gas-steam combined cycle system
abstract: Aiming at the gas-steam combined cycle system models with complex algorithm structures, the single algorithm simulation software cannot build a friendly man-machine interface. Existing hybrid programming methods that combine MATLAB tools and the foreground interface are restricted by the algebraic loop structure in models and are not able to be applied. A distributed modeling and simulation platform with self-defined interfaces is proposed, which utilizes database as a medium to realize data storage and interaction between the server and clients. And implementation in the gas-steam combined cycle system showed that the proposed platform gave full play to advantages of rapid prototyping's fast iteration, complex control computing capability and the environment-friendly clients' interface. The proposed platform holds effective real-time simulation, strong confidentiality, flexibility, and versatility, which satisfies mass data's simulation and storage need for multiple clients.

articleTitle: Filter-based tracking of magnetic levitation ball system
abstract: The tracking control problem of magnetic levitation ball system is considered in this paper. Based on Lagrange-Maxwell equation, the nonlinear dynamic model of levitation ball system is obtained. Three types of nonlinear tracking control strategies: position-velocity-flux feedback, position-velocity feedback and position feedback are proposed by using backstepping method. In all cases, we choose the favorable initial value to ensure that all signals of the closed-loop system are bounded and track errors tend to zero. Simulations are performed to demonstrate the performance of the control strategies.

articleTitle: A semantic trust model of large scale distributed system based on Ontology
abstract: With the in-depth research of large-scale distributed application systems, the traditional software system ecology has shifted from closed relative static form to open, shared and publicly accessible dynamic collaborative service mode. The original trust model has been unable to adapt to the identification of new system security problems, so the research of the dynamic trust model has become a hot spot. In this paper, we propose a large scale distributed system trust model (LSDM) based ontology based large-scale distributed system semantic trust model, which aims to describe the interaction behaviors between entities, and give consideration to the sharing and scalability of models. On the other hand, the RBTM trust calculation method is proposed to improve the recognition rate of the model based on LSDM.

articleTitle: Endgame database for Dots-and-Boxes game
abstract: Endgame database is a popular technology that can be used to enhance the performance of various tree search-based methods such as Minimax algorithm and Monte Carlo Tree Search. In this paper, we present a method for creating the endgame database of Dots-and-Boxes game, and we test whether it is available to enhance the performance of some popular tree search-based methods in Dots-And-Boxes game.

articleTitle: Synchronization for complex networks with randomly occurring coupling delays via passivity
abstract: This paper deals with the synchronization problem for complex networks under the passivity framework. In particular, the randomly occurring coupling delays are taken into account to describe more complicated dynamics in the real world. By means of stochastic analysis, delay-dependent sufficient synchronization criteria can be given for ensuring the desired passivity performance by matrix techniques. With the established conditions being satisfied, the designing procedure for the synchronization controller is proposed. Finally, we give an illustrative example for illustrating the efficiency of our synchronization strategy.

articleTitle: Multi-granularity rough set and measure based on weighted granularity on the dual universes
abstract: Considering attribute weight and universe expansion, lower and upper approximation operators on dual universes are presented. And multi-granularity rough set model on the dual universes is proposed. Some properties of the multi-granularity rough set model on the dual universes is discussed considering different weighted granularity. Then, roughness and precision factor for multi-granularity rough set model on the dual universes are introduced to measure the uncertainty of the information system. Also, properties about the relation between information granular and subset in information system are researched.

articleTitle: Research on modular evaluation system of computer game code
abstract: Traditional computer games require participants to write the complete program code. They run their own program code on their own computers. In the condition of similar algorithmic function efficiency, if a participant uses a faster processor or larger memory, then he has more chances to win. Even looking at the interface of the other program and the slow input operation will put the player at a disadvantage. This paper describes the design and implementation of modular evaluation system of computer game code. It makes the game algorithm program which has the similar function or efficiency will not affect the outcome by unrelated operations. And participants do not need to write a complete program, including input and output, which not only reducing the difficulty of getting started, but also help to promote the computer game scientific research to gain popularity in more colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Different-Level Dynamic Quadratic Minimization Using Square Root Matrix Based Zhang Equivalency
abstract: For quadratic minimization (QM), it is usually assumed that the solution objective is time-invariant and at the same level. However, the QM is always time-varying (i.e., naturally and implicitly dynamic) and may be at different levels (i.e., explicitly dynamic) in practice. In this paper, different from the general QM, a novel different-level dynamic QM (DLDQM) is proposed and investigated. First, the DLDQM solving is split up into two general time-varying QM (TVQM) solving. Then, a solution model is thus proposed and investigated for the DLDQM, by applying square root matrix based Zhang equivalency and Moore-Penrose (MP) generalized inverse. In addition, it is worth pointing out that solving the DLDQM is a new and important attempt of this research. Finally, illustrative numerical experiments are conducted with numerical results presented and analyzed.

articleTitle: Correlation analysis of haze governance influencing factors and regulation mechanism in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region
abstract: The degrees of association among haze and impact factors determine the correct judgment and grasp the decision-making path of haze governance. This paper uses the gray correlation method of system theory comparative analyze relevance factors of haze in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region. Higher absolute correlation degree of industrial structure and haze in Beijing province, and highest association of population and haze in Tianjin area and Hebei province; The relative degree of grey incidence between haze and population is highest in Beijing, the relative degree of financial development and haze in Tianjin area is highest, Hebei province urbanization rate is the highest; the comprehensive degree industry structure associated with haze is the highest in Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei province urbanization rate is the highest comprehensive correlation with haze. It can be seen that the economic development stage and economic development situation is different, Haze problems in Tianjin and Hebei have similar places so Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei regions need to take a coordinated haze governance policy. Finally, the paper discusses the haze governance strategies and suggestions for the future green development of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region on the basis of the results of this study aiming at the coordinated development of green transformation and coordination in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, and promotes the innovation of urban agglomeration development theory and planning practice.

articleTitle: Non-fragile consensus control for nonlinear stochastic multi-agent systems with uniform quantizations
abstract: In this paper, the non-fragile consensus control problem is discussed for a class of discrete time-varying multi-agent systems with stochastic nonlinearities and uniform quantizations. The designed output feedback controller depends on the measurement outputs of a agent itself and its adjacent agents via a given topology, where the uniform quantizations are used to characterize the information transmissions between adjacent agents. The definition of mean- square quasi-consensus is employed to reflect the characteristics of consensus behavior in random case and the controller gain variations are model by the multiplicative noises. We focus on the design of non-fragile output feedback controller such that the consensus performance satisfies the pre-specified upper bound constraint at each sampling instant. By using the linear matrix inequality technique, sufficient conditions are derived to ensure the desired performance requirements and the existence of the controller gain. In addition, the optimal consensus performance is obtained by solving an optimization problem. Finally, a simulation example is utilized to illustrate the usefulness of the proposed non-fragile control method.

articleTitle: On - line Real - time Evaluation of Urban Power Grid Recovery Ability
abstract: The concept of recovery ability evaluation is firstly proposed in the field of distribution power grid fault recovery of this paper. Recovery ability evaluation refers to the ability of the fault distribution power grid to return to the basic normal power supply and the evaluation of the time and resources needed in the period to restore the power grid to the normal state. The evaluation has the characteristics of real-time and dynamic, which is of great significance to the timely and effective reduction of the economic loss of equipment and users, the determination of accident grade and the establishment of real-time optimal recovery strategy. In this paper, an online real-time evaluation model of distribution network recovery ability based on Multi-Agent is established. It includes three Agent Alliances, which are the recovery ability Index, the environment of the power grid and the disaster-bearing body Alliance. Furthermore, the index weights are changed in real time, which guarantee the real-time and dynamic of the recovery ability assessment of the power network. Finally, the reliability and applicability of the results are verified by an example.

articleTitle: Robust Visual Tracker via Cascade Classifying
abstract: Since the similar background interference and target occlusion, the result of many visual trackers occurred deviation and even lost the target. In this paper, we proposed a robust visual tracker combing with the results of object tracking and target identification to make our algorithm more robust. To do this, we use the cascade classifier to improve the performance of target identification algorithm, then adjust the consequence of object tracking algorithm which based on particle filter. Experiment results show that our method tracks target fast and robustly, and outperform the state-of-the-art tracking methods.

articleTitle: Design of an embedded multi-antenna satellite data acquisition system based on ARM-Linux
abstract: The Global Positioning System (GPS) can provides high-precision positioning information. The GPS information of multi-antenna satellite data is acquired for attitude measurement. An embedded multi-antenna satellite data acquisition system is designed in this paper. This system adopts binary protocol of GPS receiver. Compared to the NMEA protocol, the binary protocol can acquire more comprehensive raw data such as pseudo range and signal-to-noise ratio for satellite navigation. The hardware of the system is based on AM335x ARM Cortex A8 microcontroller and consists of four GPS receiver unit (NV08C-CSM). The software of the system is based on the embedded Linux operating system and the multi-channel data acquisition programs are designed. The experiments were conducted many times. The results show that the system provide GPS raw data properly for attitude measurement, which meets the requirements of precision. The size of the hardware platform is small (10×10cm) and easy to apply in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), Unmanned surface vehicles (USV), etc.

articleTitle: Research on eigenvalue analysis method in metal shell vibratory gyro
abstract: The metal shell vibratory gyro is a branch of coriolis vibratory gyro, which has the advantage of overload resistance, simplify structure, low cost, wide range and long life. This paper focuses on multi-surface metal resonator. It is important that the eigenvalue analysis of multi-surface of hemisphere, cylinder and hyperbolic. Through analysis multi-surface characteristic, it presents a novel orthogonal curvilinear coordinate used machine error factor based on the traditional coordinate, which realizes boundary linear. We analyze its natural vibration characteristics, research on basic model distribution and built Resonator's function of resonator; deeply research on dynamics characteristics of resonator under the condition of angular rate input, establish dynamics equation of multi-surface fusion metal shell resonant gyroscope based on thin shell mechanics theory of elastic mechanics, solve out the eigenvalue of the resonator.

articleTitle: Improved results of changing supply functions and the applications to nonlinear systems in cascade
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of changing supply functions in nonlinear systems. A dissipation inequality for the derivative of a storage function is introduced to describe the behavior of the systems. The dissipation inequality is allowed to hold only in a compact set and/or with some bounded functions. Then the results on modifying the involved functions are provided. Moreover, the obtained results are applied to the cascaded integral input-to-state stable systems. It is showed that, by some proper assumptions on the functions of dissipation inequality, the integral input-to-state stability of the cascaded systems could be inherited from the property of each subsystem.

articleTitle: Tracking control for helicopters with input stochastic perturbation
abstract: In this paper, the flight control problem for helicopters is investigated under input stochastic perturbation. The unmeasurable states of the helicopter are estimated by a state observer. Then, combining the estimated states with the other measurable states of the helicopter, a state feedback controller is designed. In the controller design, the input stochastic perturbation is considered. By applying the designed controller, the helicopter is maintaining a hovering state at the predefined positions and yaw angle. In order to guarantee the stochastic stability of the closed-loop system, a sufficient condition is presented by using the theory of stochastic differential equation, Lyapunov stability method and linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) technique. Finally, the simulation is given to show the effectiveness of the proposed results.

articleTitle: Design of automatic handling robot control system
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of cargo handling and reduce the labor intensity of human beings, a handling robot system that can recognize ribbons, recognize signposts and automatically charge is designed. The core of control system is based on the server and the basic controller. The optical reading head senses the position of the robot. The servo motor provides the power for the robot to walk. The jacking motor assists the robot to handling the goods. The fuzzy control method is used to control the differential steering of the robot's two-wheel. The experimental results indicate that the control system is stable, safe and reliable, and it has good control performance.

articleTitle: Attitude-constrained feedback control for spacecraft reorientation under actuator saturation and compound disturbance
abstract: The attitude-constrained reorientation maneuver problem in the presence of actuator saturation, parametric uncertainty, and external disturbance is investigated. An empirical-trial-free parameter-selection-method for the existence-conditions of the repulsive-potential-function is proposed, which enhances the universality of the potential- function-based controller and is able to avoid unnecessary detour during the maneuver process. In addition, an auxiliary system driven by the difference between the untreated command torque and the upper bound of the actuator torque is presented. Using the auxiliary system, the designed backstepping controller is able to guarantee the system stability without actuator saturation violation. In order to achieve real-time compensation of the compound disturbance consisting of parametric uncertainty and external disturbance, an extended state observer with finite time convergence is put forward. Thus, the ESO-based backstepping controller obtains a better performance on robustness and accuracy. Finally, simulations are carried out to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Commodity 3D display based on point cloud reconstruction
abstract: Commodity display is very important in online shopping. In this paper, a method of reconstructing the commodity 3D model is proposed. Firstly, this paper accepts point clouds of a commodity from different angles. Secondly, before initial alignment, this paper compresses point clouds based on octree. Thirdly, this paper aligns all point clouds. At last, we reconstruct the commodity surface. In this step, a point cloud smoothing algorithm based on MLS and a Delaunay growth projection algorithm are proposed. Experimental results demonstrate that the computation time consumed by our improved registration algorithm is only one sixth of that of traditional one. And the quality only decreases slightly. The commodity 3D model has been successfully and efficiently reconstructed.

articleTitle: Robust non-fragile H∞ control for nonlinear uncertain discrete systems with time-delays in state and input
abstract: This paper is concerned with the robust stability problem for a class of nonlinear uncertain discrete system with both states and input delays. The robust non-fragile Hœ controller with time-delay and uncertainties in the system parameters is designed. The uncertainties are norm-bounded and the states of the uncertain systems are available. Based on Lyapunov function method, some criteria are established to ensure the asymptotic stability and disturbance attenuation for the uncertain systems. The linear matrix inequality (LMI) optimization approach is used to solve the H∞ control disturbance attenuation problem. The significant improvement results for the uncertain discrete systems have been reached. The software Matlab can be applied to solve the proposed linear matrix inequality. Finally, numerical example is given to illustrate the improvement validity in this paper.

articleTitle: Non-fragile H∞ filter design for two-dimensional foransini-marchesini systems
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of non-fragile H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> filter design for two-dimensional systems. This filter has interval-type gain variation, which means that it cannot be fully performed. Firstly, by Finslers'lemma, the nonfragile filter design has been formulated as a robust convex optimization problem, which is solved by the classic vertex algorithm. It should be noticed that, for high dimensional systems, the number of LMIS involved is so large that it may be over the processing capacity of Matlab LMI Toolbox. To solve this difficulty, an efficient randomized algorithm is proposed. This algorithm can reduce the number of LMI conditions significantly. Finally, a numerical example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An improved siding mode controller in PMSM control system for smoother speed response and stronger robustness
abstract: The PI controller in the Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) control system has the disadvantages of weak robustness and poor anti-interference ability, therefore the Sliding Mode Control (SMC) is proposed to improve the control effect and enhance the robustness of the system. However, the switching control part in the design of the traditional sliding mode controller is usually switched by the sign function, which can make the chattering phenomenon arise in the system. In order to reduce the chattering and further improve the control performance of the PMSM, a saturation function was proposed in this paper to replace the sign function to reduce the chattering phenomenon on the sliding surface. The simulation results obtained in the Matlab/Simulink show that the improved sliding mode controller can improve both the dynamic performance and anti-interference ability of the PMSM control system.

articleTitle: Novel robust stability criteria for interval time-varying delay systems with nonlinear perturbations
abstract: In this paper, the problem of delay dependent robust stability for a class of interval time-varying delay systems with nonlinear perturbations is studied. Based on the idea of delay-partitioning method (DPM), the whole delay interval is divided into two unequal subintervals at appropriate point and a new Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional (LKF) which contains some quadruple-integral terms and augment terms is introduced on each interval. Then, a new bounding technique based on a novel integral inequality approach together with reciprocally convex combination technique is used to deal with the cross term of the derivative. Hence, an enhanced delay-dependent stability criterion is derived in terms of linear matrix inequality (LMI). Finally, the numerical simulation results show that the proposed method is effective and less conservative.

articleTitle: Hopf bifurcation of fractional-order small-world networks with time delay
abstract: The applicability of small-world networks, which has been significantly extended, is considered in this paper. To obtain more practical solutions, a fractional-order model applied to small-world networks has been firstly tested. The results provide that the time delay assumed as bifurcation parameter can noticeably influence on the dynamics of small-world networks. Moreover, the effects of the fractional order on the stability and bifurcation of the model are performed. In the end, we use the numerical simulation to support the correctness of our theoretical results.

articleTitle: Fuzzy sliding mode projective synchronization of HX-type hyperchaotic Liu system with disturbances
abstract: In this paper, we first give the HX-type hyperchaotic Liu system based on fuzzy inference modelling. Then for the switching system with disturbaces, we theoretically investigate the projective synchronization by using active sliding mode control. For weakening chattering phenomenon, a fuzzy system is introduced. Numerical simulations are provided to verify the effectiveness of the control methods. By comparison of the numerical results, the fuzzy sliding mode control can weaken chattering effectively.

articleTitle: The application of convolutional neural networks in bidding price estimation decision
abstract: In the daily bidding activities, the bid price is estimated by using qualitative and quantitative predicting methods, which are usually poor in accuracy and efficiency. In this paper, we introduce a method based on the Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for the bid price estimation decision. We collect the historical bidding price data from similar projects and then form a time series according to the order of the project start time to extract deep CNN features, and finally, these deep features are used to make bidding decision. We demonstrate that the learned deep models will help the decision makers to get the trend of project quotation and improve the bid winning probability and competitiveness of the bidder.

articleTitle: Delay-dependent state estimation criteria for uncertain neural networks via parameter-dependent Lyapunov functional
abstract: This paper is concerned with the problem of observer-based state estimation for delayed neural networks with polytopic parameter uncertainties and time-varying delay. The aim is to estimate the neuron states, through available output measurements, such that the dynamics of the estimation error is globally robustly stable. A delay-dependent and parameter-dependent robust stability criterion for the existence of the desired estimators of the delayed neural networks for all admissible parametric uncertainties are established using a parameter-dependent Lyapunov functional, the S-procedure and taking the relationship between the terms in the Leibniz-Newton formula into account.

articleTitle: Improved Novel Global Harmony Search Optimization for Robust Pole Assignment in Descriptor Systems
abstract: To improve the optimization performance of harmony search algorithm, an improved novel global harmony search (INGHS) algorithm with new improvisation process is proposed in this paper. INGHS algorithm is presented to address robust pole assignment for descriptor system with all the finite poles restrict in an arbitrary specified circular region. The object is converted into a nonlinear optimization problem with constraints for the transient performance request. In terms of the robust circular region stability constraints, the upper bound of the spectral norm for the perturbation or the uncertainty is optimized such that the desired poles of the closed-loop system and the state feedback controller can be optimized simultaneously. To evaluate the performance of the proposed INGHS algorithm, comparison with other harmony search variants algorithm for the problem is carried out. Finally, the simulation results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on noise locating of diesel engine block based on microphone array
abstract: In order to achieve diesel abnormal sound positioning, an abnormal sound pressure signal of a diesel engine is acquired through a NI data acquisition system of a planar microphone array. The SRC-PHAT (Stochastic Region Contraction Phase Transform Weighed) method was used to establish the initial search space region, and the Steered Response Power (SRP) at the randomly selected point in the region was calculated. The coordinates of the SRP maximum point were selected by iterative iteration, which was different noise. The source coordinate estimate. The experimental results show that this method has good accuracy for the location of impact noise and provides a reference for the location of abnormal noise in the engine block.

articleTitle: A real-time tracking prediction for maneuvering target
abstract: According to the needs of real-time tracking maneuvering targets, by introducing the tracking principle of maneuvering target, the Gaussian algorithm and wavelet filtering are combined to remove the influence of interference, and the data of the maneuvering target is subjected to data fitting and landing site prediction analysis to obtain the target maneuvering trajectory and find the coordinates of the target location.
