Simulation results show that the real-time tracking method can effectively track the maneuvering target and basically achieve the goal of target tracking.

articleTitle: Observer-based attitude tracking control for near space vehicle with output constraint
abstract: The paper proposes a backstepping method based on disturbance observer for near space vehicle with output constraints and unknown disturbance. A barrier Lyapupnov function is applied to the design of controllers, which guarantees the output constraint is not violated. Next, nonlinear disturbance observer is used to estimate the unknown disturbance. Then dynamic surface control is employed to the system, which avoids "explosion of complexity" in traditional backstepping. Finally, the simulation results prove that the control scheme proposed is effective.

articleTitle: Secure support vector machines with data perturbation
abstract: In view of the increasing demand for privacy protection, traditional data mining process has to be optimized when the data owners are usually unwilling to release their original data for analysis. Aiming at the data classification in data mining, we have proposed CI-SVM (Condensed Information-Support Vector Machine) algorithm to achieve safe and efficient data classification. In this paper, the RCI-SVM (Random Linear Transformation with Condensed Information-Support Vector Machine) algorithm is proposed to use random linear transformation to convert the condensed information to another random vector space. The compressed information in CI-SVM are obtained by clustering the original data, although it is possible to ensure that the accurate original information will not be exposed, to some extent they may still carry some characteristics of the original datasets. Unlike most of the existing data perturbations, due to the early information enrichment processing, RCI-SVM will not preserve the dot product and Euclidean distance relationship between the original datasets and the transformed datasets, which means it's stronger than existing methods in security. Our experiment results on datasets show that the proposed RCI-SVM algorithm can performs well on classification efficiency and security.

articleTitle: Event-triggered real-time scheduling stabilization of fuzzy systems via a new weighted matrix approach
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a new method to reduce the conservativeness of real-time scheduling stabilization for nonlinear systems in terms of T-S fuzzy model. Different from the previous method, a more relaxed stability condition of nonlinear systems is proposed via one weighted matrix approach. This paper adopts a so-called maximum-priority- based control law, which uses the more useful information than those previous results. That is to say, the control law has considered the different roles of the normalized fuzzy weight function at each time instant. Finally, the simulation results of a simple and typical nonlinear system model are provided to further illustrate the effectiveness of this proposed method.

articleTitle: Robust Non-fragile L1 Filtering for Networked Control Systems with Stochastic Missing Measurements and Random Delays
abstract: This paper investigates the robust non-fragile L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> filtering problem for network control systems (NCSs) with stochastic missing measurements and random delays. The filter parameters perturbation is indicated the filter implementation uncertainties. Attention is focused on design of the robust non-fragile L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> filter that ensures the filtering error system to be mean-square asymptotically stable and satisfies the worst case peak-to-peak gain of the filtering error system for the negative influence of both missing measurements and time delays in a random way. In the system, all of the stochastic variables are mutually independent satisfying the Bernoulli distribution. Using linear matrix inequality (L-MI) technology, the parameterization issue of the filter is transformed into a convex optimization problem. A numerical example is provided to demonstrate the effectiveness and applicability of the proposed design approach.

articleTitle: T-S fuzzy control with parameter estimation for three-phase active power filter
abstract: In this paper, active power filter is modeled based on T-S fuzzy theory to reduce the computational burden of the traditional method, and the fuzzy controller is constructed according to the principle of parallel distributed compensation. In view of the fact that T-S model parameters is difficult to obtain and vulnerable to external disturbance and parameter perturbation, an adaptive fuzzy controller with parameter estimation (AFCPE) is designed to ensure parameter estimation error asymptotically converges to zero and improve the reliability of the system and the robustness to parameter variations. The parameters are derived from the Lyapunov stability analysis to guarantee tracking performance and stability of the closed-loop system. Simulation studies in the MATLAB/SimPower Systems Toolbox demonstrate that the proposed control methods offer a good behavior in both steady state and transient operation during balanced and unbalanced load.

articleTitle: Adaptive intelligent detection based on 6-DOF manipulator
abstract: In this paper, a feedback linearization control for trajectory tracking of 6-DOF robotic manipulator is proposed, which can realize the dynamic tracking of a given angle trajectory. The high-precision laser tracker is used to measure the spatial pose, including position and orientation, of tested sample. And the pose sequence is considered as the expected value of the end effector going through. An interpolation method is proposed for the sake of smooth transition of poses. Then the pose trajectory is converted to joint angle trajectory by using inverse kinematics, which is regarded as the expected value of dynamics system of robotic manipulator. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Design of human eye information detection system
abstract: At present, many scholars are committed to the study of fatigue detection system, and many effective methods have been put forward. This paper examines condition of the driver based on the condition of the eyes, and the image processing technology is used to identify the driver's fatigue status in time and warn him of his continued driving. According to the particularity of system application, the non-contact, accurate and real-time fatigue detection system based on human eye information is designed under natural lighting conditions. Eye-positioning and tracking throughout the fatigue detection system is the key to the system. However, if the human eye is directly detected and located in the entire image, not only the background noise of the humanoid eye but also the accuracy of the system is affected, and because of the large detection range, the real-time performance of the system cannot be guaranteed. Therefore, the paper detects the face area in the whole image and then further locate the human eye and track it in this small area.

articleTitle: Research on position synchronization system control of internal high pressure forming machine based on WinCC
abstract: Both sides of the level hydraulic cylinder on internal high pressure forming machine position synchronous system control is one of the key technologies for Internal high pressure forming system, control performance directly affects the production efficiency and product quality. Based on this problem, multivariate coordinated control simulation test platform is be seted up. Mainly includes the control scheme design, control system hardware and software design. The Siemens S7-300 PLC has been as the main controller, WinCC as the upper computer software. Finally based on FM355C module position synchronization control experiment was carried out by the PID algorithm. the experiment result shows that, in the slope under the condition of smaller FM355C position synchronization control effect is good, the system can meet the production requirements of internal high pressure forming.

articleTitle: Millimeter wave radar simulator transmitting power test system design
abstract: Transmitting power is an important parameter of the radar simulator. This paper designs a transmitting power test system for millimeter wave radar simulator. With the gradienter and the rotary index table, the simulator is capable to achieve perfect alignment with the receiving antenna in 3D space. The laser rangefinder measures the range between the simulator and the receiving antenna accurately. When the simulator transmits power, the receiving antenna, which is connected to the digital spectrograph, receives the transmitting signal. After the spectrograph measures the frequency and power of the signal, the results are input into the embedded industrial computer. Finally, the system software is designed based on the embedded industrial computer that implements the automatic management of the whole test process. After acquire the test data from laser rangefinder and the digital spectrograph, the transmitting power of the simulator can be computed. Test result shows that the test system possesses such good performances as convenient operation and perfect alignment.

articleTitle: Global integral sliding mode control for ultra-low-altitude airdrop in extraction parachute failure state
abstract: To reduce the impact on the flight safety and the airdrop mission completion from the extraction parachute failure, a novel controller based on the global integral sliding mode control is designed. Firstly, the open-loop characteristic of the carrier in extraction parachute failure state is analyzed. Then, the system is decoupled and linearized using the nonlinear linearization theories of input-output feedback. On this basis, by applying the two-rank iterative global integral sliding mode control, we design the inner loop for velocity control and pitch control. Combining the inner loop control with the outer loop PID control for flight-altitude, we build the entire flight control system which improves the dynamic performance of the system. Finally, simulation results show that the controllers have strong robustness for fault state.

articleTitle: Construction Pruning for Optimal Control of Process with Deadtime under Extreme High Degree of Control Difficulty
abstract: The control of process with deadtime has always been a challenging performance specification for industry process control, especially when the degree of control difficulty is high. The control of process with deadtime under extreme high degree of control difficulty is seldom touched up to now. This paper explored the load disturbance rejection control and robustness of this kind of process based on the limitation analysis and construction pruning of twice optimum control. The control simulation and analysis on the control of a first order process with deadtime under the degree of control difficulty of 50 shows that the proposed method has stronger ability of disturbance suppression and stronger robustness when the model parameters have uncertainties compared with the twice optimum control method, the PI controller with Smith Predictor and a kind of Oscillation Reduction Controller with Smith Predictor and ESO. The proposed method had the advantages of simple structure, ease of parameter tuning and good performance on the setpoint tracking, load disturbance rejection and strong robustness.

Author Keywords: Extreme high degree of control difficulty

articleTitle: Temperature prediction and evaluation of mill based on neural network
abstract: The inlet and outlet temperature of the mill is an important index in the process of slag powder production. The specific technological process of the production of slag powder is introduced, and the factors that influence the inlet and outlet temperature of the mill are analyzed. The actual data of production process is preprocessed by the Pauta criterion. The forecasting model of inlet and outlet temperature of mill is established to predict the temperature in an hour by using the basic BP neural network and BP neural network optimized by mind evolutionary algorithm. Through the simulation of Matlab software, the prediction effect diagram, prediction error chart, prediction mean square error, mean absolute error, mean absolute percentage error, and coefficient of decision of the two algorithms are compared. The results show that the BP neural network optimized by mind evolutionary algorithm is better than the original BP neural network in the prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: A study on the cooperation game between china and southeast asian nations under the "the Belt and Road"
abstract: Under the "The Belt and Road" strategy, China and Southeast Asian Nations have broad prospects for cooperation. By analyzing the cooperative behavior, the article sums up the characteristic factors of value, trust, necessary resource input and resource integration according to the logical sequence. By introducing the trust index and cooperation degree index, this paper establishes a cooperative game model under the condition of the same trust index and different trust index. And use MATLAB to carry on the quantitative analysis, through the analysis of the results of China's cooperation with the Southeast Asian Nations, some suggestions are put forward.

articleTitle: Generative model of bid sequences in lowest unique bid auctions
abstract: Lowest unique bid auction (LUBA) sites are gaining popularity on the Internet in recent years. In this paper, we study LUBA with resubmission in discrete bid spaces. A long-standing goal in the field of Internet auction is to develop agents that can perceive and understand the strategy information behind the mechanism and can guide us to behave in a fast, frugal and smart way. We marry ideas from recurrent neural network and data to learn a generative model for generating winning bid sequences. A sequence of winning bids in Internet auctions can be viewed as a sequence of events and modeled by generative models. We learn a model that is able to capture the long dependencies in a winning bid sequence. The generated data obtained from our model and the ground truth dataset share similar distributions.

articleTitle: Finite-time transmission projective synchronization of multiple different chaotic systems with unknown parameters via adaptive control
abstract: In this study, problems of finite-time transmission projective synchronization of multiple different chaotic systems with unknown parameters are investigated using adaptive control methods. The adaptive laws are derived to estimate unknown parameters of systems. The nonlinear adaptive controllers are designed to guarantee finite-time stability of the error systems so that all chaotic systems can projective synchronization with each other. Finally, a numerical example is presented to demonstrate the effectiveness and validity of the obtained results.

articleTitle: Model reference adaptive fault-tolerant control for a class of uncertain linear time-delayed systems with actuator failures
abstract: In this paper, the model reference adaptive fault-tolerant control (AFTC) scheme is developed for a class of uncertain linear systems with multiple time delays and actuator failures. Based on the model reference matching condition, a novel variable gain fault-tolerant controller with the corresponding adaptive parameter updated laws is designed to effectively compensate for the actuator faults and time-delayed perturbations. By using the Lyapunov stability theory, it is proved that all the closed-loop signals are uniformly bounded, and the state tracking error can asymptotically converge to zero. Simulation results are provided to verify the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Study on the Technology of LVRT for DFIG
abstract: This paper presents the development of the wind power system and low voltage ride through (LVRT) techniques for doubly -fed induction generator (DFIG) wind energy system. In recent years, wind power has been developing rapidly. As the wind power penetration from large scale wind turbines has been increasing rapidly in the transmission system, there is a higher requirement for the frequency stability and power generation efficiency of the wind power generation system, and the power grid puts forward higher continuous operation requirements for the grid connected wind turbine in the power grid fault and demand that the wind power generator has to ride through the grid faults, especially the grid voltage dips. This overview mainly introduces DFIG and low voltage ride through technology in the wind power generation system. This paper introduces respectively their development, control strategies and future trend.

articleTitle: A novel air quality evaluation method based on AP clustering and VAE model
abstract: At present, we assess the air quality levels based on AQI which requires complex calculations and cannot evaluate the air quality comprehensively and effectively. Our air quality evaluation method not only can cluster air quality data precisely, but also can identify the air quality using unsupervised learning without any prior knowledge. We collect 2600 days' of air pollutants data from Baoding, Suzhou and Sanya which are clustered into 11 categories. A comparison between our clustering results and the air quality levels according to the traditional algorithm has been made. Moreover, we can identify a new air quality data set with the accuracy of about 96.5% based on variational autoencoder (VAE) model. This research will help people assess the air quality with air pollutants indexes more conveniently and scientifically.

articleTitle: Successive Approximation Optimal Control for A Class of Chaotic Systems
abstract: In this paper, successive approximation approach for optimal control of the equilibrium states of the Lorenz system is presented. We first formulate the equations of perturbed state of Lorenz equilibrium states problem and a sequence of linear two-point boundary value problem. A suboptimal control law is obtained by using iteration of the nonlinear compensation sequence of perturbed equation. The suboptimal control functions can successfully suppress arbitrary initial states to equilibrium states and achieve the stability. Finally, computational simulations of optimal control for equilibrium stabilization of Lorenz system are provided to illustrate the results.

articleTitle: Adaptive dual model differential evolution algorithm based on cloud model
abstract: To solve the problem of premature convergence and search stagnation in traditional differential algorithm, this paper presents an adaptive dual model differential evolution algorithm based on cloud model (ADDEC). The variation model of ADDEC is produced by combining basic variation with cloud variation. And the adaptive operators are referenced respectively for scale factor and interactive probability during the operation of variation and crossover. The robustness and the convergence rate of the algorithm are enhanced. Moreover the relationship between global search and local search of the algorithm is improved. The diversity of the population is guaranteed at the same time. It is tested by typical high dimension benchmark function and compared with other algorithms, and the results show that the ADDEC has better precision, high convergence speed and makes it easy to jump out the local optimal solution.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of the control system for magnetorheological suspension of all-terrain vehicle
abstract: Magneto-rheological (MR) semi-active control technique is a promising research topic of the intelligent suspension. In this paper, the control system for magneto-rheological suspension of domestic all-terrain vehicle (ATV)was entirely designed by incorporating the skyhook algorithm into DSP controllers, signal processing filters, analog-to-digital conversion circuits, and current drivers. Then the vehicle road test of ATV suspension using MR dampers in the place of hydraulic dampers. The results showed that the controller is significant to attenuate the root mean square (RMS) acceleration responses at the seat cushion. Consequently, the presented control system can effectively improve the comfort of passengers and achieve the desired control objectives.

articleTitle: Optimal replenishment policy for items with imperfect quality and shortages under permissible delay in payments
abstract: One of unrealistic assumptions in classical EOQ model is that the items received are all good quality. In real life, it is very difficult for all the products received to achieve a 100% qualified rate due to various imperfect production or transportation processes, which has effect on determining the order size and related inventory control parameters. In addition, nowadays trade credit is widespread and become an important form of company finance. Supplier realizes that retailers are interested to buy more items if they are offered some credit periods to pay the whole cost of items instead of paying immediately. This paper extends the work of Chung and Huang [29] by considering that shortages are allowed and occur as lost sales where the loss of stock out and the salvage of the residue are counted into the cost. An inventory model optimizing the retailer's expected profit per unit time is established under permissible delay in payments. Three theorems are developed to derive the optimal replenishment policy. Finally, sensitivity analysis on main parameters is given by numerical examples.

articleTitle: Fourth party logistics network design considering satisfaction of supply-side and demand-side
abstract: Fourth party logistics (4PL) network design plays a critical role in the strategic phase of logistics management. In this paper, the satisfaction of supply-side and demand-side are considered. A mixed integer linear programming model is established to design the network to maximize the satisfaction of suppliers and demanders under limited investment. The problem solved by CPLEX. Numerical experiments analysis for three situations of different relationship of supply volume and demand volume are conducted. The results show that the proposed model can provide tradeoff between investment and satisfaction.

articleTitle: The application of micro variation chaos genetic algorithm in optimum firepower distribution for caboodle of air defense force
abstract: Optimum firepower distribution model for caboodle of air defense force based on micro variation chaos genetic algorithm is established by using the battlefield object value and air defense firepower distribution. The model can exert the highest point of firepower unit efficiency of weapon and realize the most damage effect. The steps includes adopting real number to code, creating original community through building chromosome; calculating the degree of adaptation, checking out the original community; manipulating the inherit algorithm operators and ameliorating the manipulation of election, chiasmic, variation and so on. At last, calculate the optimum selection and find out the optimum select of distributive project. The adaptive crossover probability and adaptive mutation probability are proposed, which consider the influence of every generation to algorithm and the effect of different individual fitness in every generation.

articleTitle: Application of self-adaptive TDF-IMC in grinding classification process
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of large delay, large inertia and time-varying parameters of the second pump current control during grinding classification process, this paper proposes an adaptive TDF-IMC. The gain adaptive algorithm is combined with the TDF-IMC. Through on-line identification of the controlled object model's gain parameter, the controlled object model of the IMC controller is corrected. Finally, through simulation experiments, it is verified that the algorithm can achieve stable control for the second pump current, meet the requirements of controller performance in grinding classification process, and lay a foundation for the implementation of mineral processing integrated automation system.

articleTitle: Research on a facial feature points detection method based on skin color model
abstract: In recent years, facial feature points detection has become a popular research topic in the field of computer vision. The traditional facial feature points detection methods are defective, because these methods are affected by expression change, illumination change and other factors. In this paper, the skin color model is combined with gray information to detect and locate the facial feature points. Firstly, the skin color model is used to segment the image and extract the facial feature region. After the mathematical morphology processing, the gray integral projection method is used to detect and locate the feature points accurately. Compared to other traditional detected method, this method solves the negative effects of the factors such as expression change and illumination change on the feature points detection. It can also show high precision and strong robustness in real-time video detection system.

articleTitle: Micro grid scheduling optimization based on quantum particle swarm optimization (QPSO) algorithm
abstract: In this paper, the optimization of micro grid energy scheduling is studied; an energy management model with the objective of minimizing the total cost is established. This paper consider the operation cost, fuel cost, environmental cost and purchase price of each generating unit, and then uses the quantum behaved particle swarm optimization (QPSO) algorithm to solve the optimization problem. Under the grid connected mode, the operating characteristics of micro grid in different seasons and optimal unit commitment scheme are obtained. The results show that the method and strategy are effective.

articleTitle: Evaluation research of intersection running state based on principal component analysis
abstract: Principal component analysis (PCA) is general existing in the evaluation system composed by the multi-indicator variables. The basic principles and calculation steps of the principal component analysis are described; for typical signalized intersection, different signal timing programs are simulated with the microscopic simulation software VISSIM; a comprehensive benefit evaluation function is obtained by reducing the dimension of the simulation results using principal component analysis method. By validating analysis based on radar chart of simulation data and multiple indicator trend line, principal component analysis is feasible and effective in the evaluation of intersection running state considering multiple factors set.

articleTitle: Adaptive sliding mode control for T-S fuzzy descriptor systems
abstract: This paper investigated the adaptive sliding mode control problem for T-S fuzzy descriptor systems with different input matrices. The specific information of the bound of nonlinear term is unknown in the controller design process. Our attention is mainly focused on designing the adaptive sliding mode controller for such a T-S fuzzy descriptor. Firstly, a model-based fuzzy sliding surface is constructed to match the characteristic of different input matrices. Secondly, an adaptive sliding mode controller is designed based on the fuzzy sliding surface to adapt the unknown upper bound of matched nonlinearity. Some admissibility conditions of T-S fuzzy descriptor systems can be obtained. Finally, a numerical example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed results.

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis of material layer thickness in slag powder process
abstract: Dumping the slag into vertical mill, granulated blast furnace slag powder is finally got by the crushing, grinding and separation in the vertical mill. The whole process is a non-linear, multivariate process. In this process, maintaining the stability of material layer thickness can reduce the mill vibration and power consumption. So this paper analyzed the slag powder production process firstly. Then the models of material layer thickness, production and specific surface area are established based on the field data by using least square support vector machine (LSSVM). Finally the suitable range of material layer thickness is obtained by multi-objective optimization of production and specific surface area.

articleTitle: Improved surendra background updating algorithm for moving vehicle detection
abstract: Moving object detection plays an important role in intelligent transportation system. Combined with dynamic segmentation threshold and the counter, this paper proposes an improved Surendra algorithm based on background subtraction method. Image sequence is firstly preprocessed by median filtering, followed by background model updating on basis of dynamic background subtraction. Counter is incorporated to offset the effects of stagnation of moving vehicles and camera vibration. Mathematical morphology operations including connectivity components analysis and iterative dilating are applied to remove noises and fill holes. Experimental results show that the proposed method is efficient and can perform in real time.

articleTitle: Identification of wind Turbine Model by Subspace method and prediction error method
abstract: In this paper, the problem of model identification of torque loop and pitch loop in wind power generation system is studied. It's difficult to obtain accurate model of wind turbine using traditional method. Considering the characteristics of wind turbine is strong nonlinear, MIMO and large disturbance, the operation process of wind turbine is divided into different operating point, and it is assumed that the vicinity of the operating point is a linear system. Firstly, the model of the initial wind generator was obtained by using the subspace method, but the result is unsatisfactory in accuracy. Secondly, the optimized wind turbine model was obtained by prediction error method. The system is identified in MATLAB, and the result is high accuracy and good robustness.

Author Keywords: Subspace method and Prediction error method

articleTitle: A Recursive Approach to Event-based Resilient Filtering for Time-varying Systems with Stochastic Uncertainties
abstract: In this paper, the event-based resilient filtering problem is investigated for a class of time-varying system with stochastic uncertainties. The event-triggered scheme is adopted in order to decrease communication frequency and save network resources. The stochastic uncertainties are considered to characterize the modelling errors. The filter gain perturbation is modelled by norm-bounded uncertainties. The purpose of this paper is to propose an event-based filtering method for addressed time-varying systems such that, for both stochastic uncertainties and filter gain perturbations, an optimized upper bound of the filtering error covariance is guaranteed by means of designing the filter gain. Finally, a simulation example is provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed recursive filtering scheme.

articleTitle: Research on magnetic suspended vibration isolation system based on stiffness control under base motion
abstract: Magnetic suspended vibration isolator was designed and applied to multi-degree of freedom vibration isolation system. Stiffness and damping of magnetic suspended vibration isolator based on stiffness control was deduced. The operating condition of magnetic suspended vibration system was analyzed and mathematic model was constructed. The mathematic model of base motion was incorporated into the theoretical model and simulation model of the magnetic suspended vibration isolator. The stiffness and damping of the whole vibration-isolating system are varied by the way of adjusting the stiffness and damping of the magnetic suspension isolator. Force transmissibility, input force, and output force response of magnetic suspended vibration isolation system, respectively under chirp exciting signal and dual-frequency exciting signal were simulated. The simulation results indicate that the floating raft isolation system under active fuzzy controller can remarkably suppress vibration in the wide range of frequency and is remarkably better than those of passive isolation.

articleTitle: The research of the sliding mode control method based on improved double reaching law
abstract: For the single reaching law slow convergence speed and big chattering, this paper proposes a modified double reaching law which replaces symbol function into saturated function and adds the exponential items. This reaching law gives a method for calculating the arrival time of the control system. It overcomes the defects of the single reaching law which approach the sliding mode surface for a long time, and ensures dynamic quality and steady state performance of the system. Applies it to a two-order system, and makes a comparison with the single reaching law, the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the improved double reaching law.

articleTitle: Spectral emissivity calculation based on extreme learning machine
abstract: Spectral emissivity has important research significance and application value in the fields of national defense and medical science. The network training is carried out on the test samples through the ELM modeling method in this paper, and the results show that the blackbody is band infrared radiation brightness model in the range of 3 ~ 5μm and 8 ∼ 12μm, used to calculate the different wavelengths of blackbody spectral emissivity. The comparison of the standard blackbody shows that the maximum relative error between the spectral emissivity and the actual spectral emissivity of the ELM network model is less than 1%, and the method is applied to the calculation of the target spectral emissivity of the aircraft skin.

articleTitle: Detection of rotating stall of axial compressors based on mixed pattern library
abstract: In this paper, a mixed pattern library including normal patterns, spike stall inception patterns and modal stall inception patterns is built to detect the rotating stall in axial compressors. Firstly, the Mansoux-C2 model and the Mansoux-C3 model are used to generate the modal stall and the spike stall, respectively. In order to facilitate modeling and detection of rotating stall, system dynamics of the compressor are divided into the dominant and secondary dynamics. Then, the dominant dynamics are accurately identified and stored in constant radial basis function (RBF) networks based on deterministic learning. The stored knowledge is used to build a mixed pattern library. Based on the library, the rotating stall inception of the test compressor can be rapidly detected by the dynamic pattern recognition method and the smallest residual principle. Simulation studies are given to show the validity of the proposed approach. Simulation results show that the test rotating stall pattern can be rapidly detected without false alarm.

articleTitle: Backstepping control for a quadrotor based on the structure of inner and outer loops
abstract: As a kind of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), quadrotor is widely used in modern society. However, its design of under-actuated control laws is always quite complicated because it is a typical under-actuated system. This paper proposed a control structure based on inner and outer loops to avoid the direct design of the under-actuated control laws. The outer loop is a position subsystem including position dynamics along three axes, according to which three control inputs are designed by backstepping method independently. Then the under-actuated control law is derived by the control input along the vertical axis, and the desired values of pitch and roll angles for the inner loop are calculated by the three control inputs of the outer loop; The inner loop is an attitude subsystem including attitude dynamics, according to which three attitude control laws further designed by backstepping method as well. Under this proposed control structure, the obtained control laws above are concise and easy to be implemented in practical flight control. Simulation results prove that all the variables of position and attitude can track the expected values steadily.

articleTitle: Image segmentation based on improved fuzzy clustering algorithm
abstract: To avoid the over and under segmentation problem in image segmentation, taking advantage of fuzzy clustering which is unsupervised and the simulated annealing principle can seek the optimal solution automatically, an approach for automatically image segmentation using improved fuzzy clustering algorithm based on the simulated annealing principle and the reversible jump Markov chain is proposed. First, the spatial information and the color information are considered to acquire the feature vectors of each pixel. Then by using the cluster validity index as the performance indicators and iteratively updating the segmentation number based on different moves, such as birth, death, split, merge, and perturb move. Finally, the simulated annealing principle was applied to seek the most suitable segmentation number, which can get more accurate and reasonable segmentation results automatically without prior knowledge or complex pretreatment. The experimental results show the proposed method can accomplish the image segmentation effectively and robustly.

articleTitle: Substation Protection Based on Current Merged Credible Factor
abstract: It is easy for substation protection to access all the action information of local protection, this paper proposed a substation protection algorithm based on the current merged credible factor. First, update the current setting values of each component and collect the action information of current protection, calculate the support level of each protection to component based on effective protection range. Then, use this support level as the weight of protection action and build merged credible function and merged credible expected function of substation current protection. Finally, merged credible factor is defined as the ratio of these two functions, the faulted component can be identified by the maximum value of merged credible factor. The results of real substation show that faulty component can be identified correctly and rapidly without analog information or synchronized information. This algorithm also has good adaptability and fault tolerance in the case of information missing or error.

articleTitle: Fractional order PID control of two-wheel electric balance vehicle
abstract: In this paper, a fractional order PID control method is proposed for the two-wheeled electric vehicle with multi variables, nonlinearity, strong coupling and parameter uncertainty. According to the mechanical model of the system, the motion characteristics under straight and turning conditions are analyzed, and the stability control is carried out by using fractional order PID. The control parameters are obtained by decoupling control and particle swarm optimization. The simulation results show that the method can increase two adjustable parameters, and the setting range becomes larger, so better control effect can be achieved.

articleTitle: Utopia-tracking multi-performance predictive cruise control for a group of connected vehicles on urban roads
abstract: In this paper, a multi-performance predictive cruise controller for vehicles in connected vehicle system is proposed based on the utopia point method. With the ad hoc wireless communication technology, the signal phase and timing (SPAT) information from traffic lights is firstly employed to determine some admissible velocity range. Then the optimal target velocity of vehicles is computed by minimizing the fuel economic polynomial models of the vehicle system. In order to systematically cope with the performances of fuel economy, car-following, ride comfort and safety, the multi-objective finite horizon optimal control problem is formulated to compute the multi-performance predictive cruise controllers. The multiple performances in this paper is handled with utopia point method, where the resulted cost function is the distance of the criteria vector of vehicles to its utopia-point (i.e. the vector of separately minimized criteria). Finally, simulations are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in terms of improvement of multiple performances.

articleTitle: Stability Conditions for Event-triggered Control Systems with Limited Bandwidth and Network Delay
abstract: This paper proposes a model-based event-triggered control strategy to reduce the occupation of network resources. We study the problems of the bounded network delay in event-triggered quantized feedback control systems. In order to avoid the Zeno behavior, an event-triggering condition is designed to ensure the asymptotic stability of the system and a lower bound of the stabilizing quantization bit rates is obtained. The updating strategy based on the time stamp is introduced, and the constraints on the network delay are given. Based on these conditions, an upper bound on the tolerable network delay is derived. Simulations are done to demonstrate the effectiveness of the control strategy proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Diagnosing weak fault of rolling bearing using duffing system
abstract: Bearing's early fault signal always contains cyclical impulses and strong noise, so it is difficult to extract the feature of weak fault. It can be found if weak periodic signal was input Duffing system, then the variance of the system output value X appears maxima . This phenomenon can be occurred only under the condition of Duffing system parameter p is equal to the angular frequency of input periodic signal. By using classical fault diagnosis method, the frequency range of fault signal has been obtained. Then Duffing system parameter p would be adjusted in accordance with this frequency range. In the process of adjusting parameter p, the largest variance of Duffing system output X would be appeared. With this method, fault feature frequencies can be extracted and fault type can be judged. Simulated and real weak rolling bearing fault signals have been analyzed in this paper, the result showed the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Impact of Microblog User Cognition and User Emotion on Microblog Behavior in Social Emergencies
abstract: With rapid development of social media, it provides a certain platform for information dissemination and diffusion. User's understanding of the different events in the sudden events will produce different microblog content and contains a certain emotional, and emotional gathering will activate the corresponding behavior. This paper studies the influence of uses' cognition and user's emotion on microblog behavior, and takes the case test of Hangzhou nanny arson as an example. The results show that the user's cognition and the user's emotion have a significant effect on the microblog behavior, and the user's cognitive part affects the microblog behavior through the intermediary variable.

articleTitle: Simultaneous stabilization for a collection of single-input nonlinear time-delay systems with uncertain parameters
abstract: A method for simultaneously stabilizing a set of feedback linearizable time delay systems with uncertain parameter is presented by using control Lyapunov-Krasovskii functionals (CL-KF). Based on common CL-KFs, two continuous state feedback laws are designed to simultaneously globally asymptotically stabilize the closed-loop systems. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed scheme is illustrated by two simulation examples.

articleTitle: Internal control, cloud accounting platform and administrative management: A case study ofchina's quzhou investment bureau
abstract: Based on the new theory of information technology and cloud accounting, this paper discusses the whole process of the government procurement business and the ways of normalization management. The aim of this paper is to establish a new efficient framework for accounting management. The research shows that the government can use the platform to establish the supplier credit system and provide the best supplier selection. In addition, the government can also establish an optimal supplier selection mechanism to reduce the cost of purchasing. It is of particular importance that a continuous tracking and evaluation mechanism for the procurement process should be established appropriately. Only in this way can the government realize the evaluation and monitoring of the whole process of purchasing.

articleTitle: Nonlinear robust motion control of hydraulic servo system with matched and mismatched disturbance compensation
abstract: A novel disturbance observer-controller scheme for hydraulic servo system is proposed in this paper. Not only the matched disturbance but also the mismatched disturbance can be estimated by this scheme.A composite controller is synthesized by a backstepping procedure. And the estimation of the matched and mismatched disturbance was used in the controller to compensate the corresponding disturbance. Especially, the estimation for mismatched uncertainties was used in the visual control law. The analysis of the estimation error was implemented along with the stability analysis of the controller. Theoretical analysis proves that the final tracking accuracy and the disturbance estimation accuracy can be guaranteed by the proposed disturbance observer-controller scheme Furthermore, the convergence of the closed-loop controller-observer system is achieved when the disturbance becomes to a constant. Extensive comparative simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed observer-controller scheme.

articleTitle: Event-triggered adaptive control for a class of discrete-time uncertain nonlinear systems
abstract: In this paper, an event-triggered adaptive control approach is proposed to control a class of discrete-time uncertain nonlinear systems, based on the backstepping adaptive control and the fixed threshold strategy. The designed event-triggered adaptive control can guarantee that all the closed-loop signals are globally bounded and the tracking error converges to a compact set. Simulation results are given to illustrate the performance and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Improved Elman neural network and its application
abstract: A novel improved hysteretic Elman neural network which contains input layer, hidden layer, output layer and context layer is proposed to enhance the short-term forecasting accuracy of wind speed series. The activation of functions in the hidden layer are chosen as the hysteretic activation, and other activation functions are chosen Sigmoid functions. The hysteretic activation function has two response branches: the rising branch and the falling branch. The output response of the neuron is determined by the current input states and variation tendencies. Therefore, the neuron must store its historical state information which can enhance the information utilization rate of the neural network and improve the information process ability. Chaos optimization algorithm is used to train the connection weights and hysteretic parameters. The improved Elman neural network is used to predict the wind speed series. Experiment results show that the improved Elman neural network can improve the prediction performance, and more effective prediction results can be got by the network.

articleTitle: The Hopf bifurcation analysis in a delayed fractional SIR epidemic model
abstract: In this paper, the Hopf bifurcation in a delayed fractional-order SIR epidemic model is investigated. Firstly, the associated characteristic equation is analyzed by using time delay as a bifurcation parameter. It is shown that time delay can effect the stability of the diseases prevalence. Finally, some numerical simulations are presented to illustrate our theoretical results.

articleTitle: Analysis of ideological and political education based on optimal control theory
abstract: Ideological and political education is regarded as the lifeblood of ideological work and all other work. Therefore, how to improve the effect of Ideological and political education has always been a problem for institutional units to think about and solve. Combining the theory of optimal control, this paper presents the problem of Ideological and political education by mathematical methods. The article first introduces the common methods of Ideological and political education, and expresses it by mathematical equation. Then it puts forward the optimized model of Ideological and political education. Finally, the model is analyzed based on the theory of dynamic optimal control. The research of this paper can provide some theoretical basis for improving ideological and political education effect.

articleTitle: Research on the arterial coordination control of road intersections in port areas based on vissim simulation
abstract: In order to increase the volume of vehicles to pass intersections continuously as much as possible, arterial coordination control is necessary to be applied. Based on the traditional method of traffic control, this paper focused on the features of traffic flows in port areas in different times, especially in peak periods and slack times. Also considering that most of the vehicles in port area are container trucks, this paper designs fixed-time coordination control and inductive control for traffic flows in different periods, and uses Vissim, a professional traffic simulation software, to finish the simulation. From the simulation results, it is clear that the method proposed in this paper can reduce total delay and total stopping rate of vehicles in port areas effectively, and improve the efficiency of collecting and distributing in the ports.

articleTitle: A new model for structural damage assessment using adaptive mutation particle swarm optimization and support vector machine
abstract: Structural damage assessment is an important part of structural health monitoring. Nevertheless, there is the defect of low accuracy in the existed evaluation methods. In order to solve this problem, a new model for structural damage assessment using adaptive mutation Particle Swarm Optimization(AMPSO) and Support Vector Machine(SVM) named A-SVM model is proposed in this paper. Firstly, A-SVM model uses AMPSO algorithm to calculate the best parameters of SVM, and then the optimized SVM model is adopted to evaluate the structural damage. A-SVM model and other two different models are used to assess the structural damages of a pile structure as an experiment, the results show that A-SVM model has a higher prediction accuracy than SVM model and PSO-SVM model.

articleTitle: Design of video aerial target detection and tracking system based on AM5728
abstract: A detection and tracking system for aerial target in the dynamic background is designed based on AM5728 in this paper. Firstly, a moving target detection algorithm based on LK optical flow and inter-frame difference is proposed. According to the number of FAST feature points, the foreground target is extracted by inter-frame difference, or the matching points are calculated by the LK optical flow algorithm to obtain the registration image, and then the foreground target is extracted by the image difference. The false target is removed by 8-connected components labeling and multi-frame association in order to obtain the target in the current frame. Then, the KCF tracker is initialized by the result of the detection algorithm and tracks the target stably. Finally, target detection and tracking algorithms are transplanted to AM5728. Experiments demonstrate that the video aerial target detection and tracking system can obtain dynamic information of the aerial target in real time and track aerial target stably for a long time under the conditions of scale changes, light changes, etc.

articleTitle: An improved approach for adversarial decision making under uncertainty based on simultaneous game
abstract: Game theory is used widely when to make decisions in an adversarial environment. There are usually two adversarial players in a game and both of players try to maximize their payoffs. However the classical game assumes the players are rational and do not consider other uncertainty factors such as personal preference. This paper proposes a method to take uncertainty into account when using game theory to make decisions. And Dempster-Shafer evidence theory is used to deal with the uncertainty, then the payoff matrix of game can be modified properly and the new payoff matrix reflects the impact of uncertain factors. Finally the equilibrium solution is computed which is the optimal decision under uncertainty.

articleTitle: Development and design of virtual experiment system based on 3dsMax and Virtools technology
abstract: With the progress of science and technology, computer technology and virtual reality technology have made rapid progress. Therefore, virtual experiment technology has been developing rapidly with the help of it. Because of the shortage and safety of the current computer hardware assembly experimental equipment, this thesis aims to study the computer hardware assembly virtual experiment based on 3ds Maxand Virtools technology. In order to achieve real results of experiment we apply a real hardware laboratory scene in a computer simulation and increase the interaction function. The development of this experiment will not only effectively solve the problems of equipment shortage, loss and safety in computer hardware assembly experiment, but also enrich the auxiliary means of education and teaching so that put forward a new attempt for the transformation of traditional laboratories.

articleTitle: Design and research of MELP vocoder based on Beidou voice communication
abstract: Mixed excitation linear prediction (MELP) algorithm has good characteristics of high voice compression rate and optimize the quality of synthesized speech, the design of MELP vocoder voice communication system based on Beidou vocoder, this system mainly focuses on speech compression encoding MELP algorithm, firstly establish the channel model, the original speech feature parameters obtained by MELP encoding algorithm combining decoding algorithm and realize the reduction of synthetic speech, speech compression rate to 300bps algorithm, and combined with the Beidou communication protocol and the function design, realization of Beidou voice data communication function. The experimental data show that the very low bit rate speech compression algorithm is effective in Beidou data voice communication, and has high practical value.

articleTitle: On optimization technology in 4G system
abstract: With the development of wireless communication technology, the fourth generation (4G) mobile system research is still the focus. In modern heterogeneous 4G wireless networks, the basic standard is call service interrupt call and call continuity. Switching is the best way to achieve continuous call service. In heterogeneous wireless networks, the key challenge is continuous call connections between different networks such as Wi-Fi, Wi-Max, WLAN, and CDMA. At present, the concept of cellular mobile communication system is introduced in this paper, and the last link of cellular network or mobile network is wireless communication. The internet. The network is distributed over a land area called a cell, each serving at least one fixed location transceiver called a cell site or a base station. The concept of handover is then described in detail, which is the process of transferring an ongoing call or data session from one channel connected to the core network to another channel. Switching technology is divided into hard switching and soft switching, compared with the traditional switching (hard switching, etc.), soft switching has many advantages: it improves the seamless communication, soft switching is the main feature of the transmission is not interrupted. However, soft handoffs also have some drawbacks, such as increasing complexity and consuming additional resources in the downstream direction. Finally, this paper discusses various switching decision algorithms and analyzes their performance. The performance of one of the 4G vertical switching algorithms is studied and simulated. The results of the analysis and the results show that the proposed algorithm gives better results in minimizing the processing delay during the switching process.

articleTitle: The research of permanent magnet synchronous motor drive based on the IGBT intelligent power module
abstract: For an electrical brake used in high precision and high reliability of permanent magnet synchronous motor direct drive system, this paper analyses the vector control principle, combined with the space vector modulation technology, build the model in MATLAB/Simulink environment, has carried on the system simulation. Based on DSP + CPLD architecture has carried on the system hardware and software design, mainly introduced DSP processor module, current protection circuit, rotating transformer interface circuit, IPM drive circuit, the design and implementation of the validity of the control system is verified by experiment.

articleTitle: Adaptive scale correlation filter tracker with feature fusion
abstract: In order to overcome the scale adapting and running time problems in the object tracking. Based on the KCF method, in this paper, we propose a novel tracker based on adaptive scale correlation filter (ASCF). Different with DSST, the developed tracking method only needs one filer process. During it, we apply the kernel trick in the correlation filter, and simultaneously detect the translation and scale. It can adapt the changes of scale in the tracking. In order to improve the accuracy of the experiment, we also use feature fusion method to cope with occlusion condition. The experiments demonstrate that, the developed algorithm can successfully inherit the scale advantage and enhance the tracking speed, and perform well on some tracking sequences.

articleTitle: An improved particle filter based on cuckoo search for visual tracking
abstract: Particle filter (PF) has been proven to be a powerful tool to solve visual tracking problem. However, the problem of sample impoverishment is a constraint of PF. To solve this problem, a cuckoo search-based particle filter is proposed. The particles in PF are optimized using cuckoo search. The meaningful particles are increased and can approximate the true state of the target more accurately. Experiments on visual tracking show that the proposed algorithm outperforms the standard particle filter in solve the visual tracking problems with various challenging conditions.

articleTitle: Coordination control for supercapacitor charge and discharge in PV energy storage system based on EL and backstepping
abstract: To realize the constant voltage charging of photovoltaic(PV) supercapacitor energy storage system and the control target of the constant voltage power supply, a control method which combines the signal control strategy and energy control strategy is used to control the supercapacitor charging and discharging processes. From energy control strategy, the Euler - Lagrange (EL) models of the supercapacitor charging and discharging circuits are respectively established. The damping matrix injected and expected by the system during charge and discharge process of supercapacitor are given, and the equilibrium of the system has been determined, the EL controller of the system is calculated. From signal control strategy, backstepping controller of the system is calculated. Coordinated controller is calculated through coordination function. The simulation results show that the coordinated control method not only can realize the constant voltage charging of the super capacitor and the constant voltage discharge of the supercapacitor to the load but also save the energy of system, and the supercapacitor constant voltage discharge system has strong robustness.

articleTitle: Adaptive fuzzy prescribed performance control for a class of uncertain chaotic economical system
abstract: This paper presents a fuzzy adaptive control method for a class of uncertain chaotic economical system, capable of guaranteeing prescribed performance bounds. By prescribed performance bounds we mean that tracking error should converge to a predefined arbitrarily small set, with convergence rate no more than a prescribed value. The main idea is to transform the original constrained system into an equivalent one via an appropriately defined output error transformation. Furthermore, for updating the parameters of the fuzzy logic systems, a proportional-integral adaptation law is introduced. Finally, an illustrative example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed results.

articleTitle: Research on control system of intelligent shore-to-ship power connecting pile based on PLC technology
abstract: In order to alleviate the environmental pollution in the port, more and more ports have begun to supply power to various ships moored at the port. Ships can be connected to the shore-to-ship power source to get the power instead of fuel electricity generation. Thus, the air pollution, water pollution and noise caused by the generation of electricity can be avoided. However, at present, most shore-to-ship power supply equipment has the disadvantages of simple equipment, low intelligence and low safety. In order to overcome the disadvantages of traditional power connecting pile, a new control system is proposed in this paper. The high-performance SIEMENS PLC is applied as the main controller in the power connecting pile. It can provide convenient power supply service for the mooring ships through the operation mode combining the touch screen with the physical buttons. The power connecting pile has the functions of identity identification, power supply guidance, electricity charge, temperature and humidity control, and fault diagnosis. The new system will increase the intelligence and safety of the power connecting piles.

articleTitle: Using differential evolution to research the multi-objective optimization of medical sensor networks: A brief discussion
abstract: The medical sensor network is special application of WSNs. In a medical sensor network, the users' information needs to be transmitted to the doctor workstation with smaller time delay. Meanwhile, the reliability and energy consumption are necessary to consider. This is multi-objective path optimization because there is exists conflict between these factors. Among to research such problem, the popular method is converting it into single objective for analysis. Due to the medical sensor network belongs to a new interdisciplinary research direction, there are does not much scholars to research it and does not exist review for it. Therefore, we analysis the multi-objective path optimization problems deeply, especially introduce the mathematical model of that and use the differential evolution algorithm to study this problem. Finally, we solve this problem based on differential evolution algorithm and provide some preliminary simulation tests. The results verify the validity of our method and offer certain reference and suggestion for researching this problem in the future. .

articleTitle: A LOS-based signal compensation method for non-bus priority approach
abstract: TSP (transit signal priority) is an effective strategy to improve the transit performance at signalized intersection. However, TSP may have negative effect on vehicles in the non-priority direction. This paper proposed a rule-based signal control method: grant an optimal green compensation time to the non-priority direction which can reduce the vehicle delay in non-priority direction while make sure the vehicle delay in priority direction is limited in an acceptable level. This paper use LOS (level of service) as judging criteria to determine the compensation threshold and total compensation time. In addition, this paper introduced an installment compensation strategy, which can avoid the negative affect when compensation time is too long. Finally, the case study shows the optimized signal timing compensation plan will reduce 24.6% vehicle delay in non-priority direction and 29.8% in the entire intersection, the LOS of the intersection increase from E to D.

articleTitle: Research on location intelligent detection based on RFID technology
abstract: Location awareness plays an increasingly important role in the research of wireless sensor networks and Internet of Things. Existing methods based on ranging and non-ranging all have their own advantages and disadvantages. Aiming at the problem of location-aware method, combined with RFID technology, taking into account that under specific environment, some factors easily affect the multi-purpose positioning algorithm adversely, this paper presents a RSSI algorithm for referencing the adjacent beacon nodes. And the simulation results show that this method is effective in amending the environmental factors.

articleTitle: Research on family monitoring system of elderly solitaries based on embedded system
abstract: With the increasing aging of the population, the intelligent monitoring of the elderly solitaries has becoming more and more crucial. In this paper, Wi-Fi wireless communication technology and OpenCV technology are combined to design an intelligent monitoring system for the elderly solitaries. The ARM9 processor S3C2416 is used as the main controller which equipped with a Wi-Fi module and a video data acquisition module. Device driver module, serial port driver module and USB camera driver module are used to achieve an appropriate device driver operation while the human body posture detection method is used to perceive falls. Through the experimental test system to achieve the design goal, it is able to verify that this system has a good application prospect and scalability.

articleTitle: Finite-time control for nonlinear magnetic bearing system based on adaptive second order sliding mode technique
abstract: A novel adaptive second order sliding mode control (ASOSMC) scheme with finite-time strategy is proposed for the control of a nonlinear thrust active magnetic bearing (TAMB) system with system uncertainty and disturbance. A Proportional + Integral + Derivative (PID) sliding surface is utilized for the sliding mode. We employ finite-time strategy to obtain the properties of fast response and high tracking-accuracy. To obtain a better disturbance rejection property, a adaptive control law is introduced to compensate the system uncertainty and external disturbance. The proposed ASOSMC algorithms ensure that the occurrence of the sliding motion in finite-time and the trajectory of tracking-error converge to the small neighborhood of equilibrium point. Finally, numerical simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Multiple kernel learning for representation-based classification of hyperspectral images
abstract: In the paper we propose a multiple kernel learning framework for representation-based classification (MKL_RC) of hyperspectral images. Unlike the existing methods that often exploit the single feature extraction method or the single kernel method; moreover, the single feature representation and kernelized RC is biased and less stable due to the high coherence of the training samples. The proposed approach is different from traditional kernelized methods and characterized by multiple features and multiple kernel learning in a representation-based classification manner. Experimental results on several real HSI datasets demonstrate that the proposed method can achieve superior performance than the state-of-the-art classification methods.

articleTitle: Research on Internal Typical Partial Discharge Characteristics for Gas Insulation Switchgear
abstract: In order to improve the accurate judgment and location level of partial discharge defects in GIS equipment, it is important to carry out the identification and determination of partial discharge types for GIS equipment running status evaluation. The types and reason of partial discharge in GIS equipment are analyzed, discusses the advantages and disadvantages of different partial discharge detection method. The amplitude, characteristics, types and empirical criterion of typical partial discharge defects are researched by employed the ultrasonic detection method (AE) and ultra-high frequency detection method (UHF) according to the five typical defect types in the field testing. It is indicate that the two methods can play their respective advantages to ensure the reliability of partial discharge detection and location accuracy. The study on the characteristics of partial discharge under the different detection methods provides important parameters and basis for the condition-based maintenance of GIS equipment and judgment data for the field tester.

articleTitle: Design of conformance verification system for intelligent substation configuration file
abstract: The intelligent substation configuration file (SCD) is the unified data source of the whole station, and its correctness is crucial to the safe operation of the whole station. In view of the existing problems of intelligent substation in SCD file management, this paper designs a set of intelligent substation configuration file consistency verification system. The function of configuration file analysis, auxiliary check, file version management, error information collection and other functions provided by this system provide effective technical means for the implementation of the project of smart substation.

articleTitle: Exponential Stabilization via Event-triggered Control for Linear Discrete-time Delayed Systems
abstract: This paper studies the exponential stabilization issue for linear discrete-time delayed systems (L-DDS) by event- triggered control (ETC) . The ETC scheme is based on the state feedback control which is updated when an event is triggered via a triggering condition. Under the designed ETC, the closed-loop L-DDS is a discrete-time switched system with the switchings driven by events expressed by a condition of state. Criteria for achieving exponential stabilization by the ETC is derived. Thus the exponential stabilization is achieved for L-DDS by the designed ETC. The algorithm with some discussions on the non-triviality are given for the improvement of ETC. Finally, one example with numerical simulations is worked out for illustration.

articleTitle: Disturbance observer-based disturbance attenuation control for a class of stochastic systems with nonlinear exosystem and white noises
abstract: This paper studies a class of stochastic systems with multiple disturbance, which includes white noises and disturbances modeled by a nonlinear exogenous system. To estimate the disturbance with nonlinear dynamics, a stochastic nonlinear disturbance observer is proposed. Based on the observer, a nonlinear disturbance observer-based disturbance attenuation control (NDOBDAC) scheme is constructed such that the composite closed-loop system is asymptotically bounded in mean square. Finally, a simulation example is given to demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: EM based estimation for general linear state space systems
abstract: EM-KF algorithm is very widely used, such as blind source separation and so on. However, due to the lack of research on the more general state space model with input data, it is difficult to apply to the real industrial system. In this paper, the EM-KF algorithm is successfully improved for the more general state space model. A simulation example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Temperature optimization setting model of the reheating furnace on 1700 line in tangsteel
abstract: In this paper, the temperature optimization setting model of the 1# reheating furnace is researched according to the actual production data of the furnace on 1700 line in Tangsteel. The BP neural network is employed to construct a prediction model of billet tapping temperature. Then, the genetic optimization algorithm is adopted to establish the temperature optimization setting model of the furnace on the basis of the prediction model of billet tapping temperature. The optimal setting temperatures of every zone of the furnace are optimized based on the ideal charging temperature and tapping temperature of billets, as well as the billet stay time in each zone of the furnace. The model is currently used for off-line instructional operators to set the temperature values of each zone.

articleTitle: Grey wolf RNA-GA modeling method for FCCU main fractionator
abstract: This paper proposes a grey wolf RNA-GA modeling method for FCCU main fractionator. In this method, the grey wolf search strategy is used to design the new crossover operator to improve the local optimization ability, and the grey wolf RNA-GA algorithm is proposed. The validity of the grey wolf RNA-GA is illustrated with some typical test functions. The grey wolf RNA-GA is adopted for parameter estimation of the FCCU main fractionator model. The simulation results show that the proposed modeling method can accurately reflect the dynamic characteristics of the main fractionator.

articleTitle: Model-free adaptive control based on local dynamic linearization
abstract: Linearization technique is essential for the controller design and analysis of complex nonlinear plants. At least, the linear affine form of the original nonlinear process is required. However, the traditional linearization methods are approximation-based with unmodeled dynamics involved. In this work, a new local dynamic linearization method is proposed using differential mean-value theorem, which can be estimated by using the I/O data only. Then, a new model-free adaptive control is proposed by using the principle of optimality, where the controller design and analysis is data-driven without using any model information. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on the control strategy of phase-change heat storage station with automatic generation system in power network peak regulation and frequency modulation
abstract: In this paper, the operation strategy of thermal power units after the configuration of phase change heat storage station is put forward, and the mathematical model for calculating the peak-shaving capacity of thermal power units after the allocation of phase change heat storage stations is established. Based on the analysis of frequency requirements of electric power system, puts forward the analysis of high frequency and low frequency demand method by using the discrete Fourier transform, and the actual system all day long the proportion of high frequency components are quantitatively analyzed. Analyzes the effect of two typical 300MW and 200MW heating units in Northeast China on improving peak shaving capacity after installing heat storage stations. The results show that the peak shaving capacity of the two units can be increased by 21% and 14% at a given heat load level in the middle heating period. And based on the actual system data, the paper simulates and analyzes the FM strategy of energy storage participating in automatic generation control (AGC). The results show that the flexible allocation of energy storage resources based on area regulation requirement (ARR) has a better FM effect.

articleTitle: Optimal core pricing and financing strategies for remanufacturers
abstract: This paper studies a problem of how to determining the optimal core prices, financing period and financing amount in the payback period or production period in a remanufacturing system under independently uncertain demand and capital constraints, where the remanufacturer acquires and produces high- and low-quality cores to meet the same market demand, in a single period setting. The acquisition pricing is formulated by a nonlinear programming model, and we obtain the optimal policies based on the KKT (the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker) conditions. Finally, we conduct numerical experiments to show that although financing in the payback period can largely alleviate the problem of capital scarcity, the remanufacturer must pay more financing interest. Based on the comparison and analysis, we derive economic and managerial insights for core acquisition.

articleTitle: Assessment of coal mine safety based on Bayesian method with entropy weight
abstract: Assessment of coal mine safety is the basis of its safe management, not only provides safety precautions against accidents, but also gives proposals for its investment in production and safety management, as well as the improvement of its economic effectiveness. An algorithm, with Bayesian theory combined with entropy weight, is applied to the assessment of safety for a southern coal mine based on 6 indexes. The results show that the algorithm is practical and effective for the assessment of coal mine safety and provides a new and more scientific method for its safety assessment.

articleTitle: Research on a new hybrid UWB location system algorithm based on double base station
abstract: Considering some advantages and disadvantages of UWB location technology, we put forward a new hybrid localization method of UWB signal's arrival time and (TSOA) and arrival time difference (TDOA) based on double base station, which has less number of reference localization base station and can apply to narrow regional localization. Due to the geometric structure of the simultaneous equations is irregular, the iterative initial value demand is high using optimization method , so we transform the nonlinear equations. New simultaneous equations have nonlinear characteristic too, but BFS that is a quasi-Newton method can solve it with a good iteration speed, and localization precision meet the requirements too. The simulation results show that the quasi Newton BFS algorithm performance is better than quasi Newton DFP iterative algorithm, and BFS that is applied to nonlinear system of equations has better falling gradient, iterative speed , that has a high practical value.

articleTitle: Multi-angle face detection based on gaussian mixture model and improved template matching
abstract: In order to solve the problem of template matching in face detection for a long calculation time and low face detection rate in different angles, this paper proposes a multi-angle face detection algorithm based on Gaussian mixture model and improved template matching. Before face detection, the necessary light compensation processing is performed first. Then the skin color is modeled by the Gaussian mixture model in the YCbCr color space and the candidate regions of the face are obtained through appropriate morphological processing. Finally, we can accurately mark the location of the face with multi-angle face template.
