abstract: An inverse spectra problem which has an important significance in the control field is discussed, that is, find an irreducible tridiagonal quaternion matrix T, such that T has the given distinct nonzero eigenvalues {Λ,}"<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">=3D1</sub> and a right eigenpairs (λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>,α<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>). In this paper, we use inverse Arnoldi algorithm for an unitary similarity matrix and construct the appropriate similarity transformation, an irreducible tridiagonal quaternion matrix T with given conditions is obtained. At the same time, two numerical examples checks the method's feasibility and precision.

articleTitle: Primal-dual optimization of the fractional-order variational optical flow model for image registration
abstract: Image registration is one of the fundamental and essential tasks for image fusion and image analysis. However, now there are still some problem exiting in non-rigid image registration. For example, in large displacement condition, the image registration accuracy is not satisfied. To deal with it, we present a novel fractional-order variational method to estimate optical flow, using the primal-dual method to construct convex function for global optimization, and applying pyramid iteration to calculate large displacement. Numerical experiments show that the proposed approach can not only obtains more accuracy than classical optical flow method but also works well in large displacement condition. It also demonstrates that fractional-order method as generalization of integer-order method has substantial improvements in image registration accuracy.

articleTitle: Attribute reduction of incomplete information system using characteristic multigranulation model
abstract: In order to extract reliable decision rules from an incomplete information system (IIS) that simultaneously contains two kinds of unknown attribute values, an attribute reduction algorithm using characteristic multigranulation model is put forward in this paper. First, characteristic sets that satisfy characteristic relation are determined according to the IIS and the attribute subset. Calculate the attribute dependency of the decision classes with respect to the attribute subset. Then, determine whether all condition attribute values are indispensable respectively in terms of the attribute dependencies. Finally, delete all the redundant condition attribute values, and generate decision rules. So as to validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, two numerical experiments were carried out. The experimental analysis indicates the proposed algorithm is more efficient and accurate.

articleTitle: Double parameter evaluation function based on path
abstract: Much research has been made to study the evaluation function of connect6 based on path. However, most of the study just use a fix set of parameters which is inflexible and can't meet various game situations. In order to handle this problem, we propose a double parameter evaluation function. Different from the former study, we combine the global and local scanning method and use two sets of parameters to meet different situations. Experimental results demonstrate that our method raise the win rate of the game application with comparing efficiency.

articleTitle: Assessment on bearing performance degradation using improved discriminant LPP
abstract: Improved Discriminant Local Preserving Projection (IDLPP) method is investigated to get the knowledge of degradation from testing data for the bearings of momentum wheels. By the means of adjusting the neighbor parameter according to its sample density, IDLPP method is less sensitive to neighbor parameters than LPP method. Furthermore, IDLPP method makes great improvement on feature extraction by introducing a supervision for category information of data and combining maximum identification criterion into traditional LPP method. With these advantages IDLPP method achieves its application on degradation feature extracting from vibration data. Simulation results demonstrate that IDLPP has a satisfactory performance on the dimensionality reduction and it also improves the manifold distortion.

articleTitle: A new analysis method for parameters retrieving in classifier based on choquet integral
abstract: Choquet integral is a powerful aggregation tool in information fusion and classification. It is established with respect to signed fuzzy measure. The nonadditivity of the signed fuzzy measure provides an effective representation to describe the interaction among contributions from the predictive attributes to the objective attributes. Currently, the values of the signed fuzzy measure in most classifiers based on Choquet integral are either preset subjectively by experience, or retrieved by global optimization methods which are time-consuming. In this paper, a new discriminant analysis algorithm to retrieve the values of signed fuzzy measure in classification models based on Choquet integral is proposed via Fisher's linear discriminant. It is the first time to derive the values of the signed fuzzy measure directly in an analytic form. Performance validation on synthetics and benchmark data sets are conducted to reveal the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A dense mapping method based on CNN
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new CNN based method for dense mapping which replaces the traditional iterative closet point (ICP) algorithm. This method is implemented by four steps: (1) construct color error image and gray error image such that the difference between current depth image and previous depth image can be represented by 2D images; (2) train a CNN classifier with the color error image set such that amplitude of camera movement can be recognized by the classifier; (3) CNN model computes the direction of camera rotation and translation through a series of gray error images which can represent different directions of camera movement; (4) apply iterative strategy to obtain the camera transformation between two time nodes. Experiment results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method to generate the dense map in fast moving environments. Compared with existing methods in break points of dense mapping under different speeds, the proposed method is more stable.

articleTitle: Stabilization for a class of neutral Markovian jump delayed systems with input saturation
abstract: This note is concerned with the state feedback controller design problem for a class of Markov jump delay systems of the neutral-type. The problem addressed is that of designing a h<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> controller that guarantees the stochastic stability of the closed-loop system subject to actuator saturation. An effective Linear Matrix Inequality(LMI) approach is developed to solve this problem. By solving LMIs, sufficient conditions for a neutral-type delay Markov jump delay system to be stochastically stable are established, and an h<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> controller with disturbance attenuation level γ is given. Furthermore, an illustrative example is used to demonstrate the validity of the proposed design procedure.

articleTitle: Robust fault tolerant control for T-S fuzzy systems with interval time-varying delay
abstract: This paper mainly studied the problem of the fault tolerant control (FTC) for a class of Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy systems with interval time-varying delay and norm-bound external disturbance. A new H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">M</sub> performance index is proposed to represent the characteristic of the complex nonlinear system in the process of fault estimation, and the sufficient delay-dependent conditions are established to reduce the conservatism in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). Then, based on the online fault estimations, we designed a new fault tolerant controller to guarantee the dynamic system asymptotically stable. Finally, an inverted pendulum example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach algorithm.

articleTitle: Multi-attribute gray clustering decision based on three parameter interval number
abstract: Gray clustering mainly studies the clustering decision with insufficient information. The interval of three parameters can effectively reduce the uncertainty of judgment. The attribute value of evaluation index is described by the interval of three parameters, and the typical gray clustering decision is expanded into three stages: data aggregation, gray cluster analysis and comprehensive decision. First, the three-parameter interval number is integrated into a numerical value through the aggregation factor; then the numerical value is clustered by the whitening weight function; finally, the ranking result of the evaluation object is determined by comparing the decision vector. The application example shows the rationality and effectiveness of the clustering decision making method proposed in this paper, which provides a new idea for decision theory and application research.

articleTitle: Impact of perceived value on smart city application
abstract: To analyze the smart city application, the relationship between multiple dimensional aspects of perceived value (perceived functional value, perceived emotional value, and perceived social value) to smart city application was studied. Three hypotheses were set to elaborate their relationship. SEM was used to test these hypotheses. The data for this study is from the online survey responses of 400 participants and was analyzed using PLS. Findings showed that perceived social value and emotional value positively influenced smart city application, while there is no relationship between perceived functional value and smart city application.

articleTitle: Recognition of the unstructured road based on machine vision
abstract: Road recognition plays a key procedure in autonomous driving. Compared with laser radar, the method based on machine vision has the price advantage, also has a better prospects for development. Focusing on complex road surface and unclear boundary of unstructured road, a recognition method based on machine vision is proposed in this paper, which uses 2-d Tsallis entropy and double dogleg method. Firstly, the RGB images are converted to HSI color space. Then the hue and saturation images are segmented respectively, using the values calculated in the minimum 2-d Tsallis entropy. Considering the probability of white pixels in segmented hue image, the results are fused in different logic manners. Finally, the double dogleg method is used to recognize the edge of roads. Experimented with different material road images, this method is also proved to be effective.

articleTitle: Research on consensus problems with second-order sliding mode algorithm in multi-agent systems
abstract: For a class of second order linear dynamic multiagent systems with leader and bounded input disturbance, a multi-agent system model is established by graph theory and matrix theory knowledge. A second-order sliding mode control algorithm based on finite state structure is applied to mult-iagent system. Under the condition that the first derivative of sliding mode is unknown, the control output is generated by switching between multiple state machines according to the measured value of sliding mode, so that the sliding mode and its first derivative converge to zero in a finite time, and to achieve the goal that the multi-agent system can be consistent for a limited period of time. The algorithm weakens the chattering problem in the traditional sliding mode control, and improves the accuracy and robustness of the control system. The effectiveness of the algorithm is proved by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: A Method for Image Segmentation Based on DC-SVM
abstract: Image segmentation is one of the most important parts of image recognition and computer vision. On the basis of the support vector machine, the classic C-SVM model is improved. And a support vector model with dynamic penalty factors called DC-SVM is presented and applied to the image segmentation in this paper. Some experiments have been carried out and satisfactory image segmentation results have been obtained.

articleTitle: Role allocation tactics of soccer robots on RoboCup3D simulation platform
abstract: A Markov Decision Process (MDP) is employed to optimize the role allocation of soccer robots on RoboCup3D simulation platform in this paper. Role allocation tactics of soccer robots are modeled based on Markov Decision Process (MDPs) considering various factors of five different types of robot in simulation environment including distance, orientation, falling, speed and other factors. Then a linear function approximation based on Sarsa(λ) learning algorithm is applied to solve the action value function of the MDP model. The role of search for the optimal allocation scheme improves the efficiency of the entire team's offensive defense. The experimental results establish the effectiveness of our methods.

articleTitle: Simultaneous stabilization for a set of multi-input nonlinear systems with time-delay
abstract: Simultaneous stabilization for a collection of multi-input nonlinear time-delay systems with uncertain parameters is dealt with in this paper. A systematic method to simultaneous stabilization this kind of systems is presented. A continuous state feedback control independently uncertain parameters is acquired. It can simultaneously stabilize this kind of systems. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed scheme is illustrated by a simulation example.

articleTitle: Research of queuing fence distribution based on cellular automata model
abstract: There are many pedestrian queues in the rush hour, especially in metropolises and famous scenic spots. In general, the efficiency of pedestrian queuing is often unsatisfying, which greatly affects the queuing experience. Taking the retrograde behavior of individual pedestrians into account, a queuing system based on the cellular automata model is established. Pedestrians choose walking directions based on their surroundings. Simulations based on three different models of fence distributions are studied. It is found that different fence distribution models have significant impacts on passing speeds and retrograde efficiency for pedestrians. The superiority of the improved fence distribution is verified by simulation results. The research work of the article has reference significance for improving the layout of queuing fences.

articleTitle: A fuzzy descriptor for analyzing the differences of facial expression
abstract: This paper proposes an improved fuzzy semantic model(IFSM) to analyze the differences of facial expressions. Comparison with traditional methods. Our method has two advantages: (i) The proposed method breaks the image limit such as scale, illumination; (ii) According to fuzzy rules, the method can interpret expression features using semantic concepts. Then, the FEI and CK+ datasets are applied in analyzing the differences among various expressions. At last, in order to compare the performance, the state-of-the-art methods have been executed. The results illustrate our method has a better accuracy, but also can interpret expression features well.

articleTitle: Research on the problems and countermeasures in incentive mechanism of small and medium private enterprises
abstract: With the development of modern enterprises, more and more enterprises realize that "talent is the first capital of the enterprise". The competition among enterprises is essentially the competition of talents. However, for most of the small and medium-sized private enterprises in the period of entrepreneurship and development, due to limited conditions and insufficient resources in their development process, there are difficulties and obstacles in attracting talents and retaining talents. To solve this problem, the key is to establish and improve the corresponding employee incentive mechanism, in order to stimulate the enthusiasm of employees and improve the efficiency of the organization. Based on the analysis of the current situation of the incentive mechanism of small and medium-sized private enterprises, combined with the actual environment of China, this paper puts forward corresponding countermeasures and suggestions on how to establish effective incentive system in the management of enterprises.

articleTitle: Simulation training system of marine auxiliary boiler and its application
abstract: At present, the auxiliary boiler simulation training system is still imperfect, and the realization of some functions and operations is relatively simple. Therefore, based on the marine engine simulation platform of Dalian Maritime University, this paper combined the existing intelligent assessment examination system, perfected boiler simulation training system, carried out system modeling, and the system model was put into the simulation platform. The system can be used for trainees' training. We can simulate a fault by changing some parameters, and by some operation of interface, these parameters can return to normal. Thus, we can achieve the goal of training engineers' ability to analyze and solve the system fault.

articleTitle: A BDS static positioning drift correction algorithm for dangerous goods transportation
abstract: A correction algorithm for reducing Beidou system(BDS) static positioning drift in dangerous goods transportation was proposed and experimental validated in this paper. First, the positioning principle and precise point positioning(PPP) was briefly introduced, and the error sources which effect positioning and positioning drift were analyzed; Then, some threshold values were set based on experience to judge vehicles status and a moving average correction algorithm was proposed to reduce the modelling error in post-process, and then this proposed algorithm was realized via a microprocessor; Finally, experiments were conducted to verify the feasible of the proposed algorithm. Furthermore, in order to evaluate the effectiveness and easy-to-implement of the proposed correction algorithm, trace curves of the largest static draft distance and the largest distance between the two ends were demonstrated and followed with a comparison between the original data of navigation and the data after correction.

articleTitle: New exponential synchronization for delayed chaotic neural networks with reliable sampled-data control
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of exponential synchronization for chaotic neural networks with mixed time-varying delays via reliable sampled-data control. By making full use of the usable information on the actual sampling pattern and the nonlinear part condition, an improved Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional (LKF) is chosen. Based on our novelly constructed LKF and relaxed Wirtinger-based integral inequality, a new synchronization criterion is derived to guarantee the exponential stability of the error system. Moreover, the desired reliable sampled-data controller can be designed on account of the proposed optimization algorithm. Finally, the superiorities of obtained result is demonstrate by one numerical example with simulations.

articleTitle: Research on the asymmetry of the impact of monetary policy on bank's risk-taking
abstract: This paper introduces the deposit insurance system, the loan mortgage system and the market structure into the theoretical model, and studies the influence of the monetary policy on the credit supply through the bank's risk-taking channel. The derivation of the theoretical model shows that the monetary policy uses the bank's capital level as the threshold variable and there is a threshold asymmetry to the bank's risk-taking transmission. Under the assumption of perfect competitive market structure, the degree of bank's efforts to supervise loans increases with the increase of interest rate, but under the assumption of monopoly market structure, the bank's risk-taking increases with the increase of interest rate.

articleTitle: A new double-sampling method for mediastinal lymph nodes detection by deep conventional neural network
abstract: In the field of automatic clinical image detection, there are still many problems to be solved, especially in detecting and amplifying lymph nodes (LNs) from low-dose Computed Tomography (CT) images. Accurate and efficient identification and segmentation contribute to timely diagnosing various related serious diseases and choosing proper therapy. In this paper, we detect and amplify LNs by using deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), which significantly improve the efficiency of amplifying method of training sets and extracting features from three- dimensional (3D) images. In addition, we combine the method of decomposing the 3D images into three orthogonal two - dimensional (2D) images with a new method of three continuous parallel images. And we also establish a vote algorithm to integrate different values of various possibilities. Firstly, 90 % candidate slices of each patient are used for training, and the other samples are used for detection. The sensitivity even reaches 99 %. However, we consider that there are some identical samples. So then we use the candidate slices of 80 % patients for training and the slices of 20 % patients for detection, which sensitivity is 98 %. Therefore, the results show that the method of this paper can efficiently detect the true-positive samples in the LN candidates.

articleTitle: Alternative estimation method for nonlinear systems with gain fault
abstract: For the nonlinear system with gain fault, an alternative estimation method is given in this paper. Firstly, a joint estimation is presented to estimate the system state and the gain fault synchronously, based on the joint system function of the state evolution process and the gain evolution process. Then, an alternative estimation method is developed, which includes the state estimation process and the fault estimation process. Compared with the joint estimation method, the alternative method reduces the dimension of each sub-system, further reduces the computation requirement. The final simulation result shows that the feasibility and the effectiveness of the alternative method.

articleTitle: Improved teaching-learning-based optimization algorithm and its application for fast control switched systems
abstract: To improve the optimization performance of the TLBO algorithm, an improved TLBO (ITLBO) algorithm with new learning scheme is proposed in this paper. In the learner phase, a no-best student learns from a random selected excellent student or an excellent student learns from teacher again according the fitness of the two mutual learners. Numerical results show that the proposed algorithm is an effective method for global optimization problems. For fast control optimization of periodic switched systems, ITLBO algorithm is presented to address the global optimization problem for designing the periodic switching law without imposing restrictions on the number of switching, switching time, and the convex combination coefficients. Thus, the NP-hard problem for the combination has been resolved, and the fast control objective can be achieved by the proposed scheme. Under the premise of quadratic stability, the switching law designing becomes relatively simple based on TLBO stochastic optimization approach. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness and merits of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The application of the new three theory in the emergency disposal of outdoor gas leakage events
abstract: In our country in recent years several major and over gas safety accidents occurred, especially outdoor gas pipeline, is easy to leak and not easily detected by people is feature, once the accident, the first time the emergency disposal is particularly important. Based on the analysis of the new characteristics of three of the basic content and system approach and combining the actual repair process of Beijing gas group and emergency disposal of the case, we use the "new three" to improve outdoor gas leak emergency disposal. In the process of emergency disposal, the emergency teams should cooperate with each other to work well together to complete the emergency disposal of outdoor gas leakage events; The field commander should make full use of the dissipative structure theory to make the corresponding decision plan in time according to the real-time feedback of other emergency disposal personnel on the scene situation; And the mutation theory is used in the city gas leakage event, which can help the gas group quickly develop effective emergency disposal plan, strengthen the response to the leakage accident, and minimize the loss. This paper uses the new three theory to improve the process of outdoor gas emergency disposal, which is of great significance to the treatment of outdoor gas leakage events.

articleTitle: Study on temperature adjustment system of intelligent shore-based electrical cabinet and its control
abstract: As an important part of the shore power supply system, Intelligent Shore-based Electrical Cabinet (ISEC) is working outdoors at the port. Its cabinet needs to meet some protection level requirements. At the same time, the cabinet usually has a problem of heat-dissipation. In this paper, a solution to the problem of heat-dissipation in electrical cabinet under high temperature environment is proposed. In the design, some new mainly measures are proposed, such as the design of the innovative cabinet, temperature adjustment system and the optimizing of the electrical geometrical layout. Through the above measures, not only the electrical cabinet can be guaranteed to a certain level of protection, but the air temperature in the cabinet can be stabilized within the setting temperature range. By nearly two-month actual test in Wuhan Jinkou port, the temperature adjustment system of the electrical pile has both good practicability and reliability.

articleTitle: An adaptive unified artificial bee colony algorithm for global optimization
abstract: The artificial bee colony (ABC) algorithm invented by Karaboga is a relative new nature inspired heuristic for optimization problem. It has been proved to be competitive with some conventional optimization algorithms. This paper proposes an adaptive unified artificial bee colony (auABC) algorithm which employs a single equation unifying multiple strategies into one expression. As we all know, ABC is good at exploration but poor at exploitation due to the insufficiency in its solution search equation and its one-dimensional search strategy leads to slower convergence speed. In order to improve the above defects, we created a combined self-adaptive equation that its parameters are determined by the current iteration times to solve the problem mentioned above. We also introduce a chaotic strategy when generating candidate food sources which balance the proportion of exploration and exploitation. Experiments conducted on benchmark functions demonstrate that our algorithm achieves good performance in both unimodal and multimodal functions as expected compared to several state-of-the-art algorithms.

articleTitle: Optic Disc Segmentation Method Based on Rules
abstract: In this paper, a rule-based method is proposed to segment optic disc. Firstly, the results of color-boosted Harris corner detection are applied to calculate the convex hull which represents an approximate region of the optic disc. Secondly, two super-pixel methods are used to over segment the retinal image separately, based on which the prior probability and the observation likelihood probability of the constructed Bayesian model are calculated to estimate the posterior probability of the optic disc. Thirdly, the posterior probability using Otsu threshold segmentation method is binarized, and finally the accurate segmentation result of optic disc using Hough transform is obtained. A large number of experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Admissibility analysis for discrete-time bilinear singular systems using bilinear state-feedback controller
abstract: In this paper, both the admissibility analysis and the stabilization of discrete-time bilinear singular systems are addressed, respectively. First, a sufficient condition of admissibility of discrete-time singular system is derived. Then by applying the matrix inequality, a bilinear state-feedback controller is designed to guarantee the closed-loop discrete- time singular bilinear systems to be admissible. An iterative algorithm making use of sequential linear programming matrix method (SLPMM) to derive a single-step LMI condition for bilinear state-feedback controller design is presented. Finally, a numerical example is provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Differential steering control algorithm of 6-wheel fixed-axle drive vehicle
abstract: The differential steering is the basic steering form of the vehicle without steering mechanism. This paper concentrates on steering function of 6-wheel fixed-axle drive vehicle. The differential steering coordinate system is established as basis of theoretical analysis. Then, the triple-linear differential steering torque algorithm, based on driver's operation and characteristics of in-wheel motor, calculates steering torque. The steering torque is distributed to each wheel under guidance of directional vector. Besides, co-simulation model is built using Trucksim and Simulink to show that the differential steering control algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Study on the structure of smart manufacturing system from the perspective of super-network
abstract: With the upgrading of manufacturing mode, smart manufacturing has been the most advanced mode of production, which is the outcome of the changing of manufacturing environment and the technology. On the basis of reviewing the development of manufacturing industry, the evolution trends of the manufacturing mode and the characteristics of smart manufacturing are reviewed. With the introduction of a special complex network, super-network into the analysis of the system structure of smart manufacturing, the super-network theory-based smart manufacturing system structure mode is put forward based on the analysis of super-network characteristics of the smart manufacturing system in this paper. The scientific formulation of the operating mode of smart manufacturing provides theoretical basis for the smart manufacturing process and network operating mechanism.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on the Effect of AC Single-phase Fault on a ±800kV DC Transmission System
abstract: Based on the simulation model of ± 800kV UHVDC transmission system established by PSCAD/EMTDC simulation software, the influence of different AC faults on DC system is studied. A single phase reclosing strategy is used in the DC system near the converter station. Aiming at this kind of situation has carried on the simulation, the simulation results show that the single-phase earth fault in the inverter system is easy to cause commutation failure. The simulation results are compared with the recorded files, and the waveforms of the two are consistent, which proves that the simulation results are credible.

articleTitle: Admissible consensus for descriptor multi-agent systems with exogenous disturbances
abstract: In this paper, we study the admissible consensus for descriptor multi-agent systems with exogenous disturbances that are generated by the linear systems. The interactive topology among agents is modeled by directed graphs. By using the graph theory, the generalized Riccatti equation, and by designing the exogenous disturbances observer, conditions for admissible consensus of descriptor multi-agent systems with exogenous disturbances are obtained. Finally, a numerical simulation is provided to illustrate our result.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimization of methyl acetate hydrolysis process based on NSGA — II algorithm
abstract: An enhanced non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm (NSGA-II) was applied to carry out the integer optimized design in this article. The steady simulation design was established based on the reaction kinetics analysis using Aspen Plus, and the feasible region of each optimized variable was calculated through sensitive analysis. Aiming at the total cost TAC as the objective function, the NSGA-II algorithm was used directly to obtain the Pareto optimal solutions under the constraints of feasible region of variables. The simulation results showed that the NSGA-II algorithm can effectively reduce the total cost of TAC.

articleTitle: An improved criterion for ellipsoidal invariant set of fractional order uncertain systems subject to input saturation
abstract: This technical note investigates the problem of the estimation of domain of attraction of a class of fractional order systems. The unknown parameters of system matrix and the actuator saturation are considered here. The sufficient condition is based on Lyapunov direct approach and fractional order inequalities. After that, the optimal problem is constructed by the method of linear matrices (LMIs) and solved by Matlab. Finally, the superiority of the proposed theoretical method is demonstrated by two numerical examples.

articleTitle: Estimating wheel-road vertical load for nonlinear vehicle vibration system based on cubature Kalman filter
abstract: The vibration of vehicle is most governed by the load generated of the road roughness, which can affect comfort of vehicle and cause fatigue damage of the vehicle suspension. So knowledge of the load is very important for vehicle control systems to enhance vehicle stability and safety. During the process of the estimation, noise affects the identification accuracy, and maybe cause divergence. The cubature Kalman filter (CKF) has good accuracy performance, numerical stability and computational costs. So this paper presented a new methodology based on CKF and a recursive least-squares algorithm for estimating wheel-road vertical load. The state equations and measurement equations were established according to the second order vibration system, and RK4 was employed to discretize the continuous-time equations. The CKF was used to calculate the residual innovation sequences and the residual innovation sequences were used to calculate the vertical load. To verify the effectiveness of the identification method, numerical simulations of the five degrees of freedom vehicle vibration system subjected to white noises and four types of forces were employed. Simulation results validated and proved the feasibility of this approach.

Author Keywords: Five degrees of freedom vehicle vibration system

articleTitle: Research on path planning of intelligent shopping cart in large shopping mall
abstract: The recovery and arrangement of shopping carts in large shopping malls need to invest a lot of manpower and financial resources, and its recovery efficiency is low. In order to achieve the purpose of self-driving and collision free recovery of shopping cart near work, an improved algorithm is proposed. The basic RRT algorithm takes the starting point of the intelligent shopping cart as the root node and adds the gravity component of the artificial potential field, and sets the node selection range, which overcomes the randomness of the random tree growth. The simulation experiments show that the improved algorithm has the characteristics of high obstacle avoidance, short search time and strong real-time.

articleTitle: Solving a fuzzy flowshop problem with a self-adaptive DE algorithm
abstract: This paper studied a flowshop scheduling problem with fuzzy due dates where the objective of maximizing the sum of customer satisfaction for the completion times of jobs is concerned. A self-adaptive differential evolution (SDE) algorithm has been employed to solve the fuzzy flowshop problem (FFP). The mutation scaling factor F and crossover probability CR are self-adaptive during the evolutionary process which can balance the exploration and the exploitation effectively. In order to make the SDE algorithm more effective and efficient, a local search strategy based on insert operation is introduced to exploit more latitude of search space to anchor the global optimum. The experimental results on the problem instance from literature demonstrate the good performance of the proposed SDE, thereby proving its worth as an attractive alternative for flowshop problems in uncertain environments.

articleTitle: H∞ control of constrained-input nonlinear systems with unknown model based on adaptive dynamic programming
abstract: An Adaptive dynamic programming(ADP) algorithm that contain online measurement and off-policy learning two phase is proposed to solve the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> control problem of continuous-time nonlinear system with constrained-input and unknown model only based on online data. The model-free Hamiton-Jacobi-Isaacs(HJI) equation is derived by the policy iteration(PI) and the model-free iteration reinforcement learning(IRL) method. Three neural networks(NN) are structured, after collecting online data of system is finished, then off-policy learning method is used to approximate solve the model-free HJI equation. And the value function, control strategy and disturbance strategy are obtained by the NN. The weights of the neural network are solved by the least square method. The simulation results verify the feasibility of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Image denoising in security inspection of pantograph catenary
abstract: In the monitering of pantogragh-catenary system by the real-time methods, image processing technology is very important .As the first step of this technology, the image preprocessing is also crucial important. It is directly related to the precision of image processing during the following steps, then affecting the accuracy of testing results. Therefore, this paper discusses four algorithms of DCT, DWT, PCA, SVD ,for the unstable system like the pantograph and catenary system, this paper discuss the performance of these four methods. The comparasion results of image processing are obtained by Matlab programming. Finally, using the gray value and the signal-to-noise ratio to test the results, then the optimal image denoising algorithm of pantograph system is obtained. This optimal algorithm can provide the reference for engineering practice.

articleTitle: Research on modeling method of firepower collaborative process for shipboard cooperative air defense
abstract: Based on the process of naval fleet coordination and air defense operations, the air defense combat model of naval platform, carrier platform and ship and carrier-based aircraft is established. On this basis, the analysis of firepower distribution unit based on the method of queuing theory modeling, this paper analyzes the naval fleet and the aircraft in the platform, time, space and function on the basis of comparing the traditional air defense mode of the ship formation and the firepower of the naval fleet cooperative air defense model. Firepower cooperative mode and air defense firepower allocation method.

articleTitle: Research on online target allocation of multiple air-defense missiles
abstract: Weapon Target Assignment is a typical NP problem. In order to maximize the efficiency of air-defense missile cooperative operation in warship formation and improve the speed and precision of solving the problem, an online target assignment model of air-defense missile based on interception geometry is established. Adaptive large neighborhood search (ALNS) is applied to solve the model. According to the special requirements of model solving, two kinds of destroy operators and two kinds of repair operators are designed for ALNS algorithm, and the adaptive layer is designed to select operators with high search efficiency to improve the search efficiency. Through case analysis, it is proved that the proposed algorithm can solve the problem quickly and efficiently.

articleTitle: Leaderless state synchronization of homogeneous multi-agent systems via a universal adaptive nonlinear dynamic protocol
abstract: This paper studies leaderless state synchronization of continuous-time homogeneous multi-agent systems (MAS) with identical general linear agents. The communication network is with full-state coupling, or partial-state coupling but with additional information exchange. We assume that the communication topology is completely unknown and undirected. An adaptive nonlinear dynamic protocol design is presented to achieve leaderless state synchronization for a MAS. For the full-state coupling case, the protocol design is based on two methods. One is algebraic Riccati equation (ARE) method, and the other is asymptotic time-scale eigenstructure assignment (ATEA) method. We show that the adaptive nonlinear dynamic protocol is universal and does not depend on any information of communication topology such as lower bound of non-zero eigenvalue for the Laplacian matrix associated with the communication topology and the number of agents.

articleTitle: Design of fuzzy synovial trending law based on exponential change for industrial robot
abstract: In this paper, a variable exponential fuzzy synovial control law is designed by improving the general exponential approximation law as well as by combining the variable structure control with the fuzzy control In order to overcome a serious chattering phenomenon in the general exponential law. They also provide the MATLAB/simulink simulation results to illustrate that the design makes the system to attain fast tracking and reduce the tracking error. As well, the control input buffeting phenomenon is perceptibly improved, and the system stability is enhanced.

articleTitle: An Improved Algorithm for Multi-source Location Information Fusion Based on Comprehensive Probability Distance Matrix
abstract: The traditional multi-source location information fusion algorithm based on probability density function is inefficiency when dozens of targets are concerned. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes an improved algorithm which is based on comprehensive probability distance matrix (CPDM), and creatively puts forward how to extract location information on the same target by using absolute probability distance matrix (APDM) and relative probability distance matrix (RPDM). A simulation was conducted to emulate the real environment. The accuracy of the improved algorithm under different conditions is analyzed. Results show that the algorithm can effectively fuse multi-source location information to improve the locating precision.

articleTitle: Rotating stall detection of axial compressor based on LabVIEW
abstract: The main work of this paper is the online detection system design of axial compressor rotating stall by combining deterministic learning theory, dynamical pattern recognition algorithm, and LabVIEW. Based on MATLAB and GPU technology, the modelling of rotating stall offline data, which is obtained from axial compressor test rig, is realized and then the pattern library is constructed. The GPU technology accelerates the calculation speed of the algorithm. In view of the advantages of LabVIEW's graphical programming language and multicore parallel computing technology, this paper uses the LabVIEW software to design the axial compressor's rotating stall online detection system. The designed system has a friendly user interface, and it can give an alarm before the rotating stall and surge of the compressor test rig effectively and accurately. The detection results verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the axial compressor rotating stall detection system.

articleTitle: Stability and l1-gain analysis for positive 2D fuzzy systems in Roesser model
abstract: This paper considers the stability and l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>-gain analysis for positive two-dimensional (2D) linear systems with state delays described by the Roesser model based on Takagi-Sugeno(T-S) fuzzy logic rules. The co-positive type Lyapunov function method is applied to establish sufficient conditions of asymptotical stability for the addressed system. l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>-gain index is used to analyze the noise attenuation performance of the positive 2D T-S fuzzy delayed systems. The obtained results are formulated in the form of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). Finally, an illustrative example is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Image classification via structured dictionary learning
abstract: In the past years, dictionary learning has been widely used in many image classification applications. Although lots of dictionary learning methods have been proposed to deal with the issue of image classification, there exists much room for improvement. To further improve the performance of image classification, a novel structured dictionary learning method is here proposed. The proposed method based on the Fisher discriminative criterion aims to learn category-specific dictionaries for all categories in the lower level simultaneously to obtain the specific information of each category, and learn category-shared dictionaries between all categories in the upper level to obtain the common information across different categories. Experiment results on public available databases to specific category tasks are conducted to evaluate the effectiveness and the superiority of the proposed method compared with the state-of-the-art dictionary learning for category methods.

articleTitle: The textbook compilation for Altium Designer should highlight its practical characteristics
abstract: In light of the fact that current PCB design textbook adopted in higher education institution is not concerned with its actual practical circuit design application, this paper will use the practical engineering cases to illustrate several points and summarize the innovative practical experiences in the process of compiling Altium Designer textbook. This textbook features on its typical examples, using numerous training cases to help students master schematic diagram, PCB and 3D PCB design, PCB constraint rules and interactive routing, schematic library, PCB library and integrated library creation, circuit design and simulation technology gradually. Finally, this study will use the robot circuit design as an example, exploring the design methods of hierarchical schematic diagram and multi-channel circuit, with the purpose to improve students' PCB design skills. Teaching practice indicates that adopting new textbook with its design cases could optimize students' knowledge structure and strengthen their circuit and PCB design capacity, also it will be beneficial to cultivate students' learning and innovative capacity. Through the survey of questionnaire, 94.2% of the students think that through the study of this course, they can master the design skills of circuit and PCB.

articleTitle: Bifurcation analysis of a food chain system incorporating time delay and the disease spreading among prey species
abstract: In this paper, a food chain system incorporating time delay and the disease spreading among prey species is proposed. The positive of such system is given. In the presence of time delay, some sufficient conditions of the local stability of the positive equilibrium and the existence of Hopf bifurcation are obtained by analyzing the corresponding characteristic equation, and the properties of Hopf bifurcation are showed by using the normal form theory and center manifold theorem. Some simulations are given to support our analytical results.

articleTitle: Design of Air Source Heat Pump System Based on BP Network Prediction
abstract: The temperature control problem of condenser outlet water in air source heat pump hot water system is studied and a BP network predictive control scheme is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the outlet water temperature control structure of the air source heat pump system is designed. The control structure adopts a cascade control structure, which comprises outlet water temperature prediction control and water flow control. Then, a BP network model of outlet temperature was established to derive a numerical optimization algorithm for optimizing the objective function of water flow control. Finally, the control effect of predictive control and PID control are compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on classification of LBS service facilities based on rough sets neural network
abstract: LBS is location based services, it is through the Internet or wireless network, for mobile intelligent terminal users to find a certain range of service facilities, such as hotels, restaurants, cinemas and so on. With the continuous improvement and development of LBS, more and more businesses to join into the LBS application, LBS data of system processing become complicated, classification method for LBS terminal services to the original has not been able to quickly and effectively to classify service facilities. In order to overcome this shortcoming, a classification method based on rough set neural network is proposed. This method uses XML language to describe the basic properties of the building, followed by the theoretical analysis of the basic attribute information of building type rough set, redundant attribute information excluding data, to reduce the number of iterations, the neural network training to improve the convergence speed of the network. On this basis, the BP neural network is used to classify the building types. Finally, the method is compared with the traditional neural network by simulation experiment, and the results show that the method has the advantages of fast convergence and high classification efficiency.

articleTitle: Existence of solutions for a class of fractional ordinary differential equations with integral and antiperiodic boundary value conditions
abstract: We study the existence of solutions to a class of fractional differential equations with integral and antiperiodic boundary conditions. The boundary conditions for the mixed conditions with integrals and counter-cycles are obtained using the Arzela-Ascofi theorem, the Schauder's fixed point theorem, and the Krasnosel'skii theorem to obtain the existence of the solution to the problem. Finally, gives three numerical examples to verify the result.

articleTitle: Axial suspension control for P.M.D with pitch stiffness improvement
abstract: This paper proposed active and passive suspension control for permanent magnet disk (P.M.D). The eddy current damping is introduced into suspension control for the improvement of the pitch stiffness and weak damping. Considering the deformation of the magnetic field and the centerline deviation of the suspension coils, the axial and pitch motion equations of the disk permanent magnet are constructed, with which the essence of the suspension shock is revealed, and then Pitch stiffness is improved by the eddy current damping. The single D.O.F axial suspension controller was designed with the consideration of suspension stability and measurement noise, and the stability domain of the controller was analyzed on the influence of eddy current damping. The experiment platform is builted to validate the active and passive suspension control strategy from the two operation condition on both the rated air gap and the variable air gap.

articleTitle: Research on planning method of tunneling cutting trajectory with uncertain constraints
abstract: In order to realize intelligent tunneling and automatic section forming, a method of cutting trajectory planning for roadheader with uncertain constraints has been proposed in this paper, which aiming at the uncertainty of cutting and trajectory planning. Firstly, cutting mechanism was analyzed, the cutting section equation was constructed, and the correct limit cutting section was obtained by simulation. Secondly, the factors influencing cutting trajectory were analyzed and confirmed, which are deviation of roadheader position and pose, the dirt band and control system characteristics. The roadheader position and pose could be described by level deviation angle, level deviation displacement, pitching angle and rolling angle. The influence of each single parameter on the cutting trajectory was calculated, and the composite deviation could be decomposed to compensate due to the parameters do not interfere with each other. Finally, the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) was used to plan the cutting trajectory. The roadway section environment was modeled by the grid method, and the dirt band was described as the gray area which can not be cut. The algorithm was designed and carried out by Matlab. The simulation has been verified the particle swarm optimization algorithm could plan out the optimal path that avoiding the dirt band and ensuring the section forming. This paper laid an important foundation for robotic automatic tunneling.

articleTitle: Expert knowledge based multi-agent reinforcement learning and its application in multi-robot hunting problem
abstract: We propose a novel reinforcement learning algorithm based on expert knowledge to further solve curse of dimensionality and accelerate the convergence when solving multi-robot hunting problem. Two kinds of expert knowledge are designed: one is the multi-agent joint state abstraction method based on dynamic ID, which dramatically reduces the number of state space; the other is the multi-agent Q-learning algorithm based on artificial potential field (APF). In this method, the artificial potential field is utilized to initialize the Q value according to the environmental prior knowledge, hence the robot can acquire a better learning foundation and accelerate convergence. Finally, the proposed algorithm is validated by the multi-robot hunting problem. The results show that the method can reduce the number of state space and accelerate convergence, thus improve the performance of the algorithm.

Author Keywords: Joint State Abstraction Method Based on Dynamic ID

articleTitle: Research on information fusion method for mobile electronic commerce based on improved Monte Carlo algorithm under big data environment
abstract: Information of mobile e- commerce has increased dramatically and it highlights the characteristics of the user's location information under big data environment. For huge amounts of data under big data environment, how to take advantage of user's location information to mine potentially useful information quickly and efficiently for users, and provide users with useful decision support services, which become one of key research direction in mobile e-commerce recent years . This paper puts forward an improved Monte Carlo algorithm- fast Monte Carlo algorithm on the basis of the traditional Monte Carlo algorithm, which effectively solve particle degradation problems in the traditional algorithm. Finally, the paper makes simulation experiment, compares the traditional information fusion method and shows that the fusion method has higher accuracy, at the same time reducing the complexity of the algorithm. It makes mobile e-commerce platform can more accurately predict user behavior information, better service to provide decision support.

articleTitle: Improved harmony search algorithm applied in power system economic load dispatch
abstract: This paper presents a harmony search algorithm with opposition-based learning techniques (HS-OBL) to solve power system. To prevent the HS-OBL algorithm from being trapped into the local optimum effectively, an improved algorithm in this paper integrates the opposition-based learning operation with the improvisation process. After that, pitch adjusting rate (PAR) and harmony memory consideration rate (HMCR) are adjusted by a new adjusting strategy that is designed for dynamic adjustment to further improve the performance of algorithm. The HS-OBL is employed to solve 7units and 14units power system, the numerical results show that the HS-OBL has performed much better than harmony search (HS) algorithm and other improved algorithms that have been reported in recent literature. And the data has shown in table 4.

articleTitle: Adaptive cluster synchronization with network failures in community networks
abstract: This paper discusses the adaptive cluster synchronization problem of a class of complex dynamical networks with network failures via pinning control method. An effective adaptive scheme to tune the feedback control gain is represented based on information of the network's topology structure. The pinning control scheme is employed in designing controllers according to the nodes property for guaranteeing cluster synchronization. Based on the Lyapunov stability theory, the sufficient synchronization conditions are given and proved theoretically. Finally, some numerical examples are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Robust control for a class of uncertain nonlinear systems using adaptive filters
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of output tracking for a class of nonlinear uncertain systems in strict feedback form. By utilizing the nonlinear filters with a common compensator, a robust adaptive control scheme is proposed via dynamic surface approach. Compared with the existing results in the literature, the proposed control scheme not only avoids the issue of "explosion of complexity" in the recursive procedure, but also eliminates the effects raised by boundary layer errors. Finally, a numerical example is presented to verify the effectiveness of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: About step-length of ZeaD (Zhang et al Discretization) formula 4IgS_Y for future minimization via fan equations
abstract: Future minimization, i.e., discrete time-varying minimization, is a difficult and meaningful problem. It has been successfully solved by Zhang et al using zeroing dynamics (ZD) and discretization formulas. In this paper, a type of discrete-time ZD (DT-ZD) model, which is obtained via utilizing ZeaD (Zhang et al Discretization) formula 4IgS_Y, is analyzed and investigated to ensure its stability. Specifically, via theoretical guarantees, we propose the step-length domain, or say, the effective domain of the step-length, which makes the discrete-time model stable. Additionally, we make further efforts to obtain the step-length optimum which provides the optimal stability of the DT-ZD model. Eventually, numerical experiments are performed to validate the step-length domain and the step-length optimum of the DT-ZD model for future minimization.

articleTitle: Design military and civil information exchange organization management system based on structural entropy
abstract: To build the optimal military and civil information exchange organization management system, ensure that all kinds of Civil-Military Integration main body can obtain and exchange Civil-Military Integration information very efficient and convenient, and as many ways as possible. Defined the concept of military and civil information exchange organization management system, designed two kinds of military and civil information exchange organization management system, such as decentralized and centralized, used the "institution + process relation" method to obtain decentralized and centralized organization operational structure, evaluated the decentralized and centralized organization operational structure from the order degree and flexibility degree based on structural entropy theory, on this basis, get the optimal military and civil information exchange organization management system, centralized organization management system.

articleTitle: Planet gear fault diagnosis based on HVD and envelope time-domain synchronous average
abstract: Planetary gearboxes are widely applied in rotating machinery due to unique its merits. Planet gears play an important role in planetary gearboxes, but it prone to be damaged because of the terrible operating condition. In addition, the vibration signal of planetary gearbox is complicated, which makes it difficult to diagnose the failure of gears in planetary gearboxes. To solve this problem, a method combining the Hilbert vibration decomposition (HVD) and envelope time-domain synchronous average is proposed. The HVD technique it is used to decompose original signal into a set of monocomponents. Envelop is utilized to extract weak feature related to initial gear faults and the time-domain synchronous average (TSA) technique can precisely extract the interested periodic component. Experimental results support the proposed method positively.

Author Keywords: Hilbert Vibration Decomposition and Envelope Time-domain Synchronous Average

articleTitle: An improved condition for set invariance for neutral time-delay systems considering input saturation and fault
abstract: In this paper, authors gave an improved condition for set invariance for neutral time-delay systems with actuator saturation and fault. Methods for designing indirect adaptive fault-tolerant controllers are given for actuator fault compensations. Based on the on-line estimation of eventual faults, the adaptive fault-tolerant controller parameters are updating automatically to compensate the fault effects on systems. The improved condition for set invariance are developed in the framework of linear matrix inequality (LMI) approach, which can guarantee that the domain of asymp­totic stability of closed-loop systems is enlarged as possible in the cases of actuator saturation, time-delay and actuator failures.

articleTitle: Bidding strategy based on the degree of completion for bilateral negotiation of power market
abstract: Rubinstein model is widely used in bilateral negotiation problems, and in this paper it is used in the bilateral negotiations between large consumer and generating company in power market. In real market, there are several negotiation agents for one large consumer or one generating company, and thus different from traditional STS (Single-To-Single) model, MTM (Multi-To-Multi) model is used in this paper to describe the bilateral negotiations between large consumer and generating company. In Rubinstein model, the concession negotiation strategy is expressed by the discount factor, but in the bilateral negotiations between large consumer and generating company the motivation of concession is quite different from general problems. Then, based on above MTM model, the discount factor is defined according to the degree of completion and the negotiation round. Detailed strategy design is given in the paper and the results of numerical simulation also demonstrate the validity of proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Nonlinear dynamic analysis for a permanent magnet synchronous motor model and its application in magnetic flux optimization
abstract: This paper focuses on the optimization of magnetic flux linkage in permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM). A new compact representation of the PMSM nonlinear dynamic differential equations is established to reduce the complexity of system parameters. Afterwards, in order to avoid the unstable of the system, the complicated nonlinear dynamic behavior of PMSM is analyzed in detail with variation of parameters μ and Meanwhile, the nonlinear dynamic characteristics of novel PMSM equations in the process of magnetic flux linkage changing are further considered, and the magnetic flux linkage stable region of PMSM is obtained concurrently. In addition, according to the practical design requirements and the analysis results, a 30kW PMSM 2D/3D model is designed by ANSYS. Finally, the optimum value of flux linkage and the corresponding permanent magnet specifications and dimensions are obtained to illustrate the effectiveness and feasibility of our theory result.

articleTitle: TOPSIS based earth station marking method
abstract: Earth stations í ES) play a vitally important role in satellite communication systems í SCS), and the evaluation of earth stations is in deadly need with the rapid development of SCS application market, but only a few researches have been done on it. In this paper, an earth station marking scheme based on TOPSIS. which is one of the most popular MCDM method, is proposed. By this scheme, the marking result is rational, comprehensive, interpretable and comparable. To lake both people's preferences on criteria and objectivity of the result into account, pairwise comparison matrix method is used to calculate weights of criteria. Instead of constructing ideal solution from extreme criteria values of alternatives, fixed positive and negative ideal solutions (FPIS and FNIS) are proposed to avoid rank reversal and keep the result consistent.

Author Keywords: Technique for order preference by similarity to ideal solutions (TOPSIS)

articleTitle: Unbiased estimation localization for wireless sensor networks
abstract: Considering the biased estimation and inaccurate localization in WSNs, we propose the unbiased estimation localization. For average hop distance, the deviation is introduced to improve the solution. Then the node distance is shown in a system of equations which can be solved by Least Square Method. By formula transformation, this process is based on three parameters. The calculated result uses the deviation in average hop distance estimation to balance the weight. The final result combines the deviation and Least Square Method. Its simulation results are compared with other method which performs better in accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on security and stable checking algorithm of power system control
abstract: In recent years, measures against maloperation such as power grid online security analysis software are deployed in main stations of power grid, which can hardly adapt to the frequent operation circumstances of power grid with the development of power grid. In this paper, security and stability problems of power grid control are analyzed based on current situation and structure of power grid, and an efficient control algorithm for main station of power grid is presented, which can achieve anti-misoperation of power grid in multiple conditions. With full use of line characteristics, the algorithm takes less time for calculation to fulfill frequent operation of power grid with the ensurance of security, which is of great significance for the safe and stable operation of power grid and the development of smart grid.

articleTitle: Human behavior recognition method based on double-branch deep convolution neural network
abstract: Aiming at the poor robustness and the low accuracy of 2D image recognition, this paper presents a method of human behaviors recognition based on double-branch deep convolution neural network. Firstly, the features of the input image are extracted, and the feature maps are input into the double-branch deep convolution neural network to obtain the joints information of human body and the joints connection information of human body respectively. And we used the Hopcroft-Karp algorithm to optimally match skeletal joints to obtain the human skeletal sequence diagram. The human behaviors are identified by the multi-classification support vector machines. Finally, through the training and testing of standing, walking, running, waving, bending, squatting and sitting on seven kinds of general human behaviors, the experimental results show that the proposed approach has good accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Research on the algorithm of noisy laser stripe center extraction
abstract: Considering various interference such as environmental change, surface roughness, background reflection and so on, the extraction of laser stripe center should be difficult, especially for bent or irregular laser stripes with noise. Because of the noise diversity, this paper firstly designs a template to finish a two-step convolution process for eliminating the false light-spots, then uses a median filter to reduce the random noise. After identifying every point's normal equation along the edge of the stripe in a small neighborhood, the nearest neighboring points around the normal are searched and based on the gray values of these points, the gravity method is used to extract the sub-pixel coordinates of the stripe centers. Simulation results prove the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Active fault tolerant control design for UAV using nonsingular fast terminal sliding mode approach
abstract: In this paper, an active fault tolerant controller is proposed for the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) attitude control system using nonsingular fast terminal sliding mode control technique. Firstly, the nonlinear attitude dynamics model of UAV with actuator faults and external disturbance is described. Next, a neural network-based fault estimation observer is designed to obtain the estimated value of unknown actuator faults and external disturbance, and the stability of the designed observer is also proved. Then, an active fault tolerant controller is designed based on the fault estimation observer and nonsingular fast terminal sliding mode control technique. The Lyapunov stability analysis shows that the proposed fault tolerant controller can guarantee the finite time asymptotic stability for nonlinear closed-loop attitude control systems of UAV with actuator faults and external disturbances. Finally, numerical simulation results are presented to illustrate the benefit of the proposed scheme.

Author Keywords: nonsingular fast terminal sliding mode control

articleTitle: A dendritic neuron based very short-term prediction model for photovoltaic power
abstract: As solar energy accounts for an increasing share of total energy, PV power prediction becomes more and more important in order to control power quality and improve system stability. Traditional neural network models usually require a large number of neurons when used for PV power prediction. The recently proposed dendritic neuron model, which has the advantages of fast convergence rate, simple structure and high prediction accuracy, is introduced to predict the PV power output. The relevant influencing factors are taken as input variables and transmitted to synapses of dendritic neurons, and then a dendritic neuron model based PV Power output prediction method is developed. To evaluate the validity of the proposed prediction model, the experiments simulation are conducted comparing with some common used neural network models. The simulation results show that the dendritic neuron prediction model can effectively improve the prediction accuracy of the PV power output.

articleTitle: Lane detection algorithm based on density clustering and RANSAC
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy, real-time and robustness of video lane detection, in this paper, we propose a fast lane detection algorithm based on DBSCAN (Density Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise) clustering algorithm and improved RANSAC (random sample consensus). Firstly, the image is preprocessed by graying and binarizing in the inverse perspective mapping image. Secondly, eliminating noise points and smoothing lane boundaries by using morphological erosion and opening operation in the binary image, then traversing the binary image and extracting the feature points. Then, the feature points are clustered by DBSCAN clustering algorithm, which are then divided into clusters. Finally, the points in every class was fitted a straight line or curve line by using improved RANSAC algorithm based on parabola. The experimental results show that the improved RANSAC algorithm accelerates the speed of lane detection. The proposed algorithm has good real-time, robustness and accuracy.

articleTitle: High-precision analysis of discrete-time fractional-order sliding mode control
abstract: This paper proposes a discrete-time fractional-order sliding mode (DFSM) control scheme based on the single-input second-order system. The general methods of designing a fractional-order sliding surface and the DFSM controller are introduced. Specifically, a series of researches on the performance of the sliding surface, the dynamics of the sliding variable and the results of simulations and experiments are conduced in this paper. Moreover, during the researches, the parametric uncertainties of the system are taken into consideration, which makes the conclusion properer to the cases in practical industrial applications.

articleTitle: Nonlinear disturbance observer-based sliding backstepping hovering control of a quadrotor
abstract: In this paper, the nonlinear observer based hovering control is addressed for a quadrotor with system uncertainties and external disturbances. Main contributions are as follows: 1) A nonlinear observer for complex unknowns including unmodelled dynamics and external disturbances is designed for a quadrotor, and thereby contributing to more robustness pertaining to the closed-loop system; 2) The sliding backstepping based technique is then employed to realize hovering control of a quadrotor, and thereby leading to the proposed controller which achieves satisfactory control performance; 3) Exhaustive analyses ensure that tracking errors of the overall system can converge to a small neighborhood of the origin. Furthermore, a large number of simulation experiments show the effectiveness of the proposed control law.

articleTitle: A study on harmony search algorithm and applications
abstract: This paper presents a study on harmony search algorithm with application. A disadvantage of HAS is trapped into the local optimum easily, so many improved algorithms about the HAS have been presented by research scholars. We, in this paper, reviewed many methods published in the journals, which have been valued in some aspects, such as dynamic parameters adjustment, self-adaptive adjustment, global search and local search strategy, even the HS combined with other intelligent algorithms.

articleTitle: Underwater image dehazing using modified dark channel prior
abstract: In an underwater environment, light always scatters and absorbs as it travels from the object to the camera, seriously affecting image quality. As a result, underwater images have poorer contrast, like a haze covering them. In this paper, a modified method for images restoration based on the dark channel prior (DCP) is presented. Firstly, the ambient light is estimated according to the difference between the blue and red channel. Then, attenuations of three RGB channels are obtained separately. Finally, a color collection is used to compensate the remaining color distortion. The experiments carried out at last demonstrate the good performance of this method for improving the visibility of underwater images.

articleTitle: An indoor autonomous guided vehicle based on electromagnetic tracking and positioning ibeacon
abstract: In order to further improve the efficiency of indoor unmanned transport, a low-power and efficient navigation and positioning system is designed. The system combines the advantages of the detecting method of electromagnetic signals and the indoor positioning technology based on Bluetooth Low Energy (BTLE). By analyzing the magnetic field model, common inductance coils are used as a sensor to detect the magnetic field, and the differential steering mechanism of the motor is controlled by the tracking characteristics of the dual-inductive electromagnetic sensor. For GPS can not provide satisfactory indoor positioning results, on the basis of the electromagnetic tracking system combined with the indoor positioning technology based on spatial information mode, a stable and independent indoor positioning system is finally realized. And with the predetermined electromagnetic track crossing point, the dead reckoning accumulated error for signpost is revised. The experimental results show that the system can achieve stable operation, and the system design is reasonable and basically meets the design goals and users' needs.

articleTitle: Maximum daily load forecasting based on support vector regression considering accumulated temperature effect
abstract: Maximum daily load forecasting is of great significance in power system dispatching. First, electric load characteristics are analysed in this paper. Second, maximum load and weather factors are selected as the input of the maximum incremental load forecasting regression model, and the mapping relationship between input and output is established by least squares support vector machine (LS-SVM). Then, the modified date type normalization of rest days is proposed according to load change regulation in summer. Moreover, the effect of accumulated temperature is considered to reduce the model prediction error. Finally, numerical tests demonstrated the efficiency of the proposed model.

articleTitle: An Overview of Photovoltaic System
abstract: Solar Photovoltaic (PV) energy conversion system has drawn the tremendous attention of researchers in the past recent years. The concern related to global energy crisis and climate change threats from conventional sources of energy leads to look for alternate sources of energy. Solar energy is seen as a potential alternate source of energy as it is available globally in abundant. To develop an efficient and stable solar PV energy conversion various analysis are done by the researchers. It is analyzed at various facets like PV module characteristic, Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) algorithm, Islanding Detection methods, Inverter etc. This paper present an overview of the research going on in this area, focused on aspects mentioned above. This overview may be useful for further investigation to improve the system.

articleTitle: Study on insulator recognition method based on simulated samples expansion
abstract: In the application of the deep learning to the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) autonomous inspection, a problem about the insufficiency of both quantity and quality for insulator images emerges. In the light of this situation, a sample expansion method based on a combination of statute and 3D modelling technology is proposed. Its feasibility is verified in a deep convolutional neural network by using five kinds of insulator simulated samples. The classification accuracy acquired by the proposed method is higher verified by the comparison of the experimental results, which proves its superiority to the traditional method containing no simulated samples. It is concluded that the simulated intensive samples of pure background have a significant effect on the accuracy of network classification. And when the ratio of real samples to simulated intensive samples goes to an appropriate value, the classification has the best accuracy.

articleTitle: Variable Pitch Sliding Mode Control of Wind Turbine Based on Disturbance Observer
