An improved LOS algorithm is used to calculate the desired heading instruction and make sideslip angle compensation. In the respect of yaw control, active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) is employed to deal with the heading attitude tracking, which inherits the advantages of proportional-integral-derivative (PID) and combines the modern control theory. The disturbance can easily be estimated by the portion of ADRC. The effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified by the simulation results.

articleTitle: An agent-based simulation model to analyze journal impact factor
abstract: In order to research the differences of journal impact factors among different disciplines, a simple agent-based simulation model is stablished in the article. Our model uses a novel method, namely a distributed method, which can effectively simulate the publication and citation activities of the articles in the journals of a discipline. According to simulation experiments and actual collected data, the tendency of impact factors is affected by some fundamental elements that are average review period and average quantity of references. Furthermore, we can observe a satisfactory approximation between certain real data and simulation consequences.

articleTitle: Study on evacuation simulation of medical pension building based on anylogic
abstract: In order to shorten evacuation time and improve evacuation efficiency, evacuation model for a medical pension building based on social force model and agent technology in Anylogic simulation platform is built. In this Evacuation model, physiological and psychological characteristics of evacuees are considered. By comparing the evacuation results with different evacuation numbers, evacuation patterns and mental parameters of evacuees, it conclude that the evacuation time is the longest when the psychological parameters are lower under the same evacuation number. This paper proved the important influence of mental parameters on evacuation through the complicated, diverse and truthful evacuation simulation.

articleTitle: Platoon control for connected vehicles based on the V2X communications: Design and implementation
abstract: This study proposes a platoon control for connected vehicles under the realistic vehicle-to-vehicle/vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2X) communications. In particular, a two-level framework including the vehicle merging and diverging is designed for the platoon control. Then, the corresponding field experiments are implemented according to the designed framework. To this end, the dedicated short range communication (DSRC) is used to facilitate the communication links. And on-board units (OBUs) and roadside units (RSUs) are developed for information exchange (i.e., position, speed and direction). In addition, the IEEE 802.11p is chosen as the protocol of DSRC. Results from the experiments validate the effectiveness of the proposed method in terms of the position trajectories and speed.

articleTitle: Distributed set-membership observer-based consensus of nonlinear delayed multi-agent systems under round-robin protocols
abstract: In this paper, we study the set-membership leader-following consensus problem for nonlinear discrete- time multi-agent systems with mixed time-delays and bounded noises under switching topologies. A distributed set- membership consensus protocol, which is based on set-membership observers, is presented. The scheduling of sensor information towards the observers is ruled by the Round-Robin protocol. Sufficient conditions are derived for the existence of the consensus protocol and the observers, and the parameters of the desired consensus protocol and the observers are obtained by solving a set of recursive linear matrix inequalities. Both the topology-mode-dependent observers and the topology-mode-independent observers are considered. Finally, a numerical example is utilized to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed state estimators and consensus protocol.

articleTitle: Outlier-factor-based cluster analysis for infrared image segmentation of electric equipment
abstract: This paper proposes an outlier-factor-based cluster analysis algorithm for infrared image segmentation of electric equipment. Firstly, the information dataset of HSI color feature space of the original image is constructed. Secondly, pre-segmentation of the information dataset is performed by clustering. Thirdly, according to the pre-segmentation results, the post-segmentation estimates the information objects by outlier factor, which reflects the isolation level of the information object to remove noise objects in target domain. Finally, the target domain of image is segmented by mapping the information dataset of the post-segmented back to the original image. The experiments are performed on the infrared image of insulator to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Compared with the traditional clustering segmentation methods, the experimental results verify that fuzzy C-means combined with the connectivity outlier factor has the highest clustering segmentation capability and removes the noise more effectively.

articleTitle: Event-Based Consensus Control of Multi-Agent Systems with Input Saturation Constraint
abstract: The event-based leader-following consensus problem for multi-agent systems with input saturation is stud­ied in this paper. The control input update is event-driven, and the triggering function is linear, under the given trigger function and trigger condition. At first, a sufficient condition of the leader-following consensus for multi-agent systems without input saturation is presented. Furthermore, under the constraint of input saturation and communication time delay, the leader-following consensus control is achieved through designing control protocol and choosing suitable pa­rameters of control input. Lyapunov function in combination with S-procedure method is adopted to prove the consensus stability for multi-agent systems with input saturation and communication time delay. Moreover, the Zeno-behavior is excluded for the triggering time sequence. Finally, simulations are present to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed consensus control protocols.

articleTitle: Approach for time series prediction based on empirical mode decomposition and extreme learning machine
abstract: In order to improve the prediction accuracy of time series, a prediction method based on empirical mode decomposition and extreme learning machine is proposed. Through empirical mode decomposition, original time series can be decomposed into different frequency components. The components after decomposing remove the long correlation, prominent and the different local characteristics of time series, which can reduce the non-stationary of time series. Different extreme learning machine is introduced to prediction each component with different frequencies. The prediction value of each component is superimposed to obtain the final prediction result. Two typical time series include Lorenz chaotic time series and network traffic time series are chosen as the simulation object. Simulation results show that the prediction method in this paper has a good performance with smaller prediction error.

articleTitle: Instructions Data Compression for Smart Grid Monitoring using Wavelet Domain Singular Value Decomposition
abstract: This paper proposes a data compression for power grid using wavelet domain singular value decomposition (WDSVD). The method splits the power signal into cycles and combines them as a 2D matrix. Then 2D discrete wavelet transform (2DDWT) is used to decompose the original matrix into submatrices. Singular value decomposition(SVD) compresses the data in each submatrix domain according to adaptive threshold setting based on Bayesian rules. Then the data is quantized by uniform threshold quantizer. By various tests and comparisons, the new method is validated for low reconstruction error and high compression ratio (CR) of both single and multiple signal monitoring as smart grid requires.
